Title: Content Analyst
Description:
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.

Job Description

The team:

We are a unified, collaborative marketing team focused on creating meaningful client connections that drive business growth. We combine deep insights with strong partnerships to deliver timely, relevant, and impactful experiences for our clients. Our team is committed to continuous learning, innovation, and excellence in everything we do. We align closely with distribution partners to generate demand and unlock new opportunities across the business. Above all, we measure and optimize our efforts to ensure we consistently deliver value, drive engagement, and strengthen loyalty to Invesco.

The role:

The Content Enablement Content Analyst is a key role within Invesco’s Global Content Enablement team, supporting the Americas & EMEA Marketing organization. This position executes the content strategy and roadmap to enhance the quality, accessibility, and usability of content across the EMEA region. The role focuses on building and managing content infrastructure, ensuring accurate categorization, distribution, and access across platforms and audiences. It partners closely with business and technology stakeholders to deliver consistent, well-governed content solutions and ensure requirements are clearly defined and tested. This hands-on role is critical to improving content quality and driving engagement, ultimately enabling a stronger client and investment experience.

Responsibilities of the role:

Provides analytics support primarily for EMEA content domains, with additional support for North America.
Partners closely with EMEA Content Product Owners to deliver analysis across development, deployment, and research initiatives.
Defines and standardizes content quality metrics, building reporting and dashboards to provide visibility into content performance for senior leadership.
Collaborates with EMEA and NA domain experts to develop and maintain global taxonomy, aligning stakeholders to standardized definitions and fields.
Bridges business and technology teams to ensure solutions meet requirements and align with strategic priorities.
Maps business processes, develops expertise in content sources, and provides recommendations to improve content effectiveness.
Translates stakeholder needs into user stories and supports execution of content initiatives, including testing, impact analysis, and cross-team coordination.
Leads governance and documentation efforts, including content quality monitoring, process improvement, issue escalation, and maintaining records in tools such as Jira and Confluence.


Requirements of the role:

Bachelor’s degree, 5+ years in technology platforms, project management, or content development and distribution.
Experience with CMS and/or DAM platforms, content lifecycle management, and content migrations, including API-based integrations.
Familiarity with AI-assisted content analysis and UX or digital marketing concepts.
Strong skills in workflow/process mapping, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and operate effectively in ambiguous environments.
Advanced technical proficiency, including SQL and Excel (advanced formulas, pivot tables; VBA a plus), along with strong desktop tool capabilities.
Strong analytical and statistical reasoning skills, with ability to organize, analyze, and communicate large data sets with accuracy and attention to detail.
Knowledge of content categorization (campaign, program, asset class, product), with preferred experience in investment or asset management content.
Client-focused, execution-oriented professional with strong communication, organizational, relationship-building, and influencing skills, plus a data-driven approach to measuring content performance and impact.


The salary range for this position is $55,000 to $61,000 per year. The total compensation offered for this position includes salary and incentive pay and will vary based on skills, experience and location.

Full Time / Part Time

Full time

Worker Type

Employee

Job Exempt (Yes / No)

Yes

Workplace Model

Pursuant to Invesco’s Workplace Policy, employees are expected to comply with the firm’s most current workplace model, which as of October 1, 2025, includes spending at least four full days each week working in an Invesco office. This reflects our belief that spending time together in the office helps us build stronger relationships, collaborate more easily, and support each other’s growth and development.

What’s in it for you?

Our people are at the very core of our success and we strive to provide employees with a competitive total rewards package which includes:

Hybrid working environment
RRSP Contributions
Health & Wellness Benefits
Work flexibility Programs
Parental Leave Benefits
Study Support

Title: Decision Support Analyst
Description:
Requisition ID: 46744

Organization

Vancouver is consistently ranked as one of the world’s most liveable and environmentally sustainable cities. Recognized among BC’s Top Employers and Canada’s Greenest Employers, the City of Vancouver is seeking colleagues who can help advance our core commitments to exceptional public service, sustainability, equity, and an outstanding quality of life for all residents.

With a strong commitment to being a City of Reconciliation, we invite you to join our dedicated team and become part of an innovative, inclusive, and engaging workplace. A career with the City of Vancouver and within the broader public service, offers meaningful work where you play a key role in ensuring equitable access to services, upholding ethical governance, and supporting the needs of citizens with integrity and dedication.

Main Purpose and Function

The Decision Support Analyst is part of the City’s Centre of Expertise for Performance Measurement and Decision Support, within the Strategy and Project Support Office (SPSO). The role supports evidence-informed decision-making across the City by helping leaders understand service performance, assess options, evaluate outcomes, and identify opportunities to improve accountability, transparency and value for money.

The role combines performance measurement, service evaluation, business analysis and business intelligence to help leaders make sound strategic, operational and service-delivery decisions. A core part of the team’s mandate is enabling the delivery of an enterprise-wide corporate planning process and the evaluation of City services, ensuring decisions are grounded in consistent, comparable evidence.

The analysis considers operational, financial, resource and service-delivery implications and supports recommendations to managers and senior leaders.

The Decision Support Analyst partners closely with corporate and departmental teams to build a culture of data-informed decision-making across the City. This includes increasing data literacy, enabling data exploration, supporting adoption of business intelligence tools, and translating complex analysis into clear, decision-ready insight.

Specific Duties/Responsibilities


Performance Measurement and Corporate Planning
Supports performance measurement reporting by linking City services and service plans to performance metrics, departmental work plans and the corporate plan.
Supports the design and delivery of the City’s enterprise-wide corporate planning process, helping connect service plans, performance measures and corporate priorities.
Supports corporate, capital and service-planning processes by connecting service plans and performance information to operating requirements, costs and resource implications.
Develops, monitors and analyzes performance metrics and benchmarks to assess the efficiency, effectiveness and outcomes of City services.
Helps identify short-term and long-term measures that support continuous improvement, service planning and corporate accountability.
Reviews and analyzes how major City decisions may affect service plans, performance measures and service-delivery outcomes.


Service Evaluation and Decision Support


Contributes to the evaluation of City services by helping define evaluation questions, identify measures of success, gather evidence, analyze outcomes and summarize findings.
Synthesizes quantitative and qualitative evidence into clear findings, implications and options for decision-makers.
Provides analytical decision support, including business analysis, options analysis, scenario modelling and business case development, and develops findings and recommendations for managers and senior leaders.
Analyzes and develops service proposals and business cases, including their operating, financial, resource, risk, benefit and performance implications.
Assists client departments in identifying opportunities to improve service outcomes, strengthen accountability, increase transparency and support value-for-money decision-making.
Applies structured problem-solving approaches to complex business, operational and service-delivery questions.


Analytics, Reporting and Data Quality


Develops and maintains datasets, reports, dashboards and analytical models using tools such as Power BI, Excel, SQL and other business intelligence platforms.
Supports the development of user-friendly reporting products that help leaders and service owners understand performance, trends, risks and opportunities.
Works with client departments to identify and remediate data quality issues that affect reporting, analysis and decision-making.
Supports the team’s use of modern analytics platforms, including Microsoft Fabric, Databricks or similar tools, as required.
Contributes to the development of consistent reporting methods, data definitions and analytical approaches across the City.


Stakeholder Support and BI Adoption


Works with client departments to understand business needs, clarify decision questions and translate those needs into useful analytical products.
Supports adoption of business intelligence tools by developing guidance materials, providing training or coaching, and helping users interpret and apply performance information.
Builds effective working relationships with technical, professional and operational staff across the City.
Presents analysis clearly and appropriately for different audiences, including operational teams, managers and senior leaders.
Supports a culture of data-informed decision-making by helping departments use evidence to understand performance, improve services and make better decisions.
Other duties as assigned.


Minimum Qualification Requirements

Education and Experience:


A relevant master’s degree, such as Business Analytics, Commerce, Economics, Statistics, Public Policy, Public Administration or an MBA, or a professional designation, or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience. Examples include a CPA.
Minimum 4–5 years of experience in performance measurement, data analytics, service or program evaluation, business analysis, business intelligence or a related field, ideally in a large, complex organization.


Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Considerable knowledge of performance metrics, benchmarking and service evaluation, with the ability to link operational and financial measures to service outcomes.
Considerable knowledge of business intelligence, analytics and automation tools to transform data into reliable, user-friendly reporting and decision-support products.
Considerable knowledge of business intelligence and analytics tools such as Power BI, Excel, SQL and data modelling approaches.
Considerable knowledge of designing performance measures, indicators or evaluation approaches that inform strategic, operational or service-delivery decisions.
Ability to support corporate planning, service planning, business planning or enterprise reporting processes.
Ability to systematically frame and breakdown complex issues, opportunities or service questions, and reaches conclusions supported by evidence and sound judgment.
Ability to work with structured data, analytical models, data quality issues and modern BI platforms, with the ability to partner effectively with technical teams.
Ability to turn quantitative and qualitative information into clear findings, implications and recommendations.
Ability to present complex analysis simply and compellingly in writing, verbally and through reports, dashboards and presentations.
Experience supporting multi-stakeholder initiatives and presenting analysis to a range of audiences, including managers and senior leaders.
Ability to focus on accuracy, definitions and analytical detail without losing sight of the broader business or service context.
Ability to approach problem-solving with professional judgment, confidentiality, tact and diplomacy.
Collaborative. Builds effective working relationships with technical, professional, operational and senior management staff across the City.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, projects and deadlines in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
Knowledge of Python, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Power Automate or similar analytics, automation or cloud data platforms is an asset

Required

Strong communicator, with the ability to tackle loosely defined problems with a solution oriented mindset.
Business writing skills as well as the ability to create technical documentation, communicating clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Passion & love for music.

Process Oriented

Title: Analyst, Rebates - Calgary or Saskatoon
Description:
Nutrien is a leading provider of crop inputs and services, and our business results make a positive impact on the world. Our purpose, Feeding the Future, is the reason we come to work each day. We’re guided by our culture of care and our core values: We put safety first. We act with integrity. We are stronger together. We deliver with excellence.

Through the collective expertise of our nearly 26,000 employees, we operate a world-class network of production, distribution, and ag retail facilities. We efficiently serve growers' needs and strive to provide a more profitable, sustainable, and secure future for all stakeholders.  Help us raise the expectation of what an agriculture company can be and grow your career with Nutrien. 

What You'll Do


Lead monthly reporting, quarterly forecasting, and strategic annual budgeting activities
Develop and maintain analytical models to deliver actionable insights on supplier profitability and rebate performance
Manage rebate programs in Segmentation/Vistex, including setup, maintenance, and product-level impact analysis
Ensure accurate data setup and integration across ERP, and rebate accrual systems
Support supplier contract lifecycle through financial analysis, negotiation input, implementation tracking, and redemption oversight
Serve as liaison between Vistex consultants and internal teams to ensure business requirements are clearly defined and delivered
Conduct financial modeling, sensitivity analysis, and business case evaluations to support strategic decisions and new business initiatives
Present financial analyses quantifying P&L impact and communicate key findings to stakeholders
Recommend and implement automated solutions to enhance regular business activities to ensure efficiency within tasks
Align with strategic supplier managers on new or changes in reporting requirements to deliver accurate analytical and performance rebate program metrics
Collaborate cross-functionally with Strategic Supplier Managers, FP&A, and other key stakeholders, working independently as needed


What You'll Bring


Bachelor’s Degree required, preferably in data sciences, finance, or economics. MBA a plus. Experience may be considered in lieu of a degree
3+ years of related experience required, preferably in Finance or Business Analysis
Demonstrate a high level of attention to detail and accuracy in your work
Excellent organization and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities
Understanding of business forecasting and analytics is required, with prior experience in vendor rebate analytics as a strong differentiator
Ideal candidate would have experience with FP&A, SAP, Vistex, reporting, analytics, and Excel modeling; however, candidates who offer a combination of several of these qualifications will be considered
Curiosity to find ways to create efficiencies to improve processes over time
Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills preferred
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, demonstrating initiative & problem solving
Strong written, presentation, and verbal communication skills; ability to effectively communicate at all levels of the organization


What You'll Get


Purpose-Driven Work – Make an impact as part of a global team feeding the future and support farmers locally and around the world
Excellent Benefits – Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, plus a retirement program with generous employer matching for your future
Grow Your Career – Tuition assistance for future education and ongoing learning and training opportunities for career advancement pathways across the organization
Support When it Matters – Employee Assistance Programs, inclusive leaves, and paid time for holidays, volunteering, vacation, and wellness
Thrive in a Strong Culture – Guided by our core values we put safety first, act with integrity, are stronger together, and deliver with excellence in a collaborative, high-performing environment


Ready to make an impact with us? Apply today!  

The estimated salary that Indeed, Glassdoor and LinkedIn lists does not represent Nutrien's compensation structure. Nutrien is an equal opportunity employer.  We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.  

This job will remain posted until filled. In accordance with Nutrien policies, you will be required to undergo a background check, and may be required to undergo a substance test. While we appreciate all applications we receive, only candidates under consideration will be contacted. Applicants must meet minimum age requirements, as permitted by law. 

Our Recruitment Process: Application > Resume Review > Pre-screen/Interview > Offer > Pre-Employment Conditions > Welcome to Nutrien 

To stay connected to us and for the latest job postings and news, follow us on:  LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.

Job Description

What is the Opportunity?

The Metadata/Data Lineage team is undertaking multiple complex enterprise-wide initiatives as part of RBC’s ongoing plan to improve data governance and data lineage management across the organization. In this role you will be responsible for strategically planning and managing successful implementation of data lineage extraction and documentation. The role will coordinate, develop, lead, communicate and execute activities to ensure objectives are accomplished on time.

What Will You Do?


Analyze, validate, and document data lineage from complex legacy systems across AML, Risk, Compliance, Finance, and Wealth Management
Design and execute SQL queries and Python scripts to extract data relationships and lineage information from undocumented or minimally documented legacy systems
Build and maintain reusable frameworks and tools that scale across multiple systems and departments
Research and prototype AI/agent-based approaches to automate data lineage discovery
Collaborate cross-functionally with business teams, data engineers, and platform teams to understand data flows and validate lineage
Work independently to identify blockers, develop solutions, and escalate issues appropriately
Perform data quality assessments and identify gaps or inconsistencies in lineage data
Document findings and approaches to help scale lineage discovery to other systems across the bank


What Do You Need to Succeed?

Must Have


3-5 years of data analysis, data engineering, or software development experience
Strong SQL and Python programming skills for data extraction, parsing, and tool development
Experience with regular expressions and Bash/Unix scripting for data manipulation
Demonstrated ability to learn new systems quickly, especially legacy or undocumented code
Internal locus of control: ability to identify and remove your own blockers and drive solutions independently


Nice to Have


Experience with AI/agent frameworks, LLMs, and multi-model LLM concepts (MCP)
Familiarity with mainframe systems, JCL, or other legacy enterprise systems
Experience with data modeling, schema design, or metadata management
GitHub Actions or CI/CD pipeline deployment experience


What’s in it for You?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.


A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable

Flexible work/life balance options
Opportunities to do challenging work

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Description

Primary Purpose

The Data Analyst Independently performs data analysis; document, recommend, and make process and

configuration changes to data functions and/or systems; and perform strategic data analysis to support

management. Requires in-depth and broad understanding of the company’s data configuration and

needs to analyze and resolve problems.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities


Create, run, and disseminate weekly and monthly reports as directed by stakeholders and team.
ERP support, testing and implementation including CPP
Warehouse Management System support & testing for warehouse
Excel support for store, management for stores and Home Office.
Corporate EDI support.
SharePoint support, update, & changes for Merchandising.
D-Com testing and support for data exchange between Compass and Ecommerce platforms.
Data integrity, hierarchy, maintenance.
At the direction of the department lead to identify, define, and document business needs and objectives, current operational procedures, problems, and system requirements.
Tracks and fully documents change for functional and business specifications; writes detailed universally understood procedures for permanent records and for use in training.
In collaboration and leadership of the department lead, plans, organizes, and conducts business process improvement.
Applies creative thinking in the development of business processes.
Participates in user testing of new system functionality.
Acquire subject matter expertise in the functions and activities of the various departments, including applicable laws, rules, regulations, procedures, and technical operations.
Provides technical assistance in training, mentoring, and coaching professional and technical staff.
Establish and maintain effective and cooperative working relationships.
Acts as a team lead on designated projects or assignments and may provide work direction to technical or clerical staff.


Other Duties And Responsibilities


Comprehensive knowledge of the products Country Supplier sells.
Perform daily cleaning – such as, but not limited to, vacuuming, replacing full trashes with new trash bags, and sweeping.
Other duties assigned as needed.


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in data analytics or similar field is preferred.
Two (2) years of experience in business process analysis, data base management, change management, and/or analytical or research projects preferred.
Experience with ERP systems and/or Epicor Software
Experience with presentation, spreadsheet, flow charting and work processing.
Understanding of methods of developing business and data process specification; procedures and testing of business functions within computer systems.
Effective project documentation skills including business functions, desk manuals, and configuration documentation.
Handle multiple and parallel projects concurrently.
Basis project management techniques, techniques for managing change.
Advanced Excel, MS Access, and application software knowledge
Exceptional time management and organizational skills
Ability to write logical, comprehensive, concise reports and correspondence.
Exceptional interpersonal skills
Ability to maintain a high degree of confidentiality.

Title: Analyst Statistician
Description:
Mandate

The Analyst/Statistician advances evidence based decision making across the university by collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data related to enrolment, student success, academic programs, operations, and strategic initiatives. The role leverages modern analytics tools—including Power BI and emerging AI driven technologies—to transform complex information into actionable insights. This position supports institutional planning, accreditation, assessment, and compliance reporting while collaborating with academic and administrative units to strengthen the university’s strategic capacity.

Objectives

This position strengthens the university’s ability to make informed, strategic decisions. By integrating advanced analytics, Power BI dashboards, and AI driven insights, the Analyst/Statistician helps shape academic planning, improve student outcomes, and ensure accountability to internal and external stakeholders.

This position requires a bachelor’s degree in education, Statistics, Social Sciences, Data Science, or a related field and 3 years related experience. An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may be considered.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Include


Strong analytical, problem solving, and communication skills.
Proficiency with statistical software (e.g., SAS, SPSS, R, Python) and database tools (e.g., SQL).
Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
Collaborative and independent work.
High level of attention to detail, clear documentation, and ability to work with sensitive information.
Experience with data visualization tools, including Power BI.
Predictive modeling, time series analysis, forecasting.
Familiarity with AI assisted analytics tools (e.g., natural language query features, automated insights, predictive modeling platforms) and the curation of results.


Preferred


Master’s degree in a relevant field.
Experience in higher education or institutional research, especially in the BC context.
Knowledge of student information systems (e.g., Banner).
Experience applying AI tools to data analysis, forecasting, or workflow automation.
Familiarity with accreditation standards and government reporting requirements.

Description:
MANTECH seeks a mission-driven and detail-oriented BI Suite Analyst to join our team in Oahu, Hawaii.

Develops and maintains interactive dashboards and reports that track key performance indicators and resource allocation.
Draft technical documentation for data processing workflows and standard operating procedures for BI tool usage.

Foundational training in knowledge management or project management.
Familiarity with USSOCOM data policies and the USINDOPACOM area of responsibility is preferred.

The person in this position must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time.

Title: Product Analyst / Data Analyst
Description:
Your Job

Flint Hills Resources is seeking a Product Analyst/Data Analyst to join our team in Wichita, KS. As an IT Product Analyst/Data Analyst, you will serve as a highly capable contributor who helps ensure strong delivery execution and continuity within the product team. You will play a critical role in translating product direction into high-quality delivery outcomes and in extending the team's impact across the broader technology ecosystem. This role is well-suited for someone ready to take accountability for delivery outcomes, influence how work gets done, and contribute meaningfully to business and technology objectives.

What You Will Do


Work closely with the business to understand problems at their root and drive solutions through technology — whether through your own development work or by collaborating across the business, software engineering, data architecture and solutions architecture.
Develop and maintain scripts, agents, and lightweight applications using tools like Python to automate processes, move data, and solve business problems.
Understand data models, system integrations, and application behavior to effectively translate business needs into sound technical approaches.
Analyze data, build reports and dashboards, and surface insights that inform product and business decisions — including understanding how application data and APIs translate into graph and analytical data models.
Own projects end-to-end — from problem statement through delivery and adoption — maintaining accountability for outcomes throughout.
Contribute to roadmap development, collaborating closely with product and business leadership to identify new features, enhancements, and incremental improvements aligned with product direction.
Continuously innovate and push the team forward — challenging the status quo, identifying opportunities to transform how work gets done, and raising the bar for those around you.



Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)


Experience in IT, data, software engineering, or a business role with demonstrated technical aptitude
A passion for or experience writing scripts, queries, or code (e.g., Python, JavaScript, SQL, AI agents, or equivalent) to solve problems, automate processes, or move and validate data
Experience working directly with business stakeholders to understand problems and translate them into technical solutions
Experience communicating technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences
This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship



What Will Put You Ahead


Experience with Cypher, graph databases, or data modeling
Experience with data engineering or API integrations — building pipelines, moving data, or connecting systems
Experience with cloud technologies, specifically AWS (e.g., SQS, CloudWatch, Lambda)
Experience with AI agents, LLMs, or prompt engineering
Experience with Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, data modeling, or analytics — including building reports, dashboards, or data products that inform business decisions
Experience in procurement, accounts payable, source-to-pay, or operations



At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

Hiring Philosophy

All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here.

Who We Are

As a Koch company, Flint Hills Resources is an industry-leading refining company making the oil and transportation products that keep the world moving. We make a large supply of fuel for gas stations and airports in addition to transporting crude oil, natural gas liquids and refined products through 4,000+ miles of pipeline – delivering energy to farmers, manufacturers and families. Our team champions innovation and excellence to help power modern life.

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

Our Benefits

Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter.

Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

Equal Opportunities

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except where prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. The Data Analytics Coordinator plays a supporting role as a steward of PRPA's data warehouses, from data ongestion through to the creation and maintenance of reports. Position Accountabilities


PRPA's primary data steward for all forms of data, including geospatial (GIS) data, which support day-to-day operations at PRPA.
Load data assets into PRPA’s data warehouses following best practices.
Support and maintain PRPA’s data warehouse.
Maintenance of reports and dashboards.
Training of PRPA staff in end user reporting tools available for accessing PRPA’s data.

Works predominantly in an office environment.
Regular, full-time position (37.5 hours per week). Regular working hours are Mondays to Fridays, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM with 1 hour unpaid lunch break.

Title: Master Data Analyst
Description:
*This position is not eligible for sponsorship




Data Analyst – Master Data & Enterprise Reporting

Location: La Crosse, WI – Kwik Trip Support Center (Onsite/Hybrid)

Job Type: Full‑time




About the Role

As a Data Analyst on Kwik Trip’s IT Data Services team, you will help ensure the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of the data that powers decision‑making across the company. You will develop and maintain SQL‑based data solutions, support enterprise reporting platforms, and implement master data management (MDM) processes that improve data quality and integrity. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex data challenges and collaborating across business units.




What You’ll Do

Support and manage Kwik Trip’s MDM tools (Informatica, SAS, and future platforms).
Build MDM jobs and pipelines that ingest, match, merge, and distribute data to downstream systems.
Develop and maintain complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and ETL processes.
Create and maintain ETL jobs using tools such as Microsoft SSIS, Informatica ETL, and SAS DataFlux.
Support enterprise reporting platforms including Power BI, SSRS, and Sigma.
Build dashboards and reports that provide clear, actionable insights to business partners.
Implement and manage MDM best‑record and matching processes to improve data quality.
Assist in creating and maintaining data dictionaries, data flow diagrams, and integration documentation.
Partner with software vendors to resolve issues, manage upgrades, and stay informed on future enhancements.
Serve as a subject matter expert for enterprise data and support business units with data‑related needs.




What We’re Looking For

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
At least two years of related professional experience.
Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases and enterprise software.
Ability to write complex queries and work with advanced database tools.
Experience troubleshooting ETL jobs, SQL procedures, and data integration issues.
Understanding of Master Data and Data Quality concepts.
Ability to develop data requirements and specifications.
Familiarity with version control and release management.
Strong problem‑solving, communication, and collaboration skills.




Even Better If You Have

Experience with SSIS and Azure Data Factory.
Experience with Informatica MDM, SAS DataFlux, or similar tools.
Experience creating dashboards in Power BI, SSRS, or Sigma.




Work Schedule

Monday through Friday, daytime hours.

Title: Pricing & Reporting Analyst
Description:
Adventure is our Culture. Join a team that celebrates a lifestyle as bold as the terrain we love. At Backcountry, we are rooted in adventure, recognition, and wellbeing on and off the mountain. We spotlight employee stories, celebrate milestones, and offer exclusive outdoor perks. Whether you are at HQ, in a retail store, or remote, you will be part of a team that thrives on energy, exploration, and connection.

Reports to: Sr. Pricing Analyst

Location: Cottonwood Heights, Utah (Hybrid - 3x/week in-office)

About The Role

The Merchandise Planning team needs a data-driven analyst to own the day-to-day mechanics of pricing across Backcountry's four banners—competitive pricing audits, markdown execution, MAP/MSRP compliance, and the reporting that powers pricing decisions.

As Pricing & Reporting Analyst, you will work directly with the Sr. Pricing Analyst to maximize profitability through smart pricing execution. By 6–12 months, you will be running pricing operations independently, regularly making recommendations that move sell-through, margin, or working capital, and serving as the team's go-to for AI-augmented workflows.

This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end-to-end responsibility.

About The Role


Pull pricing, margin, and sales data from the data warehouse for ad hoc analysis
Use AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) daily to write formulas, draft SQL, automate repetitive tasks, summarize results, and accelerate your own learning
Execute daily, weekly, and seasonal price changes across four banners, ensuring accuracy and on-time delivery
Monitor competitive pricing across key categories and partner brands; surface risks and opportunities to the Sr. Pricing Analyst and Buying teams
Track MAP and MSRP compliance across the assortment, flagging and correcting violations in a timely manner
Bring analytical judgment to pricing and strategy conversations—surface trends, audit outcomes, flag risks, and recommend pricing actions that improve sell-through, margin, or working capital
Build and maintain pricing reports and dashboards that Planning, Buying, and Marketing teams rely on
Document and improve pricing processes—turn one-off analyses into repeatable AI-powered workflows
Partner with Marketing on promotional pricing setup and post-promo recaps
Maintain a strong feedback loop with the Sr. Pricing Analyst on what is working, what is not, and where to push next


What You'll Do


Pull pricing, margin, and sales data from the data warehouse for ad hoc analysis
Use AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) daily to write formulas, draft SQL, automate repetitive tasks, summarize results, and accelerate your own learning
Execute daily, weekly, and seasonal price changes across four banners, ensuring accuracy and on-time delivery
Monitor competitive pricing across key categories and partner brands; surface risks and opportunities to the Sr. Pricing Analyst and Buying teams
Track MAP and MSRP compliance across the assortment, flagging and correcting violations in a timely manner
Bring analytical judgment to pricing and strategy conversations—surface trends, audit outcomes, flag risks, and recommend pricing actions that improve sell-through, margin, or working capital
Build and maintain pricing reports and dashboards that Planning, Buying, and Marketing teams rely on
Document and improve pricing processes—turn one-off analyses into repeatable AI-powered workflows
Partner with Marketing on promotional pricing setup and post-promo recaps
Maintain a strong feedback loop with the Sr. Pricing Analyst on what is working, what is not, and where to push next


Required Qualifications


3–5 years of analyst experience, preferably in retail, ecommerce, or a related data-driven role
Demonstrated daily use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini, or similar) for real work—you iterate on prompts, evaluate outputs critically, and know when AI is the right tool versus when it is not
High proficiency with Microsoft Excel (pivots, lookups, formulas) and a strong aptitude to learn technical applications quickly
Solid understanding of retail math (margin, markdown, sell-through, IMU) and financial concepts (GMROI, NPV, CM%)
Awareness of customer pricing behavior—anchoring, discount perception, and how merchandising and pricing decisions land on a product detail page
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work with messy datasets
Excellent attention to detail—pricing errors are expensive, and you treat that responsibility seriously
Excellent written and verbal communication; able to translate analysis into a clear, concise recommendation
Able to work both independently and collaboratively across Planning, Buying, Marketing, and Finance
Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Statistics, or a related field preferred; equivalent demonstrated experience considered
Passion for the outdoor industry and knowledge of outdoor gear is a plus.


Why Join

The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work.


Cross-Functional Impact: Your pricing work carries weight beyond the Pricing team—recommendations you make will shape decisions across Planning, Buying, Marketing, and Finance.
AI-First Skill Building: AI is a first-class tool here, not a buzzword. You will use Claude, Copilot, and similar tools daily and actively shape how the team adopts them.
Real Ownership: This role pairs tactical pricing execution with strategic contributions. You will report to an experienced Sr. Pricing Analyst with growth-focused mentorship and high visibility from day one.
Competitive Benefits: Paid time off policies, 401(k) match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.


Interview Process


Recruiter Screen - A 30-minute conversation with our recruiting team to align on the role, your background, and what you are looking for.
Hiring Manager Interview - Conversation with the Sr. Pricing Analyst focused on your analytical approach, pricing experience, and AI tool proficiency.
Take-Home Assignment - A pre-built test requiring high-level analysis, the use and documentation of AI as a working partner, and advanced communication skills to convey complex business recommendations.
In-Person Interview - We'd like to meet you at our Cottonwood Heights office. Details and logistics will be arranged with your recruiter.
Reference Checks - Conducted in parallel with the final stages where possible.
Offer - We move quickly for the right candidate.


Interview process is subject to change. Any updates will be communicated promptly and clearly.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
A growing organization is seeking an eCommerce Data Specialist to play a key role in modernizing its online eCommerce product ecosystem. This position will focus on transforming large, complex product datasets, designing scalable catalog structures, and improving the processes used to manage product information across digital sales channels.




This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys solving data challenges, streamlining workflows, and building a foundation for future ecommerce growth.




What You'll Do

Redesign and optimize product catalog structures for a modern commerce platform.
Analyze, cleanse, and standardize large volumes of product data.
Create efficient processes for data imports, updates, validation, and ongoing maintenance.
Work with technical teams to align product information, business rules, and system integrations.
Improve digital asset organization, including product imagery and supporting content.
Evaluate and automate manual processes where possible.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and usability across ecommerce systems.

What We're Looking For

Experience working with large-scale product catalogs or digital commerce data.
Strong understanding of product taxonomy, catalog organization, and data governance.
Experience with data conversion, migration projects, or systems modernization initiatives.
Familiarity with APIs, structured data formats, and data integration processes.
Ability to troubleshoot data quality issues and develop scalable solutions.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Experience

Product information management (PIM) systems.
ERP integrations and data synchronization.
Workflow automation or scripting experience.
High-volume product environments or highly configurable product offerings.
Digital asset management and ecommerce operations.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

Highly visible role with significant impact on business operations.
Opportunity to shape long-term data strategy and best practices.
Blend of technical problem-solving, process improvement, and business collaboration.
Stable organization investing in its digital commerce capabilities.

Candidates with experience improving product data quality, streamlining catalog operations, or supporting digital transformation initiatives are encouraged to apply.


• At least 2 years of experience working on ecommerce platform migration initiatives.
• Hands-on knowledge of BigCommerce catalog architecture and platform capabilities.
• Experience designing product taxonomies, catalog structures, and data mapping strategies for ecommerce environments.
• Proficiency with ETL concepts, SQL, JSON, and data import or synchronization processes.
• Working knowledge of APIs and experience supporting system integrations or migration tooling.
• Familiarity with Python, Node.js, or similar scripting languages used for transformation workflows.
• Experience managing digital asset preparation, including ecommerce image formatting and organization.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to resolve issues in inconsistent or poorly structured legacy data.

Title: Data Specialist
Description:
Role

The Data Specialist manages the credit union's data infrastructure, ensures the accuracy and accessibility of core and third-party data, and partners with departments across the organization to turn data into actionable insights that support member service and business decisions.

Major Duties And Responsibilities


Data Warehouse & Database Management: Manage the data warehouse solution; validate and reconcile data from core banking and third-party systems for accuracy and completeness. Administer SQL Server/database environment — updates, table management, indexing, performance tuning, and backup/recovery processes. Maintain data lineage and documentation so data sources, transformations, and definitions are traceable and auditable. Monitor data quality on an ongoing basis (not just at point of extract) using validation rules, exception reporting, and reconciliation checks
Dashboards & Reporting: Partner with management to design, build, and maintain data dashboards that support operational and strategic decision-making. Develop self-service reporting capabilities so departments can pull standard reports without ad hoc requests, freeing capacity for higher-value analysis
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the primary point of contact for data-driven requests and custom extracts from internal departments (Lending, Marketing, Compliance, Finance, etc.). Translate business questions into data requirements and deliver clear, actionable outputs. Provide basic data literacy support/training to help staff interpret and use dashboards and reports effectively
Emerging Responsibilities / Current Trends: Data governance: Support development and enforcement of data governance policies — data ownership, access controls, retention schedules, and standardized definitions across systems. Data security & privacy compliance: Ensure data handling practices align with GLBA, NCUA guidance, and other applicable member privacy/security regulations, including monitoring for unauthorized access and supporting audit/exam data requests. Cloud & integration management: Manage or support cloud-hosted data solutions and API-based integrations with fintech/third-party vendors, ensuring secure and reliable data flow
Carries out supplementary tasks aligned with the role and department objectives


Experience

Knowledge and Skills


Two to Five years of similar or related experience, including time spent in preparatory positions


EDUCATION/CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES


Microsoft SQL Certification, Associates Degree, College Degree


Interpersonal Skills


Work with third party data providers, management, and subject matter experts, developing data visualizations. Dialog is of technical nature that may require communicating abstract data relationships


Other Skills


Knowledge of technology programs utilized by the financial industry including but limited to JackHenry Symitar, Fiserv, Origence, Internet/Intranet applications, and Microsoft Office products. Has programming platform experience using Object Oriented Architecture, HTML, XML, SOAP, and REST api. Has database management skills with stored procedures, views, and SQL Server 2016 and above

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Location: This hybrid role requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

The Data Analyst delivers Power BI visualizations and dashboards that tell a story using data, drive action, and deliver value to the business. You work within a cross-functional product team, with support from product owners, business analysts, data engineers and data scientists where needed. You will also support the business in the transformation by contributing towards beginners’ sessions, drop-ins, and show-and-tell sessions demonstrating the capability of Power BI and wider visualization best practice.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver


Work with stakeholders and other data team colleagues to understand the data and insights needed to address business questions and challenges
Use visualization techniques to tell data stories, delivering insight to the business in a compelling way
Design and implement analytics reporting dashboards and visualizations using SQL and Power BI
Work with engineers to model, reshape and prepare data to optimize dashboard performance
Collaborate within the wider Data Team and Technology where required for the successful end-to-end delivery of the analytics solution
Work with business end-users to ensure the best user experience
Manage stakeholder expectations on analytical work by providing regular written and verbal communications, building trust, and forming close working relationships


Transform


Be a subject matter expert in visualization and Power BI
Continually improve your own knowledge, including participating in the Specsavers data visualization and storytelling training programme, and other training events
Share your knowledge with less experienced colleagues
Keep up to date on the latest analytics & visualization innovation, share ideas and highlight opportunities to adopt them
Encourage use of data visualization and storytelling in decision making


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst across the data lifecycle, from data modelling and transformation to visualization and analytics, leveraging SQL, Power BI, Databricks, and related tools.
Experience manipulating. transforming and cleansing data, and building compelling visualizations, ideally in Power BI
Experience delivering reports, dashboards, or visualization projects in a business context
Intermediate SQL for analytics
Able to convey complex concepts to non-technical audiences in a succinct and accessible way
A collaborative approach to working, with good relationship building skills
Capability in DAX, Power Query or equivalent


Nice-to-have


Experience working with stakeholders to refine requirements and design outputs
Mentoring or coaching experience
Experience in Python or PySpark
Experience working in any capacity in retail or ecommerce, marketing, supply chain, healthcare or other regulated environments such as telco, financial services and utilities.


Compensation: $80,000 - $95,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Specsavers, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enriches our work environment and enables us to achieve our goals. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you believe you can contribute to our mission and vision, we welcome your application, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We value the unique skills and perspectives each individual brings to our team.

Accessibility and Accommodations

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by contacting us at careers.ca@specsavers.com . We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience.

Support team and senior leadership with ad-hoc reports.
Produce daily, weekly, and monthly reports.

OTA Management

Experience with Opera (PMS and S&C) and Passkey GroupMax is highly preferred

Title: Operations Systems Analyst
Description:
The Operations Systems Analyst will assist in tactically driving applications to evolve and enhance Click Bond’s business decision making capabilities. This role will support the identification, research, troubleshooting, and resolution of technical issues as it relates to database management, data conveyance mechanisms, graphical representation, and AI/Automation processes as well as applications. This role will support and work closely with all functional departments of Click Bond.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities


Responsible for examining and diagnosing trends and optimizing manufacturing processes to improve efficiency and productivity. This involves conducting data analysis, identifying areas for improvement, and implementing strategies to enhance overall operations.
Develop and create AI/Automation tools to support Click Bonds initiative.
Develop and create dashboards and reporting tools to support team members.
Participate in the development of new methods utilizing data to improve manufacturing processes and outcomes.
Propose process enhancements through data analysis.
Assist in developing and maintaining manufacturing measures, and metrics and apply Lean principles where applicable.
Conduct training on various manufacturing-related tasks.
Learn Click Bond manufacturing processes to better understand data outputs.
Will comply with and meets or exceeds requirements of Click Bond’s Quality and Environmental Management System (QEMS), AS9100, ISO14001, and 27001.
Tasked with the collection of stakeholder requirements, the orchestration of meetings, and the advancement of collaborative efforts in line with the industry’s recognized project management best practices.
Report immediately all suspicious and hazardous conditions to a supervisor.
Understand and observe all safety guidelines and assure quality and safety by complying with all appropriate Click Bond policies and procedures.
Assist in maintaining clean, orderly, and hazard-free work areas.
Able to work with minimal supervision, be a self-starter and be detail oriented.
Other duties as assigned.


Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to demonstrate the following competencies:


Strong analytical skills with attention to detail.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Experience building dashboards, using measures, and metrics.
Skillful at reading, writing and interpreting documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
Demonstrated ability to present business solutions to executive teams.
Proficient in AI/Automation tools (i.e. – CoPilot Studio, Power Automate, Python, HTML coding).
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Power BI).
Ability to utilize reports, accounting database applications, and MRP/ERP software.
Solid understanding of data structures, relational database, and MRP/ERP systems.
Strong SQL skills and understanding of data warehousing techniques.
Ability to collect business requirements and develop effective reports and dashboards. Additional requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.
Ability to write and read English.


Education And/Or Experience


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science Field or 3+ years’ experience in a related field.
EPICOR experience is a plus but not required.


Supervisory Responsibilities


This is not a supervisory position.


PHYSICAL DEMANDS: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


The work is primarily sedentary, although there may be some walking, standing, bending, and carrying of items, such as paper or books, weighing less than 10 pounds.


Work Environment


Work primarily performed in a standard office environment. If in manufacturing areas, may be exposed to noise, smells, heat, dust, etc.
Work requires the observance of fire regulations and safe work practices.


Click Bond Way – Key Attributes


Communicates respectfully to all team members, vendors, and visitors.
Models a positive attitude.
Actively listens to others and supports the team environment.
Asks questions and learns from mistakes.
Executes tasks with minimal errors in a timely and efficient manner.
Attendance is consistent and meets or exceeds company standards.

Title: Corporate Advanced Analyst I
Description:
Employment Type

Full-time

Exempt or Non-Exempt

Exempt

Job Summary


Hybrid Work Environment - Must reside on Oahu**



Pay Range: $59,000 - $116,000

Note: Individuals typically begin between the minimum to middle of the pay range

Works independently with internal and external customers to clearly articulate and define business problem(s) to be solved; reviews data sources and preps needed data; performs required analysis; applies accepted statistical methodologies where applicable; documents the process that was followed and data sources/tools used; ensures results have been validated (statistically, if necessary); and prepares/presents findings that are informative and audience appropriate to drive decision making across various levels of the organization.

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree and four years of related experience or two years of Healthcare Analytics experience; or an equivalent combination of education and related work experience.
Strong oral and written communicate skills.
Strong understanding of data (types, content reliability, etc.).
Strong problem solving and data collection, analysis, and interpretation.
Strong understanding/use of dashboards, data visualization tools, and advanced and custom graphics.
Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office applications. Including but not limited to Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Outlook.
Proficiency with OLAP tools and databases.
Knowledge of one or more of the following: SQL, R or SAS/SPSS



Duties And Responsibilities


Data Management:
Reviews data sources and preps needed data.
Identifies existing and new data sources.
Performs data prototyping, if necessary, to agree what data can/not be used.
Preps data for use in analysis, goes back to source if problems are found, and identifies other options/alternatives if problems cannot be resolved.
Performs review of data to ensure completeness/accuracy/timeliness for the purpose of the analysis.
Ensures existing, approved, corporate tools used can accept/integrate the data.
Where necessary (and if practical to be done within the delivery timeframe of a project), facilitates the identification and use of new tools and works with the Technical Review Committee to authorize its use.
Analytics and Technical Acumen:
Performs required analysis, applies accepted statistical methodologies where applicable, and documents the process that was followed and data sources/tools used.
Determines what kind of analytics will be performed (descriptive, predictive, prescriptive) and defines/documents overall framework.
Where appropriate, applies linear regression (correlation, contingency table, ANOVA, inference, chi-square, t-test) and/or time series methods (data set-up, conversions, trends, decomposition, models, forecasts, confidence).
Utilizes appropriate tools to load, integrate, and analyze data.
Conducts analysis and documents findings, identifies unexpected anomalies and root cause (if possible) and determines if analysis can continue, identifies alternatives if anomalies cannot be resolved
Ensures reproducibility of outcomes.
Documents entire analysis process, including business problem, data sources, methods and tools used, project reference, and outcomes.
Implements pre-emptive actions, where possible.
Project Definition and Coordination:
Lead meetings with internal and external customers to clearly articulate and define business problem(s) of medium/high complexity and impact (department/function specific, external customer centric, or part of a corporate project).
Types of projects include descriptive and predictive analytics.
Applies a whole company perspective, draws upon previous knowledge and experience, and -- where necessary -- researches new/other approaches to identify and agree upon objectives, approach, and success measures.
Works with customer to submit appropriate paperwork (ISS, TPDR, etc.) and ensures necessary agreements are in place for external customers.
Defines delivery milestones and negotiates timeframes, monitors progress, and periodically notifies customer of status.
Effective Communication:
Works primarily with department heads or function leads to prepare/present findings that are informative and audience appropriate
Reviews findings and outcomes with customer, ensures business problem/objectives have been met, and prepares documentation of the analysis
Where necessary, manage divergent views in the audience and advises the internal/external customer on any recommendations or options that will facilitate data and analysis driven decision making.
Prepares a presentation of the analysis, process followed, and reviews it with the customer to ensure the results are audience appropriate.
Performs all other miscellaneous responsibilities and duties as assigned or directed.
Trains others on MicroStrategy and Excel.
Functions as a team player within the department and embodies collaboration.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
The Data Analyst is the single point of accountability for the accuracy, integrity, and consistency of Allied Business Solutions' core business data across our ERP, CRM, and PSA platforms. This is a hands-on, technical role focused on keeping data clean, aligned, and trustworthy as it moves between systems — through disciplined data standards, active auditing, direct ownership of integrations and data synchronization, and targeted automation that eliminates manual entry and enforces quality. The Data Analyst ensures that every department works from a single, reliable source of truth, and provides reporting that turns well-governed data into usable insight for sales, service, and finance.




Key Responsibilities:




Cross-System Data Stewardship & Integrity

Serve as the single point of accountability for data accuracy, completeness, and consistency across the ERP, CRM, PSA, and related business systems.
Establish and enforce data standards, naming conventions, and entry rules so records remain consistent across systems and users.
Perform regular audits to identify and resolve errors, duplicates, gaps, and cross-system mismatches.
Own master and reference data (customers, products, pricing, equipment) so a single source of truth is reflected consistently everywhere it appears.
Maintain data dictionaries and documentation covering field definitions, ownership, and standards.

Data Integration & Synchronization

Own the flow and synchronization of data between the ERP, CRM, PSA, and other platforms, ensuring records stay aligned across all systems.
Write and maintain SQL queries to validate, extract, and reconcile data.
Build and maintain API-based integrations; troubleshoot sync failures and drive root-cause resolution with vendors or internal stakeholders.
Monitor integration health and proactively catch and correct data drift before it reaches downstream teams.

Automation for Data Quality & CRM Workflows

Design, build, and maintain automated routines that reduce manual entry and enforce data quality — deduplication, validation, reconciliation, and exception alerting.
Build and maintain CRM workflow automations that streamline sales and service processes and keep records current.
Document automations and adapt them as business needs evolve.

Product, Pricing & Proposal Data

Maintain accurate product records, configurations, and pricing across systems.
Keep proposal templates and pricing data current so quotes and proposals generate from clean, correct source data.

Lease & Asset Data Reconciliation

Maintain lease and asset records and reconcile them against related data across systems for consistency.
Monitor key dates — renewals, expirations, and term changes — and flag them to the appropriate stakeholders.

Reporting & Data Support

Generate routine and ad hoc reports to support the sales, service, and finance teams.
Support cross-departmental data requests and help translate data into usable insight.
Identify opportunities to improve data workflows, accuracy, and reporting efficiency.




Qualifications:




Required

Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Proven experience managing data across CRM, ERP, PSA, or comparable business systems.
Hands-on SQL skills for querying, validation, and reconciliation.
Experience building and maintaining integrations (APIs) and troubleshooting data-sync issues.
Experience with process automation.
Strong attention to detail and a high standard for data accuracy.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and comfort working with large datasets.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

Preferred

Familiarity with data governance and master data management practices.
Experience with data reporting and visualization/dashboarding tools.
Familiarity with lease or asset tracking systems.
Scripting for automation (e.g., Python or PowerShell) or experience with low-code automation platforms.
Background in the managed IT, technology, or copier/print industry.

Competencies

Ownership and accountability for data integrity
Problem-solving and analytical thinking
Technical aptitude and adaptability
Clear written and verbal communication
Dependability and follow-through
Collaboration across teams

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
NFI Parts™ is North America's most comprehensive organization providing parts, technical publications, training, and support for buses and motor coaches. NFI Parts is the parts division of NFI Group, providing replacement parts for New Flyer® transit buses, MCI® motor coaches, ADL buses, ARBOC® vehicles, as well as the product lines for the acquired NABI and Orion parts businesses. Additionally, NFI Parts has extensive cross references for parts that are common with other bus, coach, and cutaway product lines and has a mature supply base and established relationships with over 1,000 suppliers. Further information is available at www.nfi.parts.

POSITION GOAL:

Support a critical initiative aimed at eliminating part identification inconsistencies, incorrect cross references, and outdated product information that result in lost sales opportunities and customer confusion. This role is responsible for cleaning, managing, and maintaining the integrity of parts data across systems - ensuring accuracy, standardization, and usability for both internal teams and customers.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

Initial Data Clean-Up


Audit and correct part naming conventions across multiple data sources
Re-establish and validate product relationships, including obsolete parts, alternates, supersessions, kits, and subcomponents
Standardize and validate cross-reference data, including OEM and vendor cross references
Identify and remove redundant, outdated, or unreliable written notes that hinder searchability
Ensure significant product data is accurately displayed in the e-commerce platform
Review, revise, or remove attachments (customer documents, photos, PDFs, drawings) to ensure accuracy and relevance
Reclassify parts into correct Category/Set/Class structures to improve catalog consistency ensuring new structure is communicated to Pricing Dept


Ongoing Data Management


Monitor and resolve data discrepancies in real time, ensuring alignment between ERP, catalog, and e-commerce systems.
Ensure all product relationships remain accurate, including replacements, alternates, and component groupings.
Revise customer-facing attachments and information to support correct and current product details.
Collaborate with Engineering, Product Management, Procurement, Customer Service, and Business Systems to ensure data accuracy across all platforms
Maintain detailed documentation of data changes, rules, and governance standards


Process Improvement & Governance


Design and document scalable data governance workflows to support long-term data integrity.
Recommend system enhancements to improve product data handling, visibility, and consistency.
Contribute to continuous improvement efforts to enhance catalog searchability, product accuracy, and customer digital experience.


Requirements


Education in Data Science, Statistics, or Business Analytics
Understanding of catalog data, cross-referencing, and product identification
Experience with ERP systems and product data management environments
Experience with data governance, process improvement, or LEAN methodologies
Proficiency with data management tools (e.g., SQL, Python, Excel Advanced functions, data cleansing utilities) and ERP reporting functionality
Familiarity with e-commerce or digital product content management systems
Analytical mindset with strong attention to detail and the ability to identify and correct data inconsistencies
Ability to work independently and take full ownership of data quality objectives
Strong communication and documentation skills
Knowledge of cataloging practices and historical data structures
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage large data sets and complex information structures
Problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills in data-related workflows
Ability to develop and document data standards and governance rules
Strong aptitude for identifying patterns, anomalies, and process inefficiencies within large data repositories
Ability to collaborate effectively across departments and communicate technical concepts clearly


Benefits

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM:


Competitive Wages
A continuous learning environment
Ability to advance your career with a growing company
NFI Group has been named a Manitoba Top Employer for 2020 and this is the tenth since the competition was established in 2007
Employee social committee organizes numerous events throughout the year, including summer barbecues, holiday festivities, sporting events and tournaments, and much more
Ongoing employee development through a variety of in-house training initiatives along with tuition subsidies for courses at outside institutions

We exist to move people. Our mission is to design and deliver exceptional transportation solutions that are safe, accessible, efficient and reliable.

Title: Reporting Analyst
