Post-secondary education in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Actuarial Science, Business Analytics, or a related discipline; equivalent experience will also be considered.
3–5 years of experience in underwriting, insurance, group benefits, financial analysis, or a similar analytical role.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, advanced formulas, data analysis, and data clean up techniques.
Experience using Power Query to transform, validate, and automate data processes.
Experience with VBA or other automation tools is considered a strong asset.
Demonstrated experience working with large datasets and producing insightful reports, analyses, and recommendations.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
Ability to interpret complex data and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
Effective verbal and written communication skills.
Strong collaboration and teamwork skills, including the ability to work across departments and with external partners.
Knowledge of group benefits, underwriting principles, and/or the insurance industry is an asset.
GBA designation or progress toward a professional industry designation is an asset.

Learn by working alongside our experts
Extended health care and dental benefits

A suite of Health & Wellness offerings
Mental Health programs and support for you and your family
Competitive compensation

Title: Staff Analytics Analyst, Full Stack (Revenue)
Description:
Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

About The Team

We’re looking for an experienced, highly independent analytics engineer to join our Revenue Analytics team. This team owns the data products, reporting infrastructure, semantic foundations, and analytical systems that support Affirm’s Revenue organization.

About The Role

In this role, you will lead the development of scalable, trusted data products for Affirm’s revenue teams. You turn ambiguous business and technical problems into scalable solutions across data modeling, metrics, dashboards, automation, governance, and AI enablement. You will help set the technical direction for Revenue’s data layer, establish the semantic and metadata foundations required for AI, and raise the quality and impact of data across the Revenue organization.

What You’ll Do


Lead high-impact data product initiatives for Revenue, from ambiguous problem definition through technical design, implementation, rollout, and adoption.
Advance AI initiatives within the Revenue data ecosystem by identifying high-value use cases, integrating AI into analytics engineering workflows, and establishing the semantic, metadata, context, quality, and evaluation foundations required for AI.
Design and build durable, well-tested data products that power revenue operations, field and executive reporting, external merchant reporting, and analyst self-service.
Set technical direction for Revenue’s data layer across dbt models, metrics, semantic structures, documentation, lineage, testing, governance, and access controls.
Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and scale Revenue Analytics through improved data architecture, tooling, governance, and enablement.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to analysts and cross-functional partners, raising the bar for how data products are designed, built, and maintained.


What We Look For


7+ years of experience in analytics engineering, business intelligence, data engineering, data product development, or a related technical analytics role.
Deep expertise in SQL, dbt, data modeling, metrics design, data quality, documentation, and modern analytics engineering practices.
Strong working knowledge of BI tools such as Sigma, Looker, or Tableau, cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, and modern data platforms such as Databricks.
Strong understanding of the foundations required for reliable AI—including semantic layers, metadata, evaluations, documentation, lineage, access controls, and data quality—and experience applying AI tools within analytics engineering workflows.
Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, ambiguous projects by defining scope, sequencing work, managing tradeoffs, aligning stakeholders, and delivering durable technical solutions.
Experience designing scalable data products for multiple audiences and influencing technical and non-technical stakeholders around architecture and product direction.
Familiarity with Salesforce and experience supporting commercial, GTM, revenue, or sales operations teams.


Pay Grade - O

Equity Grade - 6

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

CAN base pay range per year: $173,000 - $233,000

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently seeking a Pricing Analyst to join our Marketing Team in Vancouver, Calgary, or Toronto.

What your team does:

The Monetization team leads Clio’s AI-first pricing and packaging strategy and execution across all regions, including initiatives for new and existing customer segments, products, plans, bundles and cross-portfolio upgrades. This is a highly strategic team contributing to Clio’s success in a highly cross functional role working across nearly all functions at Clio.

Who you are:

You're analytical and curious about customer behaviour, comfortable working through large volumes of data to find the story in the numbers. You like turning ad hoc, manual processes into something repeatable, and you enjoy building partnerships across the business. You're also detail-oriented, organized, and self-managing, with a habit of verifying your own work. You build in checks, flag what looks off, and hold a high bar for accuracy.

What you’ll work on:

As a Pricing Analyst, you'll own the execution and measurement of pricing changes, from account migrations in our billing systems and Salesforce to the modeling, reporting, and testing that tell us whether a change worked.


Own recurring price-based account migrations end to end, from cohort segmentation and batch processing through QA and post-migration validation, and build the formula-driven templates that make them repeatable and auditable at scale
Support the models that price new releases and size the impact of changes on existing customers, and help package the findings into recommendations
Partner with Data & Insights to build the dashboards and automated reporting that track realized vs. list price, discount depth, and ARPA by cohort, so the team catches problems early
Work across Billing Ops, Sales Ops, CS Ops, and Enablement to automate the manual steps in pricing execution and equip Sales and CS when prices change
Help design and run in-market price tests to validate willingness to pay before changes roll out broadly
Use AI tooling to compress the analysis and execution cycle, from generating and QA'ing migration cohorts to automating the handoff into Salesforce and building intuitive internal pricing calculators and price sheets


What you may have:


2+ years in financial or business analysis and modeling, preferably for B2B SaaS, including heavy spreadsheet work with nested logic and QA across large datasets
Hands-on experience in a subscription billing system (Zuora, Stripe, Chargebee, or similar) and a CRM like Salesforce, including bulk updates and data validation across large account sets
2+ years building dashboards and queries in Looker, Tableau, or similar
Experience with pricing analysis across SaaS charge models, such as subscription, usage-based, tiered, and per-seat
Experience running cross-functional projects in Asana or similar, coordinating with ops and GTM teams to keep work moving
Strong communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear status updates, business insights, and recommendations in written, presentation, and spoken form
Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to support analysis, workflows, and day-to-day productivity


Serious bonus points if you have:


Experience with Workato or similar integration and task-automation tools
Prior experience executing pricing or plan migrations at scale


This role is a backfill for an existing position.

What you will find here:

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:


Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.
Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
$2000 annual counseling benefit
RRSP matching and RESP contribution
Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years


The expected salary range for this role is $97,300 to $131,700 CAD. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.

Our team shows up as their authentic selves, and are united by our mission. We are dedicated to diversity, equity and inclusion. Title: Data Business Analyst
Description:
Location: This is a hybrid role that requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

As a Data Business Analyst, you'll be responsible for eliciting requirements and shaping solutions to business problems across the full reporting lifecycle — from requirements gathering through to delivery of reports and dashboards. You'll work within an Agile framework, acting as the conduit between the business, and our Data Engineers and Visualization Analysts.

Key Responsibilities


Gather and define detailed project requirements from across the Canadian business for data reporting products
Own the end-to-end reporting lifecycle, from requirements gathering, to solution design, build support, user acceptance testing, and deployment
Run workshops, interviews, and prototyping sessions to capture and refine requirements — including situations where requirements are unclear or priorities are shifting
Define and document data mappings, and end-to-end data flows
Support data governance, data quality, and master data management initiatives
Produce Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria
Partner with Data Visualization Analysts to support the delivery of Power BI and self-service analytics solutions, ensuring outputs are intuitive, well-documented and accessible to business users
Ensure requirements are complete, consistent, concise, and verifiable — and traceable back to a genuine business need.
Provide input into new products and feature designs so that reporting and analytics needs are considered from the outset, not bolted on afterward
Manage scope changes and requirements during implementation
Partner with the Product Owner to refine and size the backlog
Maintain oversight of delivery, including scope, timelines, dependencies and expected outcomes
Proactively identify risks, blockers and potential delays, driving mitigation and escalation where required
Define acceptance criteria (Definition of Ready / Definition of Done) and support test planning and UAT


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years' experience as a Business Analyst, ideally on data or reporting products.
Demonstrated experience across the full reporting lifecycle (requirements through deployment)
Experience writing technical user stories and documentation
Ability to understand database schemas, including the relationships between objects and key terminology
Experience gathering requirements from diverse, sometimes non-technical stakeholders, including in situations with unclear requirements or changing priorities
Data profiling experience, including querying and profiling data using SQL
Exposure to a cloud data platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Experience working within an Agile delivery methodology
Excellent communication skills — confident liaising with stakeholders at all levels, able to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences
Sound analytical thinking, problem-solving, and negotiation skills
Self-motivated and comfortable working autonomously, while collaborating closely with the other Data Business Analysts

Nice-to-have


Experience in a retail environment.
Technical data skills: Power BI or other visualization tools
Experience in data visualisation techniques and principles
Awareness of the use of AI to support in the Data BA space


Compensation: $95,000 - $115,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Specsavers, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enriches our work environment and enables us to achieve our goals. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you believe you can contribute to our mission and vision, we welcome your application, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We value the unique skills and perspectives each individual brings to our team.

Accessibility and Accommodations

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by contacting us at careers.ca@specsavers.com . We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience.

Title: Analyst, Offer Management & Optimization
Description:
This position requires in-person collaboration up to five days a week. This arrangement is subject to change based on business requirements.

Why WestJet

Since our story took off in 1996, WestJet has strived to enrich the lives of everyone in our world; a career with us is no exception. We’re proud to be one of Canada’s most admired and respected corporate cultures and continuously aim for the highest standards of service and success.

Join us, this is where your career story takes off.

Overview Of Role

As the Analyst, Offer Management & Optimization, you will tackle the complex puzzle of airline pricing by bringing WestJet's Offer Management strategy to life through data-driven execution. This role is focused on actively optimizing fares, designing dynamic bundles, and leveraging large datasets to test and deploy modern offer strategies.

Acting as a critical bridge between Commercial and Technology teams, working alongside Pricing, Revenue Management, Digital, Distribution, and external technology partners, you will ensure WestJet delivers innovative retailing capabilities that directly boost revenue and elevate guest value.

Key Responsibilities

Offer Execution & Optimization


Support the evolution and daily execution of WestJet's Offer Management capabilities across:
Fare price optimization
Ancillary price optimization
Dynamic bundle generation
Offer optimization and decisioning
Commercial experimentation and testing
Offer governance and configuration
Collaborate closely with Pricing and Revenue Management teams to ensure pricing strategies are effectively executed through Offer Management tools.


Cross-Functional Delivery


Manage day-to-day technical workflows with internal teams and external vendors, using tools like Postman to validate API requests, troubleshoot integrations, and ensure seamless offer delivery.
Participate in the business delivery of new capabilities by working with stakeholders across the organization including Pricing, Revenue Management, Distribution, Digital, Commercial Technology, Finance, and the Contact Centre.
Gather and document business requirements, coordinate testing, and assist with change management and release readiness to ensure successful implementations


Performance Management


Monitor product performance, build queries, and identify optimization opportunities by tracking key commercial metrics, including:
Revenue uplift
Conversion rates
Ancillary attachment
Bundle performance
Pricing effectiveness
Customer adoption
Provide regular reporting, dashboards, and actionable recommendations to leadership


Experience And Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline
2–4 years of experience in data analytics, airline commercial strategy, pricing, revenue management, product management, or distribution
Experience supporting complex technology or commercial transformation initiatives
Demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional stakeholders and external vendors
Understanding of airline pricing and revenue management principles
Familiarity with Offer Management and Pricing Optimization concepts
Knowledge of airline retailing and distribution
Strong commercial and analytical mindset with proficiency in analyzing performance data
Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights
Strong hands-on experience querying large relational databases using SQL on cloud platforms like Snowflake, and visualizing data in tools like Tableau or PowerBI
Familiarity with API testing and validation (e.g., using Postman) to support technical troubleshooting and vendor integrations is an asset


The Benefits Of Being a WestJetter

WestJet provides all WestJetters with a competitive total rewards package. On top of that, we offer:


A fun and friendly culture with colleagues who work together to win
Travel privileges for you and your family, effective from your start date
Savings and Benefit programs that are flexible to meet your specific needs


Think we’re a great fit? Apply now!

About WestJet Group Of Companies

WestJet took to the skies in 1996 with just over 200 employees and three aircraft operating service to five destinations. Since then, WestJet has pioneered low-cost travel in Canada, cutting airfares in half, and increasing the flying population in Canada by more than 50 per cent. Since the Sunwing Airlines integration in 2025, more than 15,000 WestJetters support nearly 200 aircraft and connect guests to our global network of more than 100 destinations across North America, Central America, the Caribbean, Europe and Asia. The WestJet Group is a major Canadian employer and includes WestJet Airlines, WestJet Encore and Sunwing Vacations Group. We’re Canada’s leading value airline and largest vacation provider, with a united purpose of providing affordable and accessible air and vacation travel to Canadians.

Our safety promise

At WestJet, the safety and security of our people and our guests is a core value and at the heart of what we do. Safety and security are shared responsibilities all team members are expected to use safe work practices to ensure their well-being and the safety of others. Acting as a critical bridge between Commercial and Technology teams, working alongside Pricing, Revenue Management, Digital, Distribution, and external technology partners, you will ensure WestJet delivers innovative retailing capabilities that directly boost revenue and elevate guest value.

Key Responsibilities

Offer Execution & Optimization

  • Support the evolution and daily execution of WestJet's Offer Management capabilities across:
  • Fare price optimization
  • Ancillary price optimization
  • Dynamic bundle generation
  • Offer optimization and decisioning
  • Commercial experimentation and testing
  • Offer governance and configuration
  • Collaborate closely with Pricing and Revenue Management teams to ensure pricing strategies are effectively executed through Offer Management tools.

Cross-Functional Delivery

  • Manage day-to-day technical workflows with internal teams and external vendors, using tools like Postman to validate API requests, troubleshoot integrations, and ensure seamless offer delivery.
  • Participate in the business delivery of new capabilities by working with stakeholders across the organization including Pricing, Revenue Management, Distribution, Digital, Commercial Technology, Finance, and the Contact Centre.
  • Gather and document business requirements, coordinate testing, and assist with change management and release readiness to ensure successful implementations

Performance Management

  • Monitor product performance, build queries, and identify optimization opportunities by tracking key commercial metrics, including:
  • Revenue uplift
  • Conversion rates
  • Ancillary attachment
  • Bundle performance
  • Pricing effectiveness
  • Customer adoption
  • Provide regular reporting, dashboards, and actionable recommendations to leadership

Experience And Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline
  • 2–4 years of experience in data analytics, airline commercial strategy, pricing, revenue management, product management, or distribution
  • Experience supporting complex technology or commercial transformation initiatives
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional stakeholders and external vendors
  • Understanding of airline pricing and revenue management principles
  • Familiarity with Offer Management and Pricing Optimization concepts
  • Knowledge of airline retailing and distribution
  • Strong commercial and analytical mindset with proficiency in analyzing performance data
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights
  • Strong hands-on experience querying large relational databases using SQL on cloud platforms like Snowflake, and visualizing data in tools like Tableau or PowerBI
  • Familiarity with API testing and validation (e.g., using Postman) to support technical troubleshooting and vendor integrations is an asset

The Benefits Of Being a WestJetter

WestJet provides all WestJetters with a competitive total rewards package. On top of that, we offer:

  • A fun and friendly culture with colleagues who work together to win
  • Travel privileges for you and your family, effective from your start date
  • Savings and Benefit programs that are flexible to meet your specific needs

Think we’re a great fit? Apply now!

About WestJet Group Of Companies

WestJet took to the skies in 1996 with just over 200 employees and three aircraft operating service to five destinations. Since then, WestJet has pioneered low-cost travel in Canada, cutting airfares in half, and increasing the flying population in Canada by more than 50 per cent. Since the Sunwing Airlines integration in 2025, more than 15,000 WestJetters support nearly 200 aircraft and connect guests to our global network of more than 100 destinations across North America, Central America, the Caribbean, Europe and Asia. The WestJet Group is a major Canadian employer and includes WestJet Airlines, WestJet Encore and Sunwing Vacations Group. We’re Canada’s leading value airline and largest vacation provider, with a united purpose of providing affordable and accessible air and vacation travel to Canadians.

Our safety promise

At WestJet, the safety and security of our people and our guests is a core value and at the heart of what we do. Safety and security are shared responsibilities all team members are expected to use safe work practices to ensure their well-being and the safety of others. WestJet recognizes that the use of Alcohol and Drugs can adversely impact a safe work environment and the well-being of others including guests, suppliers and the public, as well as place WestJet's operations at risk. All roles that are identified as Safey-Sensitive are required to pass a Pre-Employment Alcohol and Drug Test as per WestJet's Alcohol and Drug Policy. 

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We embrace what makes each of us unique, and what makes us uniquely WestJet. We welcome diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds so if you're passionate about this role, we encourage you to apply – even if you don't meet every qualification listed. WestJet is committed to inclusiveness, equity and accessibility throughout the selection process. If you require accommodation at any stage, please contact our Talent Acquisition team at talent@westjet.com.

We value the time and effort you put into your application. Our recruitment process is highly competitive and while every applicant will receive communication regarding their application status, only those selected to move forward will be contacted with next steps. If this role isn’t the right fit, we encourage you to explore future opportunities with us.

Title: Continuous Improvement Specialist
Description:
The Continuous Improvement Specialist bridges the gap between operational data and real-world execution. This role is responsible for analyzing courier, customer, and partner performance data to uncover hidden inefficiencies, designing structured "test and learn" pilots, and validating proof-of-concepts before they are scaled across global markets. The ideal candidate thrives on turning complex data into actionable recommendations and running live experiments in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. Ultimately, this role is critical to optimizing our global logistics footprint, directly impacting courier satisfaction, cost efficiency, and customer loyalty.

Key Responsibilities


Data Analysis & Opportunity Identification
Analyze operational performance data and key performance indicators (including courier utilization, complaints, and delivery reliability) to identify trends, bottlenecks, and service risks.
Quantify and articulate specific areas of opportunity across courier experience and support touchpoints.
Partner with data teams to enhance dashboards and reports (utilizing tools like Tableau or SQL) to back all improvement initiatives with hard data.
Lead process improvement initiatives focused on service quality, operational efficiency, capacity utilization, and cost reduction.
Facilitate process mapping, root cause analysis, Kaizen events, and problem-solving workshops.
Pilot Execution & Experimentation
Develop and deliver continuous improvement initiatives across all courier experience and courier support touchpoints, ensuring cohesive plans, ongoing measurement and impact to couriers and team members
Adopt a strict "test and learn" culture by designing, launching, and managing live pilots to continuously experiment with operational hypotheses.
Drive a globalised and aligned approach while adapting for local needs
Establish clear success metrics for pilots to quickly determine feasibility for scaling across various markets.
Monitor, validate, and report on the realized benefits, cost-effectiveness, and productivity impacts of all implemented pilot programs.
Stakeholder Engagement & Scaling
Collaborate closely with operations leaders, market teams, and global functions to ensure pilots align with business priorities and local regulations.
Clearly present data-driven insights, pilot proposals, and project milestones to key stakeholders and management.
Develop current and future-state process documentation to ensure a seamless handoff to Operations, Training and QA teams when a pilot is approved for scaling.

Qualifications & Competencies


Experience: 3–4 years of experience in continuous improvement, business analysis, operations management, or logistics.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.
Technical Skills: Strong analytical thinking with a data-driven approach ; experience using Tableau, SQL, or other data analytics tools is highly preferred.
Methodologies: Practical experience with Lean principles, root cause analysis, and project management practices.
Soft Skills: Exceptional stakeholder management skills ; independent thinker who is proactive and highly comfortable navigating ambiguity.


Why work at Skip?

Skip is the kind of workplace that garnered a “Top Places to Work in Manitoba” and it was no small coincidence. We set out to make this a place our employees are proud to tell their Mothers, Fathers, friends and anyone who will listen that they work here. Skip team members feel pride knowing their input and uniqueness are not only embraced but make an impact on a major Canadian company and its satisfied customers. As the company grows, so do you — you meet and surpass new challenges every day. That’s just a small taste of what it’s like to work at one of Canada’s leading tech companies. If you’re hungry for opportunity, growth, and something meaningful in a dynamic, fun and challenging environment, we’d love to hear from you.

SKIP is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive environment where all employees feel they truly belong and where everyone is included, seen, heard and respected.

In keeping with our values, all applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of: gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, marital/domestic partner status, (dis)ability, neurodivergence, or any other characteristic protected by law. Should you require any accommodations throughout the hiring process, we encourage you to reach out to your talent acquisition specialist.

Note


All employees will be asked to sign a Consent for Disclosure of Personal Information in order to complete a background check. Job offers will be conditional upon results that the Company determines to be satisfactory.
This is a hybrid role, requiring 3 days per week in our Winnipeg office and 2 days per week working remotely from home.

Title: Content Analyst
Description:
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.

Job Description

The team:

We are a unified, collaborative marketing team focused on creating meaningful client connections that drive business growth. We combine deep insights with strong partnerships to deliver timely, relevant, and impactful experiences for our clients. Our team is committed to continuous learning, innovation, and excellence in everything we do. We align closely with distribution partners to generate demand and unlock new opportunities across the business. Above all, we measure and optimize our efforts to ensure we consistently deliver value, drive engagement, and strengthen loyalty to Invesco.

The role:

The Content Enablement Content Analyst is a key role within Invesco’s Global Content Enablement team, supporting the Americas & EMEA Marketing organization. This position executes the content strategy and roadmap to enhance the quality, accessibility, and usability of content across the EMEA region. The role focuses on building and managing content infrastructure, ensuring accurate categorization, distribution, and access across platforms and audiences. It partners closely with business and technology stakeholders to deliver consistent, well-governed content solutions and ensure requirements are clearly defined and tested. This hands-on role is critical to improving content quality and driving engagement, ultimately enabling a stronger client and investment experience.

Responsibilities of the role:

Provides analytics support primarily for EMEA content domains, with additional support for North America.
Partners closely with EMEA Content Product Owners to deliver analysis across development, deployment, and research initiatives.
Defines and standardizes content quality metrics, building reporting and dashboards to provide visibility into content performance for senior leadership.
Collaborates with EMEA and NA domain experts to develop and maintain global taxonomy, aligning stakeholders to standardized definitions and fields.
Bridges business and technology teams to ensure solutions meet requirements and align with strategic priorities.
Maps business processes, develops expertise in content sources, and provides recommendations to improve content effectiveness.
Translates stakeholder needs into user stories and supports execution of content initiatives, including testing, impact analysis, and cross-team coordination.
Leads governance and documentation efforts, including content quality monitoring, process improvement, issue escalation, and maintaining records in tools such as Jira and Confluence.


Requirements of the role:

Bachelor’s degree, 5+ years in technology platforms, project management, or content development and distribution.
Experience with CMS and/or DAM platforms, content lifecycle management, and content migrations, including API-based integrations.
Familiarity with AI-assisted content analysis and UX or digital marketing concepts.
Strong skills in workflow/process mapping, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and operate effectively in ambiguous environments.
Advanced technical proficiency, including SQL and Excel (advanced formulas, pivot tables; VBA a plus), along with strong desktop tool capabilities.
Strong analytical and statistical reasoning skills, with ability to organize, analyze, and communicate large data sets with accuracy and attention to detail.
Knowledge of content categorization (campaign, program, asset class, product), with preferred experience in investment or asset management content.
Client-focused, execution-oriented professional with strong communication, organizational, relationship-building, and influencing skills, plus a data-driven approach to measuring content performance and impact.


The salary range for this position is $55,000 to $61,000 per year. The total compensation offered for this position includes salary and incentive pay and will vary based on skills, experience and location.

Full time

Worker Type

Employee

Job Exempt (Yes / No)

Yes

Workplace Model

Pursuant to Invesco’s Workplace Policy, employees are expected to comply with the firm’s most current workplace model, which as of October 1, 2025, includes spending at least four full days each week working in an Invesco office. This reflects our belief that spending time together in the office helps us build stronger relationships, collaborate more easily, and support each other’s growth and development.

What’s in it for you?

Our people are at the very core of our success and we strive to provide employees with a competitive total rewards package which includes:

Hybrid working environment
RRSP Contributions
Health & Wellness Benefits
Work flexibility Programs
Parental Leave Benefits
Study Support

Title: VOC Data & Insights Specialist
Description:
About The Role

We are looking for the VOC Data & Insights Specialist who thrives on turning raw data into actionable stories. In this role, you will be the bridge between our customer data systems and business decisions. You will be responsible for pulling data directly from APIs, querying a Data Warehouse as an advanced end-user, and building dynamic reports in Excel and Tableau.

A significant portion of this role focuses on Support Operations and Text Analytics. You will leverage Zendesk Explore to monitor support performance and use text analytics to extract meaningful customer sentiment and trends from unstructured data.

If you love data wrangling, have a knack for finding patterns in text, and enjoy building practical reports using both warehouse data and platform APIs, we want to hear from you.

You Will Be Responsible For


Data Extraction & Querying: Query data directly from our Data Warehouse to pull relevant operational datasets. Connect to and extract data from various platform APIs when direct warehouse integration isn't available.
Data Preparation: Clean, manipulate, and merge disparate datasets (from DWH, APIs, and manual uploads) to ensure accuracy and consistency before reporting.
CX & Support Analytics: Act as our internal expert for Zendesk Explore. Build, maintain, and optimize dashboards to track customer support KPIs, team productivity, and service bottlenecks.
Text & Sentiment Analytics: Analyze unstructured text data (customer tickets, feedback, chat logs) using text analytics techniques to identify emerging customer pain points, feature requests, and sentiment trends.
Report & Dashboard Creation: Design and maintain clear, user-friendly reports and dashboards in Tableau and Excel (utilizing advanced formulas, Power Query, and Pivot Tables) for cross-functional teams.


Our Successful Candidate Will Have The Following


DWH & API Familiarity: Strong experience as a DWH user (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) with the ability to write SQL queries to extract data. Experience working with APIs to pull data. SQL , Python.
Tool Expertise: Advanced proficiency in Excel (Power Query is a must) and hands-on experience building visualizations in Tableau.
Zendesk Explore: Direct, practical experience navigating and building custom reports within Zendesk Explore.
Text Analytics: Experience with text mining, sentiment analysis, or categorization of unstructured qualitative data.
Analytical Mindset: Strong attention to detail with the ability to spot trends and anomalies that others might miss.
Communication: Ability to explain data concepts and insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders.


Who We Are

At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 18 offices worldwide.

Benefits


Hybrid work policy
4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply)
Well-being allowance to support your active lifestyle
Private health insurance
Discounts across a range of retailers, gyms, bars & restaurants
We offer an employee assistance program that can provide help and guidance during challenging moments.


JOIN US!

In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen!

Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar!

As our company working language is English, we’d like to see your CV in English, please

Title: Data and AI Analyst
Description:
About Aerogen:

Headquartered in the vibrant city of Galway, Ireland, with offices around the world, Aerogen is proud to be the world leader in acute care aerosol drug delivery. Recognised through multiple MedTech awards, including being named Galway Chamber Company of the Year 2025, and twelve-time winner of the Zenith Award for Respiratory Care Excellence in North America, our employees make a difference to patients’ lives every day, having reached over 30 million patients in more than 80 countries.




Today, Aerogen is powered by a global team representing 54 nationalities, working together with a shared commitment to improving patient care. Our talented and skilled team collaborate to innovate, challenge and test not only in relation to our products but every facet of how we work.




We lead the way by finding innovative solutions to even the most complex problems, all in the name of delivering better patient outcomes.




Our business continues to grow rapidly across the globe and, as we grow, our core culture of “We Care” universally connects us. We believe that your ambition and integrity fuels ours, and we are committed to supporting our employees to reach their full potential through tangible investment in their careers.




What is the role?

The Data and AI Analyst will join Aerogen's ITIS department and will own data and AI-driven solutions within ITIS, turning business data into decision-ready insight and building intelligent automation across the organisation. The successful candidate will design and maintain Power BI dashboards and data models, develop and support Power Platform applications (Power Apps and Power Automate), and actively apply AI tools to improve data quality, analysis, and business processes - all while ensuring governance, security, and compliance, and working closely with stakeholders across the business.




What are the key responsibilities?

• Partner with stakeholders across the business to gather, analyse, and prioritise data and reporting requirements, translating them into technical solutions.

• Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports, including data modelling, DAX measures, and connections to Dataverse, SharePoint, SQL, and other data sources.

• Design, develop, and deploy business applications using Power Apps (Canvas & Model-Driven Apps), and automate workflows using Power Automate to improve efficiency across business operations.

• Apply AI tools and techniques (e.g. Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Power Platform AI Builder) to improve data analysis, automate repetitive tasks, and identify new opportunities for AI-driven solutions across the business.

• Extract, cleanse, and transform data from multiple source systems, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across reports and dashboards.

• Ensure governance, security, and compliance best practices are followed within Power Platform applications and all data solutions.

• Stay current with developments in Power Platform, SharePoint, and AI/data tools, proactively recommending new tools and methodologies to enhance solutions.

Title: BI Analyst
Description:
About the Role

GetsBet Group is looking for a BI Analyst to join our data team and be the day to day driver of analytics across the business. You'll work closely with our data engineer, who maintains the core data warehouse, and with stakeholders across departments who rely on you for clear, trustworthy answers from the data. This is an all rounder role: one day you might be building a dashboard, the next you're digging into an ad hoc question for a department head, the next you're cleaning up a recurring report. You're comfortable moving between tasks and owning whatever comes up.

What You'll Do

·        Handle day to day analytics requests from stakeholders across departments, turning business questions into clear, accurate answers.

·        Use AI tools as part of your regular workflow to speed up analysis, drafting, and reporting.

·        Keep documentation and definitions up to date, so reporting logic stays clear to both business stakeholders and technical staff.

·        Pitch in on compliance or other specialized analytics requests as they come up, as part of the broader day to day workload.

What You'll Bring

·        Strong SQL skills and comfort working directly with a data warehouse.

·        Strong Tableau skills, from building new dashboards to maintaining and improving existing ones.

·        Proficiency with AI tools, and a habit of using them to work faster and smarter.

·        Great stakeholder management skills, comfortable working with non technical people across different departments and translating between the two.

·        An all rounder mindset: happy to switch between ad hoc analysis, dashboard building, and recurring reporting without needing a rigid job description.

·        Strong attention to detail and a sense of ownership over the accuracy of what you deliver.

Nice to Have

Working knowledge of Python. Background in iGaming or another regulated, data intensive industry. Experience with AI assisted workflows or agentic tools in a business setting.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey?

At Aleph , we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.

Our mission is to empower advertisers and brands to unlock the full potential of these platforms' advertising capabilities. By fostering long-lasting partnerships, we create limitless opportunities for people and businesses to advertise effectively at both local and global levels.

With a presence spanning continents, Aleph offers you the chance to be part of a fast-growing, innovative team where your work makes a direct impact. If you’re ambitious, forward-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career.

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly analytical Data Analyst to join our Business Intelligence team. You will act as a critical "backend engine," building the data foundations and analytical models that enable data-driven decisions for both our supply (platforms) and demand (sales) sides.

You will dive deep into complex datasets, build automated reporting pipelines, and uncover actionable insights that drive our strategy with global platforms like TikTok, Microsoft, Google, X, Spotify, and others.

What You 'll Do



Extract and analyze complex data.
Query, clean, and transform large datasets from multiple sources to uncover trends, performance metrics, and market insights that support strategic decision-making across the organization.
Build and maintain BI dashboards.
Design, develop, and maintain automated dashboards and reports using Looker Studio to provide real-time visibility into business performance for executive and partner discussions. Support strategic projects.
Conduct deep-dive analyses for platform RFP responses, Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), and strategic initiatives that shape Aleph’s partnerships and revenue strategy. Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders.
Work closely with strategists, sales teams, and regional leadership to define data requirements, understand their business challenges, and deliver quantitative solutions.
Translate data into actionable recommendations.
Identify performance anomalies, revenue opportunities, and market risks by packaging raw data into structured, easy-to-consume analytical models and insights.
Ensure data integrity and governance.
Establish clear data validation frameworks, optimize queries, and maintain high standards for data accuracy and documentation internally.



Who You Are



Highly analytical and problem-solving oriented.
You have a strong quantitative background and enjoy tackling complex business questions through rigorous data analysis.
Technically proficient in data tools.
You possess strong SQL skills for data extraction and manipulation, and you are highly proficient in at least one major BI visualization tool (e.g., Power BI, Looker Studio). Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills are a must; experience with Python a strong plus. Business-minded.You don’t just pull numbers; you understand the business context behind the data and can connect your analysis directly to revenue growth, efficiency, and key opportunities.
A clear communicator. You can translate complex technical findings and data models into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders and leadership
Structured and detail-oriented. You are meticulous about data accuracy, organize your code and queries logically, and ensure all deliverables meet a high-quality standard before they reach stakeholders.
Interested in digital media or advertising.
Experience in digital advertising analytics, media agencies, ad-tech, or similar environments is a strong plus, though not strictly required.



What You'll Love About Us



We care about your individuality by giving you freedom to grow and create within the company, regardless of your position.
Work in a dynamic team in a fast-paced industry of an international company with multi-cultural teams around the world .
Learn from the best: Our state of the art workshops guarantee the latest insights into digital advertising.
In line with the EU Pay Transparency Directive, we are committed to fair and open compensation practices. For this role, the minimum gross annual base salary is 35,000 EUR.



In addition to base salary, this role includes a variable component, paid annually. The final offer will reflect your experience, skills, and the scope of the role.

#ALEPH

Why Join Us?

Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.

We stay flexible and adaptable, and believe in moving with the speed of change. We encourage everyone to strive for more, providing our internal talent with growth opportunities and the ability to learn together.

Tickmill is looking to hire a Data Analyst to mainly collaborate with stakeholders and Product Owners/Analysts to understand their data needs and provide actionable insights based on data analysis.




About Tickmill.




Tickmill is an award-winning, multi-regulated broker offering access to a broad range of asset classes, including CFDs on Forex, Stocks, Indices, Commodities, Cryptocurrencies, and Bonds, as well as Exchange Traded Derivatives like Futures & Options).




Founded in 2014, the Tickmill Group employs over 330 professionals across offices in London, Cyprus, Poland, Estonia, Seychelles and several other locations worldwide.

Our culture is built on trust, transparency, and high standards. We bring together ambitious professionals who are looking for an environment that supports them to dominate in their fields.

Our diverse, multilingual teams are focused on innovation, delivering bold excellence, and raising the bar wherever we can.

We offer competitive benefits packages, frequent team initiatives, and opportunities for professional growth. Join the Tigers!




What does the role look like?




The Data Analyst will have the chance to:

• Collaborate with stakeholders and Product Owners/Analysts to understand business requirements and support data-driven decision-making.

• Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights.

• Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations to effectively communicate findings to stakeholders.

• Support the implementation of data-driven solutions that improve business performance and operational efficiency.

• Contribute to analytics projects related to product performance, client behavior, acquisition funnels, and client lifecycle analysis.

• Ensure data accuracy and consistency through validation and quality checks.

• Work closely with BI team members to improve reporting processes and analytical capabilities.

• Stay up to date with industry trends, analytical techniques, and data visualization best practices.




What do you need to succeed in this role?

• Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

• Minimum 2–4 years of experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar analytical role, preferably within the Finance/FX industry.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and interpret data accurately.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to present analytical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into reporting and analytical solutions.

• Experience performing cohort analysis, funnel analysis, segmentation, retention analysis, and KPI performance monitoring.

• Hands-on experience with data visualization tools (Power BI preferred).

• Strong SQL skills and understanding of dimensional modeling concepts, semantic models, and how to consume data from existing star schemas.

• Working knowledge of DAX and Power BI data modelling principles.

• Demonstrated ability to independently translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches and actionable recommendations.

• Attention to detail, curiosity, and a proactive approach to solving business problems.

• Excellent command of English, both written and spoken.

• Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.




Will be considered as a plus:

• Experience with statistical analysis and A/B testing concepts.

• Basic knowledge of machine learning concepts and their business applications.

• Proficiency in Python or R for data analysis and automation.

• Experience working with financial services, trading, or FX data.

• Familiarity with data governance and data quality best practices.

• Knowledge of Agile methodologies and DataOps principles.

• Familiarity with Databricks or similar cloud platforms.

• Experience conducting market, competitor, or benchmarking analysis.




By joining us, you can expect:

• A Unique Opportunity for a career in a global, fast-growing company.

• Attractive remuneration package based on qualifications and experience.

• Opportunities to learn and grow through our “Employee Training & Development program”.

• Stebby Sports Compensation or Confido Health Compensation.

• Multiple events to bond with the team and the group.

• Birthday and Loyalty benefits.




What to expect from our recruitment process:

Interview with HR
Assessment task
Interview with hiring managers
Final interview with top management




Make your next Career step and apply NOW!

Title: Supply Chain AI & Automation Analyst
Description:
Over 50,000 customers globally trust our end-to-end, cloud-driven networking solutions and rely on our top-rated services and support to accelerate their digital transformation efforts and deliver progress like never before and with double digit growth year over year, no provider is better positioned to deliver better outcomes on scale, than Extreme.

Come become part of something big with us! We are a global leader, with hubs in Europe, North America, South America, Asia Pacific, and the Middle East.

Supply Chain AI & Automation Analyst

About The Role

We are seeking a “Supply Chain AI & Automation Analyst” to join our Extreme Networks Global Operations organization, where you'll turn complex operational data into clear, actionable insight that drives decisions and automation across our Global Supply Chan and Order Management teams. This role sits at the intersection of analytics, AI, and supply chain strategy, partnering with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities, build analytical products, and tell the stories behind the numbers. The ideal candidate is a curious, technically strong analyst who is equally comfortable writing SQL, using AI tools, framing a business problem, managing a project, and presenting findings to stakeholders. You should be excited about the rapid evolution of AI and agentic workflows and how they can be applied to supply chain decision-making and you should be actively using AI tools in your work today.

A Note On Experience

This role requires commercially delivered analytical work. We will ask you at interview to walk through a specific project from problem through to business outcome that you owned and delivered in a professional setting. Academic or course-based projects do not qualify. If your experience is primarily from an academic programme, this role is not the right fit at this time

Key Responsibilities


Partner with supply chain stakeholders to scope problems and translate them into structured, measurable, automated workstreams.
Build and maintain python/SQL/Snowflake-based data models, dashboards, and self-service analytics for our global operations teams
Help operationalize AI and agent-based solutions to automate recurring analyses, augment decision support, and supply chain processes.
Apply statistical methods to inform data driven decisions across our global operations function.
Manage your projects end-to-end: scoping, stakeholder alignment, data discovery, modelling, validation, and rollout.
Translate analytical findings into compelling narratives (written, visual, and verbal) tailored to operational, business, and technical audiences.
Define and track KPIs that measure supply chain performance and flag interventions when metrics drift.
Contribute to ongoing improvements in data quality, documentation, and analytical standards across the team.


Required Skills & Qualifications


3-5 years experience in business analytics, data analytics, or a comparable quantitative role.
Demonstrated use of AI tools such as Claude, MS Copilot, or ChatGPT – in an analytical workflow, with a genuine appetite to develop agentic and automation capabilities in role.
Strong python skills and hands-on experience with Snowflake (or a comparable cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, Redshift, or Databricks).
Demonstrated project management ability, owning deliverables across multiple stakeholders and timelines.
Solid grounding in descriptive statistics, and analytics fundamentals.
Strong data storytelling skills: the ability to distil complexity into clear visuals and narratives that drive action.
Supply chain domain knowledge: familiarity with demand and supply planning, inventory optimization, order management, logistics, procurement, or manufacturing operations.
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Operations Research, Engineering, Physics, Economics, Data Science, Supply Chain, Mathematics, or related).


Technical Skills Required


Programming for analytics: Python or R for modelling, automation, and analytics workflows.
BI and visualization tools: Tableau, Sigma, Power BI, Looker, or similar — both for building and for design literacy.
ERP / source systems: Exposure to Oracle Fusion Cloud or similar transactional systems.


Preferred / Additional Skills: These are skills that would meaningfully strengthen a candidate for this role:


Practical experience applying agentic workflows (e.g., LLM-based assistants, retrieval-augmented analytics, automated reasoning agents) to analytical or operational problems.
Master's or PhD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Operations Research, Engineering, Physics, Economics, Data Science, Supply Chain, Mathematics, or related).
Forecasting and optimization: time-series methods as well as other optimization techniques.
Machine learning fundamentals: classification, regression, clustering, and an understanding of when ML is and isn't the right tool.
Process improvement methodologies: Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent structured problem-solving frameworks.
Stakeholder management and influencing: navigating ambiguity, managing competing priorities, and building trust with non-technical partners.


What Success Looks Like


Within 3 months: deeply understand our supply chain data landscape, key stakeholders, and top-priority business questions.
Within 6 months: deliver at least one high-impact analytical product or AI-enabled workflow that changes how a decision is made.
Within 12 months: become a trusted analytics partner to supply chain stakeholders and a contributor to the broader analytics team's standards and practices.


Salary Is Based On Qualifications And Experience Between 60-70K

Title: Data Analyst, Customer Support
Description:
About Bolt

Bolt is shaping a future where cities are built for people, not cars. What started as an ambitious project of a 19-year-old in 2013 has grown into a global mobility platform used by more than 200 million customers and 4.5 million driver and courier partners across 50 countries.

From ride-hailing and food delivery to scooters, e-bikes, and car-sharing, Bolt helps people move through cities every day. Small, autonomous teams drive this work, combining the speed and ownership of a startup with the scale of a global technology company backed by more than €1bn in funding.

And we're just getting started.

Why join Bolt?


Build the future of mobility and help transform how people live and move in cities.
Tackle challenges at scale that span technology, operations, regulation, and growth.
Take real ownership early. Small, lean teams mean your decisions matter from day one, and you'll learn fast alongside some of the best people in the industry.
Join one of Europe's leading technology companies, backed by world-class investors including Sequoia.


About The Role

As a CS Data Analyst, you’ll transform CS data into insights that power smarter decisions, real-world impact, and make our Customer Support stronger. This role is all about turning numbers into action - automating data flows, uncovering trends, and helping our teams make data-driven decisions faster and better. You’ll collaborate across departments to build insightful dashboards, and ensure everything runs seamlessly behind the scenes. In this fast-paced environment, you’ll be the go-to expert for clean, accurate data and clear, actionable insights -driving change and making a difference.

Main Tasks And Responsibilities


Build and maintain Customer Support dashboards and reports.
Review performance data, identify issues and trends, and provide clear insights to leadership.
Monitor data quality across pipelines, dashboards, and source systems, and resolve reporting issues.
Develop and maintain Looker models, dashboards, and PDTs, while improving usability and automation.
Work with Operations and Engineering teams on data integration, reporting requirements, governance, and compliance requests.
Provide historical analysis to support forecasting, capacity planning, and peak-season preparation.


About You


Practical experience in data analytics, ideally with Customer Support, operations, or customer-related data.
Strong SQL skills; experience with Python, R, or another programming language is considered a plus.
Experience with Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or a similar data visualisation tool.
Ability to work with senior stakeholders and prepare clear reports and insights for leadership.
Experience with dbt or similar data modelling tools is considered a plus.
Understanding of key data platform concepts, including data warehouses, pipelines, data models, and data quality.


Why you’ll love it here


Accelerate your professional growth with unique career opportunities.
Enjoy a rewarding salary and stock options, knowing that as Bolt succeeds, so do you.
Take care of your physical and mental health with our wellness perks.
Celebrate 5 years at Bolt with a 1-month paid sabbatical to recharge.
Connect with colleagues at annual company events and smaller team gatherings.
Balance flexibility and in-person collaboration with our hybrid model, including at least 12 monthly in-office days.


Some perks may differ depending on your location and role.

At Bolt, using AI daily is a baseline expectation for everyone. If there’s a faster, smarter way to do your work, we expect you to find it. You’re still responsible for the output, so the standard stays high when using AI tools.

Experience is great, but what we really look for is drive, intelligence, and integrity. So even if you don’t tick every box, please consider applying!

Everyone is welcome

Bolt is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where all qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, colour, nationality, religion, gender or gender identity, sexual orientation, age, or disability.

We welcome applications from all backgrounds and are happy to make reasonable accommodations throughout our hiring process. If you require any adjustments, please let us know.

Title: Data Analyst (Products & Systems)
Description:
Join our team as a Data Analyst in Products & Systems domain!

Yes, you can! That's our attitude towards our work, ambitions, ideas, and relationships. We at Luminor believe that anyone has the potential to achieve big things and encourage everyone to achieve them, professionally and personally.

Whoever you are and whatever your role is, with Luminor, you will get a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to build a local banking champion.

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our transformation initiatives and help ensure the successful migration of business-critical data across the bank.

This role is for someone who enjoys turning complex datasets into meaningful insights and wants to play an important role in large-scale change initiatives. You will work with diverse portfolios, analyze data quality and migration readiness, and provide the insights that help teams make informed decisions throughout the migration journey.

Working closely with business stakeholders, project teams, and technical experts, you will support planning, validation, and execution activities by delivering high-quality analysis, reporting, and recommendations. Your work will directly contribute to reducing migration risks, improving data quality, and ensuring successful outcomes for customers and the business.

How You Will Make an Impact:



Perform data analysis using SQL, Microsoft Excel, Tableau, KNIME, and/or Python to support data migration initiatives.
Conduct portfolio analysis to understand data composition, identify trends, and assess migration scope and readiness.
Prepare and validate data extracts to support migration planning, testing, and execution activities.
Analyze datasets to identify gaps, inconsistencies, and areas requiring data clean-up, and provide recommendations to project teams.
Produce reports, dashboards, and analytical summaries to support migration tracking and decision-making.
Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to understand data requirements and support migration-related assessments.
Provide analytical input for customer communication materials, including portfolio overviews, migration impact assessments, and data findings.
Support migration planning activities by providing data-driven insights and helping define priorities based on portfolio analysis.
Work closely with project teams to ensure timely delivery of analysis, reporting, and data-related project activities.



What Makes You a Great Fit:



Experience performing data analysis using SQL, Microsoft Excel, Tableau, KNIME, Python, or similar analytical tools.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to work with large datasets and transform data into meaningful insights.
Experience preparing, analyzing, and validating data extracts for business or migration-related purposes.
Ability to assess portfolios and identify data patterns.
Strong attention to detail and ability to ensure accuracy and consistency in analysis and reporting.
Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including customer-facing teams.
Experience in creating reports, dashboards, and presentations to support decision-making and project delivery.
A proactive and collaborative mindset, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively across teams.
Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and commitment to delivering high-quality analytical outcomes.
Fluent English is required in spoken and written communication due to working on Pan-Baltic level



Why You Will Love Working Here:



Flexibility. Flexible working hours, Hybrid work, and the possibility to work from anywhere in the EU, Iceland, Switzerland, and the UK (in total 90 days per year)
International teams. Teams that go outside Pan-Baltic borders, where people value challenging work together with good humor and having fun
Culture. You’ll be joining a team where things move fast, ideas flow freely, and change is part of the everyday. It’s a dynamic environment that keeps you learning, growing, and never bored
More vacation. Additional weeks of vacation are available to all employees who have been in the company for 1 year or more
Volunteer time off. We care about giving back to society, therefore, you will get additional days off for volunteering purposes
Paid leave. We are proud of our employees who are participating in military training. Therefore, Luminor offers 30 fully paid calendar days for military training every year
Health benefits. A competitive benefits package in addition to your salary that includes health insurance after the first 3 months pass in all three Baltic states, as well as Health days in case of your absence due to sickness without a doctor's note needed
Wellbeing. Access to tools and resources that help you feel good and be productive at work and in life
Professional growth. Internal and external training programs, LinkedIn learning, workshops, conferences, online training, etc
Special Offer for Luminor products & services. Enjoy special offers & pricing for products and services provided by Luminor
Gross salary. 3,210 - 4,810 EUR/month, which is to be determined depending on your level of experience and competencies

Luminor has a strong and capable team that is committed to achieving our strategic objectives. We are dedicated to supporting sustainable growth in the Baltic region by providing a long-term commitment to businesses and individuals.

Title: Growth Analyst
Description:
About Bolt

Bolt is shaping a future where cities are built for people, not cars. What started as an ambitious project of a 19-year-old in 2013 has grown into a global mobility platform used by more than 200 million customers and 4.5 million driver and courier partners across 50 countries.

From ride-hailing and food delivery to scooters, e-bikes, and car-sharing, Bolt helps people move through cities every day. Small, autonomous teams drive this work, combining the speed and ownership of a startup with the scale of a global technology company backed by more than €1bn in funding.

And we're just getting started.

Why join Bolt?


Build the future of mobility and help transform how people live and move in cities.
Tackle challenges at scale that span technology, operations, regulation, and growth.
Take real ownership early. Small, lean teams mean your decisions matter from day one, and you'll learn fast alongside some of the best people in the industry.
Join one of Europe's leading technology companies, backed by world-class investors including Sequoia.


About The Role

As a Growth Analyst, you will take ownership of our campaign spending decisions and contribute to the marketplace's success by meticulously analysing the return on investment (ROI). With your expertise, we'll be able to accurately determine the most strategic allocation of resources, including the exact location, timing, method, and amount spent on campaigns.

You will be working closely with other team members of the Growth domain, as well as Expansion Managers, Marketing and Operations teams. A Data Analyst will need to have good attention to detail and communication skills to succeed. Solid business sense and analytical mindset? You might be the campaign magician we’ve been waiting for.

Main Tasks And Responsibilities


Own campaign spending decisions for your assigned markets and optimise such decisions to help the country team reach their growth targets
Wrangle complex data sets to come up with testing hypotheses, setting up A/B tests (and other experiments) and analysing results using statistical techniques in order to guide your decision-making
Proactively working together with Expansion Managers, Marketing, Operations and local teams to drive collaboration and get the most out of our investments
Identify valuable opportunities in the team and contribute to global campaigns team playbook, processes and product requests


About You


BS in Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Information Management or Statistics
At least 3 years of experience in an analytical role dealing with large volumes of data. Experience in consulting, pricing/discount strategy and/or on-demand is a plus
Solid grasp of statistics and demonstrated experience with A/B testing
Amazing SQL and Excel skills. Experience with Python or R is a plus
Experience with some BI tools and data visualisation like Tableau, Power BI or Looker
Fluent in English


Why You’ll Love It Here


Accelerate your professional growth with unique career opportunities.
Enjoy a rewarding salary and stock options, knowing that as Bolt succeeds, so do you.
Take care of your physical and mental health with our wellness perks.
Celebrate 5 years at Bolt with a 1-month paid sabbatical to recharge.
Connect with colleagues at annual company events and smaller team gatherings.
Balance flexibility and in-person collaboration with our hybrid model, including at least 12 monthly in-office days.


Some perks may differ depending on your location and role.

At Bolt, using AI daily is a baseline expectation for everyone. If there’s a faster, smarter way to do your work, we expect you to find it. You’re still responsible for the output, so the standard stays high when using AI tools.

Experience is great, but what we really look for is drive, intelligence, and integrity. So even if you don’t tick every box, please consider applying!

Everyone is welcome

Bolt is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where all qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, colour, nationality, religion, gender or gender identity, sexual orientation, age, or disability.

We welcome applications from all backgrounds and are happy to make reasonable accommodations throughout our hiring process. If you require any adjustments, please let us know.

Description:
