Our Mission is to help those in need with our out-of-this-world superpowers. Avalanche Laboratory’s purpose is to be a reliable and long-term business partner to our customers—offering them customized software solutions tailored for their business processes.

We work on a project basis (across the EU and beyond). To date, we’ve delivered over 320 successful projects, with another 45 currently in progress. Our clients span industries from financial services, fintech, and government, to manufacturing and technology, partnering with us to solve complex transformation challenges.




ABOUT THIS ROLE

BI Data Steward (Risk Area)

We are looking for a BI Data Steward to join an Agile delivery team within the Risk domain in a leading banking environment. This role requires proven hands-on experience working in Agile environments, including the ability to clearly explain Agile principles and demonstrate their practical value in IT delivery teams.




The team owns several key Risk services that are critical to both ongoing operations and upcoming initiatives:

BI Forbearance (data sourcing and outputs)
BI Riskgrade Consolidated (BIS)
BI Data Governance Registry
BI Exposure




These services form foundational components used across multiple Risk value delivery teams. As several initiatives are actively building new features on these platforms, the role involves managing dependencies and operating effectively under delivery pressure.




Key Responsibilities and Requirements

We are looking for a highly hands-on professional with a strong passion for data and data stewardship. The ideal candidate combines technical expertise, analytical thinking, and strong collaboration skills.




Must-have qualifications:

Strong, practical experience in SQL with the ability to work deeply with data.
Proven experience in data governance, data management, or similar roles (e.g., Data Steward, Business Analyst, Reporting Analyst, IT System Analyst).
Solid experience working in banking or financial services, preferably within the Risk domain.
Strong understanding of banking products, processes, and IT systems.
Advanced SQL skills, including analyzing large datasets, identifying data quality issues, and understanding complex data structures.
Hands-on experience with data warehousing and reporting concepts, including data profiling techniques.
Solid understanding of database structures and principles.
Proven ability to gather, analyze, and document business, functional, and data requirements.
Experience defining and maintaining business data definitions, glossaries, metadata, and data quality rules.
Experience designing data mappings, transformation logic, and business rules aligned with enterprise data architecture.
Experience monitoring data quality issues, performing root cause analysis, and coordinating remediation across teams.
Strong proficiency with JIRA and Confluence.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a proactive and engaged approach to teamwork.




Experience Level

4–6 years of relevant experience in a similar role.
Strong competence in solving complex problems and understanding interconnected systems.
Ability to guide and support others, corresponding to a senior consultant or equivalent level.




Location and Working Model

Location: Baltics
Requirement: On-site presence three days per week is mandatory to ensure effective collaboration with the team.




Why join us…

Work on a high-impact, large-scale migration project in a pan-European environment
Be part of a strong, focused team of senior engineers and consultants
Compensation: Employment in Estonia up to 3,600 EUR gross, in Latvia up to 3,900 EUR gross, or a B2B rate of 30–35 EUR/hour depending on seniority and experience. In Lithuania, only the B2B option is available.

Title: Data Analyst (Payments)
Description:
Mayflower is a technology company building large-scale entertainment products for a global audience. Our platforms serve millions of users worldwide and rank among the top-50 most visited websites globally. For more than 10 years, we've been creating reliable, high-performance solutions at the intersection of product, engineering, and entertainment.

As a Payments Data Analyst, you will help optimize the performance of our global payment infrastructure by turning transaction data into actionable insights. You will work closely with Payments, Product, Finance, Risk, and Data teams to identify opportunities for improving payment success rates, reducing costs, and delivering a better customer payment experience.

This role combines analytical thinking with a strong understanding of payment flows. You will investigate payment performance, identify trends and anomalies, evaluate experiments, and help drive data-informed decisions across the payments domain.

Responsibilities


Monitor and optimise payments performance, including approval rates, decline patterns, 3DS flows, timeouts, retries and routing rules.
Analyse and reduce fraud-related declines, collaborate on tuning fraud rules and improving risk thresholds.
Perform deep-dive analyses to discover patterns, trends and new insights across card schemes, PSPs, BINs, countries and methods.
Drive actionable outcomes: update routing logic, cascading strategy, risk rules, issuer-specific heuristics and operational configurations.
Own continuous monitoring: daily health checks, anomaly detection and alerts on key metrics.
Build dashboards and monitoring tools in Metabase / Amplitude / Tableau
Prepare clear and actionable analytics reports for internal teams and leadership.
Evaluate impact of new features, routing changes, ML versions, product experiments and provide data-backed recommendations.
Work closely with Product, Data, ML, Payments Operations and Fraud teams to design and implement improvements end-to-end.


You will thrive if you have…


Strong advanced SQL (NoSQL, window functions), ability to build metrics properly
Understanding of PSP behaviour, decline codes, 3DS, issuer logic, routing, tokens, cascading
Understanding of fraud basics (RDR, chargebacks, rule tuning, risk signals)
Ability to translate data into clear actions
Comfortable in a fast-moving, operational environment
Ownership mindset, strong attention to detail
Fluency in Python Data Science stack (Jupyter Notebook, Pandas)


Nice-to-haves


Knowledge of Russian
Experience with card schemes / PSPs and issuer-specific patterns
Hands-on work with 3DS flows, network tokens, or routing optimisation
Background in fraud prevention (rules, signals, chargebacks)
Work experience in fintech / high-load transactional products


Conditions

We know that great talent deserves great conditions, so here's what you can expect when joining us:


EU-based employment contract and a 3-year Cyprus work visa with full support for your relocation and visa processes, including assistance for your family.
EU passport. Opportunity to obtain an EU passport after 4 years of residence.
Full relocation package: flights to Limassol for you and your family, a company-covered apartment for the first month, and full relocation support to make your move smooth and hassle-free.
42 remote work days
21 vacation days/10 days paid sick leave
Transparent performance reviews twice a year, with bonus opportunities and salary adjustments.
Private medical insurance for you and your family, a corporate mobile plan (unlimited in Cyprus with roaming included), and interest-free support for car purchases.
Provident fund (Cyprus): a long-term savings plan co-funded by you and the Company together (available after probation) that grows throughout your time with us in Cyprus.
Mindfulness & well-being support, including psychological assistance with 50% coverage.
50% coverage of school and kindergarten fees for your children.
Fully covered sports benefits, and also access to in-house electric scooters and bike rentals.
Investment in your growth: paid language courses and access to suited-for-you development programs, including conferences, training programs, and coaching to support your professional journey.
A culture of recognition: a peer reward program to celebrate your contributions.
A fully equipped office in Limassol, with everything you need for deep work and collaboration.
Free breakfast options at the office, Wolt Allowance, and an in-house coffee bar with high quality drinks and a health bar stocked with nutritious snacks.
A strong engineering culture: international teams, corporate events, team buildings, and hackathons—because great work happens in great communities.


Benefits are provided in accordance with the company's policies and eligibility criteria.

HR Interview (40mins)
Technical interview with the hiring team (1hr)

Established in 2004, we are a tech pioneer offering world-class adult entertainment and games on some of the internet’s safest and most popular platforms. With the support of an international team of dynamic and collaborative innovators, we are on a mission to enable safe user experiences and empower our communities by celebrating diversity, inclusion, and expression — all while maintaining robust trust-and-safety protocols.

We embrace the best of both worlds! Local talent can thrive in our collaborative office space with the flexibility of a hybrid work environment, while remote team members play an integral role in shaping our dynamic culture from afar. We have offices in Montreal (Quebec), Austin (Texas) and Nicosia (Cyprus).


A select number of positions require full-time in office attendance*


The Data Warehouse Services team plays a vital role in our organization. They are responsible for storing vast quantities of data from many sources and responsible for disseminating data across the organization to various different groups. They are one of the backbones of data at our organization and they are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join their team.

What you'll be doing:


Collaborate with internal stakeholders including; Directors, Analysts, and Developers to understand business objectives and requirements, and help define the strategy, content, and features for our reporting environments.
Engage with business partners at all levels to discuss and clarify data analysis, needs and requirements.
Analyze data structures and content from data marts to support business intelligence initiatives.
Thrive in a fast-paced environment, where multitasking and adaptability are essential.
Participate in brainstorming sessions to define functional requirements, organize content, map process flows, and specify report features.
Develop and optimize queries to investigate data issues or new reporting structures for various business units.
Work closely with Database Administrators and Developers to estimate time and effort for report projects and refining these estimates throughout the project.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Company Description

AppXite is a product software development company based in Riga, Latvia. Our platform is an AI-ready Digital Marketplace, CPQ, and Billing Platform for Telco, SaaS, Cloud, and AI services. It enables partners to build and monetize as-a-service offerings with flexible pricing models. The platform includes pre-built vendor and catalog integrations with major providers such as Microsoft, Google, AWS, and Adobe. It supports a wide range of billing configurations, helping partners efficiently manage and grow their businesses.

Job Description

As a Data Analyst, you will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy, reliability, and timely delivery of billing and invoicing data across the AppXite Platform. You will work extensively with Microsoft SQL Server, APIs, Postman, and Excel to investigate discrepancies, validate financial data, support integrations with external vendor platforms, and help improve business processes through automation and continuous improvement initiatives.This role is ideal for a highly analytical, detail-oriented professional who enjoys solving complex data problems and working at the intersection of technology, business operations, and financial processes.

Qualifications

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications:


Advanced SQL scripting skills and experience working with Microsoft SQL Server.
Hands-on experience using Postman or similar API testing tools.
Strong understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and system integrations.
Advanced Excel skills and experience working with large datasets.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to remain focused and productive when working on complex investigations.
Eagerness to learn and continuously improve.


Nice to Have:


Experience working with billing, invoicing, financial systems, or cloud commerce platforms.
Experience with ETL processes and data transformation workflows.
Experience with Microsoft Azure services, including:
Logic Apps
Data Factory
Storage Accounts
Function Apps
Application Insights
Ability to read and understand application code (e.g., C#) to support investigations, troubleshoot issues, and collaborate effectively with development teams.
Practical experience using AI tools to automate and optimize business processes.


Your Mission:

Billing & Invoicing Operations:


Verify billing and invoicing data across the AppXite Platform.
Perform recurring discrepancy analysis to ensure the accuracy and completeness of billing and invoicing data delivered to partners.
Investigate data inconsistencies and identify root causes of issues.
Apply required manual corrections and configuration adjustments to ensure timely invoice delivery.
Participate in monthly billing and invoicing deliveries, including peak periods.


Data Analysis & TroubleshootingL:


Analyze large datasets to identify anomalies, errors, and data quality issues.
Investigate incidents and collaborate with internal teams to resolve problems.
Execute SQL scripts and perform data validation activities.
Validate data across multiple systems, integrations, and vendor platforms.


Process Improvement:


Review billing and invoicing workflows and identify opportunities for optimization.
Define requirements and development tasks needed to improve billing processes and data reliability.
Contribute to automation initiatives that reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency.
Ensure all activities comply with security and data handling requirements.


Technical Collaboration & Expertise:


Act as a subject matter expert for billing and invoicing related functionality.
Support internal teams by providing guidance on platform behavior, data structures, and processes.
Participate in customer and partner discussions when expertise is required.
Contribute to partner-specific projects by helping design solutions, provide estimates, and support successful delivery.
Collaborate with Development, QA, Support, Product, and Operations teams.


Knowledge Sharing & Growth:


Mentor colleagues and help improve organizational knowledge through documentation, knowledge base articles, and process guides.
Maintain a strong understanding of both business and technical aspects of the platform.
Continuously expand expertise in cloud commerce, billing, invoicing, integrations, and vendor ecosystems.
Stay informed about industry trends and vendor platform developments.


Additional Information

What we offer:


Remote-First Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of a fully remote role, or choose to work from our Latvia office.
Work with global Tech Leaders: Collaborate on solutions used by some of the biggest names in the industry, including Adobe, AWS, Cisco, Google, IBM, Microsoft, Lenovo, and Liquid. Your work will help shape how these companies deliver services across the globe.
Skilled, International Team: Work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We value technical excellence, clear communication, and mutual support.
Professional Development: Advance your skills with access to Microsoft certifications and continuous learning opportunities tailored to your role.
Time to Recharge: Enjoy four weeks of paid vacation per year, plus paid public holidays.
Referral Rewards: Help us grow our team - our employee referral program recognizes and rewards your contributions.

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
About Block Labs

Block Labs is a premier technology studio operating at the bleeding edge of Web3, Artificial Intelligence, and iGaming. We don't just ship features; we engineer high-scale, production-grade platforms that power the next generation of digital products.

We are a collective of senior engineers, product strategists, and builders who refuse to compromise on architecture. Whether we are designing autonomous multi-agent AI systems, building decentralized financial infrastructure, or architecting high-frequency iGaming platforms, our standard is excellence.

We move fast, but we build for the long term. If you are looking to work alongside a team that values deep technical expertise, thoughtful system design, and product ownership, Block Labs is where you belong.

About The Role

We’re looking for a data-obsessed BI Analyst to turn blockchain and product data into crisp insights that drive growth, retention, and risk controls across our crypto-enabled iGaming products. You’ll own the end-to-end analytics stack for wallet funnels, wagering behavior, lifecycle marketing, and compliance—using SQL, DBT, Python, Amplitude and Tableau as your primary tools. In the future we planning transition from Tableau to other BI tools alternatives like Metabase or Apache Superset or others.

Key Responsibilities


Drive the business forward through proactive analytics - don't just fulfill dashboard requests; spot anomalies, frame the right question yourself, and bring actionable recommendations to Product / CRM / Risk before they have to ask..
Build, maintain, and iterate dashboards surfacing KPIs (GGR/NGR, ARPU, LTV, churn, deposit→wager conversion, fraud loss rate).
Write production-grade SQL (CTEs, window functions, incremental models) to model clean datasets from Clickhouse and on-chain tables.
Build and maintain AI-agent workflows that automate recurring analytics - anomaly investigation, root-cause loops etc.
Use Python (pandas, seaborn, sklearn, scipy) for analysis, data quality checks, lightweight ETL/backfills, API pulls (e.g., blockchain providers), and automation.
Work with on-chain data: parse EVM logs, token transfers (ERC-20/721), join labeled address datasets, analyze exchange/bridge flows, gas/fee dynamics, and wallet clustering.
Partner with Product, Marketing/CRM, Risk/Compliance, and Engineering to define event schemas and tracking plans; ensure data quality, lineage, and documentation.
Design and analyze experiments, cohort analyses, and attribution within iGaming and regional compliance constraints.
Investigate anomalies (bonus abuse, botting, arbitrage, suspicious wallet rings) and recommend mitigations.
Automate recurring reporting and alerting for KPI movements.


Must-haves


2+ years in BI or Data Analytics; crypto or iGaming exposure prefered.
Ambitions about building great analytics infrastructure.
Good SQL: complex joins, window functions, query optimization, and dimensional modeling.
Solid AI-collaboration craft — prompt & context engineering, spec-driven task framing, and eval-driven iteration. Comfortable decomposing business questions into precise, agent-executable steps and designing the right tools for the agent to call.
BI Versatility: Expert knowledge of Tableau (LODs, parameters, performance tuning) combined with a strong interest or experience in modern, open-source BI tools like Metabase or Apache Superset.
Proficient Python for analytics & data engineering: pandas, modular scripts/notebooks, API integrations, scheduling small jobs, and writing maintainable code.
Solid statistics and probability fundamentals for experimentation - hypothesis testing, sample size and power, confidence intervals, and the discipline to distinguish real signal from noise.
Practical understanding of crypto wallets and transaction flows.


Nice-to-haves


dbt, Great Expectations/Monte Carlo for data quality; orchestration with Airflow/Prefect.
Built or contributed to production AI agents for analytics — ReAct loops, RAG over a knowledge base , MCP servers for data sources, multi-agent orchestration. Knows how to curate domain knowledge for agents so they stop hallucinating.
Ability to produce on-chain analytics (Dune/Flipside/Goldsky/Nansen tables or self-indexed data; contract ABIs; entity labeling).
Warehouse ecosystems knowledge Clickhouse, AWS, S3 buckets.
Data governance & privacy (GDPR, data minimization, retention policies).
Understanding of iGaming economics & KPIs: deposits, wagers, hold, GGR/NGR, RTP, bonus efficiency, RG metrics, and common fraud/AML patterns.
Experience with product analytics services like Amplitude, Mixpanel, Google Analytics.


What kind of culture can I expect?

Mature, mission-driven, and low-ego. We value clarity over noise, outcomes over theatrics, and pace without chaos. If you’re one of the smartest minds in your craft and want to build with other experts, you’ll feel at home here.

Title: Data Acquisition Specialist
Description:
Our Mission:

At Sunrise Robotics, we are dedicated to augmenting humanity through intelligent robotics. Our mission is to elevate the world of manufacturing by introducing intelligent, flexible robots that enhance human capabilities and existing machinery, ushering in the next era of production at higher quality, with less waste, and lower cost.

Our Vision:

We see a future where every element of manufacturing, from design to assembly, is optimised with intelligent automation. Our vision is to integrate flexible robotic solutions, based on generic hardware and advanced software/AI capabilities, into manufacturing, particularly in small and medium-sized enterprises, to make automation economically viable and accessible, for all sizes of manufacturers. We are not just building robots; we are creating the strategically crucial components for autonomous, intelligent agents of the future.

The Role

As our Data Acquisition Specialist, you sit at the point where our customers’ factories meet our product roadmap. You go deep into electronics manufacturing processes, capture how they really work, and turn that complex reality into structured data, analytics, and reporting that the product team uses to decide which robotics capabilities to build next.

You are the technical face of Sunrise in these conversations: trusted by customer engineers to understand their process, and trusted internally to translate it into evidence the product team can act on. This is a balanced, hands-on role, part time in the field with customers, part time building the data foundation.

What You’ll Do

Capture and translate customer processes:


Work directly with customer engineering and operations teams to observe, document, and map their manufacturing processes (for example PCBA, assembly, inspection, test, and material handling).
Elicit and write up process requirements, constraints, cycle times, tolerances, and failure modes in a clear, structured form.
Translate domain language in both directions between customers and our product and engineering teams.


Structure data and build the analytics foundation:


Define what data we should capture across customer engagements, and design simple, durable structures to hold it.
Build and maintain the datasets, queries, dashboards, and reports the product team relies on, using strong SQL and Python and a BI tooling.
Keep the data clean, consistent, and trustworthy across many processes and customers. You own this lightweight infrastructure end to end.


Turn data into product insight:


Analyse process and capability data to surface patterns, reuse opportunities, and gaps that should shape the roadmap.
Produce the recurring reporting and one off analyses the product team use to prioritise.
Recommend where robotics capabilities will unlock the most value, backed by evidence.


Be a technical face of the company externally:


Represent Sunrise credibly with customer technical stakeholders, both on-site and remote.
Build trust by genuinely understanding both the manufacturing process and what modern robotics software and machine learning can and cannot do for it.
Feed customer reality back into product decisions, and clear technical narratives back out to customers.


What You’ll Bring


Hands-on analytical and data skills. SQL and Python, comfort structuring messy data into usable datasets, and building dashboards and reports in a BI tool. You don’t need to be a data engineer, but you should be able to stand up lightweight data infrastructure and own it.
Deep familiarity with manufacturing processes, from either a process or industrial engineering background in any manufacturing environment, or from deploying robotics and automation into manufacturing. You can walk a factory floor and understand what you’re seeing.
Requirements capture. The ability to elicit, structure, and clearly document complex technical requirements.
Customer-facing presence. Credible, trusted, and clear with technical stakeholders; comfortable being the external technical representative of the company.
Working understanding of modern robotics and machine learning. Enough to reason about feasibility and value. You don’t need to be a practitioner, but you need to understand what it takes.
Excellent written communication. Able to turn observation and data into crisp, decision-ready narratives.


Nice to have


Direct experience in electronics manufacturing (PCBA, box build, test, or EMS / contract manufacturing environments).
Experience working alongside or within a product team.
Familiarity with data pipeline or warehouse tooling, even if it isn’t your primary muscle.
Exposure to robotics, computer vision, or machine-learning-driven automation projects.


Location and travel


Remote-first, CET +/- 3Hrs
You’ll travel to customer manufacturing sites as projects require (minimum 50% travel), with the flexibility to be on the floor when it matters most.

Description:
We're looking for a Web Analyst with strong GA4, GTM, and SQL expertise who can turn data into actionable insights. You'll build dashboards, analyze performance, and tell compelling data stories that help teams make smarter decisions. If you're independent, collaborative, and enjoy working in an inclusive environment, we'd love to hear from you.




In this role, you are going to:

Establish, maintain, review, and continuously optimize Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager (GTM) configurations to ensure absolute data accuracy and integrity
Analyze and optimize dataLayer coverage and structure to ensure robust, scalable data collection
Create and implement measurement strategies perfectly aligned with business goals, defining custom dimensions, metrics, and advanced event tracking
Utilize GA4 with all its functionalities to perform deep-dive analyses, uncover trends, and build customized reports and dashboards that turn complex data into actionable business insights
Apply familiarity with modern marketing and tracking practices to safely implement, troubleshoot, and thoroughly test tracking scripts
Partner with marketing, product, and development teams to promote data-driven decision-making and ensure tracking specs are met
Collaborate with cross-functional teams on data analysis and segmentation; support A/B testing initiatives where relevant
Contribute to broader business insights analysis, working alongside the analytics team to connect web data to wider business performance questions
Keep up-to-date with the latest privacy regulations, GA4 features, and analytics best practices




To be successful in this role, you need to have:

Demonstrated experience setting up, maintaining, reviewing, and optimizing complex Google Tag Manager and GA4 environments
Strong understanding of dataLayer architecture, including the ability to analyze coverage gaps and guide developers on optimization
Strong data analysis skills, with the ability to leverage the full suite of GA4 functionalities to answer complex business questions
Hands-on experience implementing various marketing and tracking scripts, with a disciplined approach to testing and QA
Strong SQL skills for querying and analyzing raw GA4 export data
Excellent communication skills and proficiency in spoken and written English - capable of translating intricate tracking setups and raw data into clear, stakeholder-friendly insight




Preferred skills and experience:

Familiarity with iGaming metrics and KPIs
Experience working with Google BigQuery
Knowledge of Google Data Studio / Looker Studio for creating automated, dynamic dashboards
Familiarity with Google Search Console (GSC) to connect search performance with on-site user behavior
Sufficient knowledge of A/B testing and CRO methodologies to support other roles with advanced data validation and analysis
Solid understanding of web development technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and how they impact tracking and DOM scraping
Google Analytics or Google Tag Manager certifications

By leveraging its proprietary technology, Playtech delivers innovative products and services to ensure a safe, engaging and entertaining gaming experience.



As the gaming industry's leading technology company, it combines business intelligence-driven software, services, content, and platform technology to drive excellence and innovation across the sector. Read more about who we are and what we do here: www.playtechpeople.com and www.playtech.com



Here at Playtech, we genuinely believe that people are our biggest asset. Diverse thoughts, experiences, and individual characteristics enrich our work environment and lead to better business decisions. Embracing differences and maintaining transparency in our processes is the core of Playtech's overall commitment to responsible business practices.



Ready to level up your career?



Playtech’s IMS team is on the lookout for a diligent, proactive, and detail‑oriented Reporting Engineer with strong analytical and system thinking skills





Job Description



Your influential mission. You will…



Design and develop high‑performing SQL queries and reporting solutions that handle large and complex datasets
Troubleshoot and optimize existing reports, ensuring faster performance, improved scalability, and stronger data integrity
Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to understand reporting needs and translate them into efficient technical solutions
Guarantee data consistency by analyzing dependencies between reports and proactively identifying potential issues
Continuously improve reporting processes, introducing automation and best practices to enhance efficiency


Qualifications



Components for success. You…



Have extensive knowledge of writing efficient SQL queries, spotting problematic areas, and optimizing them for performance
Possess strong experience working with large datasets and designing queries that balance speed and accuracy
Understand relational databases and database architecture at a deep level.
Demonstrate analytical thinking, attention to detail, effective time management, and strong collaboration skills
Are proactive and systematic in your approach, always seeking ways to improve processes and outcomes

You'll get extra points for…



Hands‑on experience with JavaScript, Python, or Java, especially in integrating reporting solutions with broader systems
Familiarity with data visualization tools or libraries that enhance reporting clarity
Ability to automate repetitive reporting tasks and streamline workflows

Thrive in a culture that values…



Collaboration and teamwork across diverse functions, where knowledge sharing is encouraged
Proactivity and ownership in solving complex problems, with freedom to propose new ideas
Systematic approaches that ensure scalability, reliability, and long‑term sustainability of solutions
Continuous improvement, curiosity, and a passion for learning new technologies
A supportive environment that balances high performance with personal growth

IMS UNIT

This platform enables seamless management of the player base, allowing operators to:



Optimize marketing spend and maximize ROI.



Unlock cross‑selling and conversion opportunities.



Strengthen player loyalty and lifetime value.

Title: Data Analyst II
Description:
About Us

GoCardless is a global bank payment company. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Payment Intelligence

Our mission is to make GoCardless the best way to pay and be paid. Our ambition is to dramatically improve payment performance and safeguard our customers from bad outcomes like payment fraud and failures. You will help find data opportunities and areas to improve our payment intelligence products. You should be comfortable with large data sets, customer data, and machine learning principles. You’ll work alongside Product Managers, Engineers and Data Scientists in our two core Payment Intelligence teams to provide critical insights and help drive product direction.

Our existing Payment Intelligence Products are already one of the key reasons why customers choose GoCardless. These include Protect+, which defends customers from fraud, and Success+, which helps customers intelligently recover failed payments. You will need to own our understanding of these products and identify insights and opportunities to help us develop new intelligent features.

What You'll Do

At GoCardless analytics is at the core of everything we do and drives business performance through data insight. You will play a critical role partnering closely with stakeholders across the business (including product, operations, marketing, and commercial teams) in order to deliver actionable insights to influence decisions at every level of the organisation. The role is focussed on identifying value and driving change throughout the business derived from insights. Your insights will be turned into actions that will help drive the future of GoCardless. You will act as the bridge between the data, technical and business stakeholders informing strategic plans and will own and evolve a suite of reports designed to give a wide range of stakeholders access insights.


Own and iterate on experiments to generate user insight and drive business metrics, allowing the team to quickly take action on business opportunities.
Define how we quantitatively evaluate success, setting KPIs, designing tracking to measure what really matters, delving into the leading indicators of user behaviour
Influence the organisation to increase Product Data coverage and implement user tracking best practices - acting as a mentor to guide other members of the organisation to become data driven
Build models of user-segmentation, customer lifetime value etc in order to inform strategic product & commercial decisions
Continuously innovate on the practices and the tools we rely on to deliver the right insights at the right decision points (A/B Testing, Analysis (SQL), Visualisation (Looker), Tracking (Amplitude), Automation (Python), AI (Gemini)


What Excites You


Become a strategic partner and advisor for the business: you like to proactively seek out gaps in our product capabilities, suggest areas of improvement based on tangible data, as well as owning processes to run and improve testing from the tracking point of view when developing new features.
Act as a catalyst for change across the organization, driving the evolution of our data analytics standards, internal processes, and overall product data strategy to ensure scalability and operational excellence.
Translate complex technical findings into compelling, high-impact narratives. You will bridge the gap between technical data and commercial strategy, influencing product roadmaps and executive decision-making across the entire organization.
Stay current with AI and data trends to solve real-world problems. You like to leverage these technologies to enhance the payment experience, as well as to optimize data analysis, and deliver high-impact insights and strategic recommendations across the business.
Unlocking new layers of payment performance, from uncovering new fraud vectors to maximizing success rates
Serve as a cross-functional mentor, championing a data-driven mindset and elevating the analytical capabilities of team members throughout the company.


What Excites Us


You have a background working in similar fast paced product-driven teams and are great at communicating insights to a range of audiences, including senior stakeholders, to drive data-informed product decisions
You are a self-starter, focused on results, with a demonstrated background in using analytics to drive the understanding, growth, and success of a product
You have extensive experience with data visualisation tools mentioned above and develop compelling visualisations which influence decision making and business understanding
You have advanced SQL skills and intermediate Python skills & have experience leveraging AI capabilities to enhance data analysis, automate tasks, and improve decision-making processes
You have a background working in similar fast paced teams and are great at communicating insights to a range of audiences, including senior stakeholders, to drive data-informed decisions.
You are solution-oriented and able to own projects from start to finish. You are comfortable motivating stakeholders across the business and negotiating timelines to unblock yourself and make things happen!


Salary range: the expected base salary range for this position is between €32,000 - €48,000.

Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data. Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the minimum and the mid-point of the pay range until performance can be assessed in role. Offers will take into account level of experience, interview assessment, budgets and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work.

(some of) The good stuff


Wellbeing - stay healthy with dedicated support and medical cover
Work away scheme - gives you the option to work away from your country of residence for up to 90 days in any 12 month period
Adaptive Working - allows you to work flexibly, around your lifestyle
Parental leave - to suit everyone embarking on life's great adventure
Learning Budget - lead your own development with an annual learning budget
Time off - generous holiday allowance, + 3 annual volunteer days, + 4 annual business-wide wellness days (‘GC Fridays’)


Life at GoCardless

We're an organisation defined by our values; We start with why before we begin any project, to ensure it’s aligned with our mission. We act with integrity, always. We care deeply about what we do and we know it's essential that we be humble whilst we do it. Working this way creates the GC magic- the reason we all love showing up to work.

Diversity & Inclusion

As of April 2025, we had 806 employees (GeeCees) globally, with 524 based in the UK, 163 based in Latvia and 119 across our other offices.

To Ensure That We're Representative Of The World Around Us - And To Be Able To Review Relevant Benchmarks - We Ask GeeCees To Voluntarily Disclose Diversity Data. This Year, The Proportion Of GeeCees Providing Data Increased To 88% (up From 79% In 2024). With Regards To Diversity Within GoCardless, We Can See GeeCees Identifying As

Title: Reporting Analyst
Description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

About The Role

Do you have a background in reporting or data visualisations? Ready to kick-start a rewarding career in healthcare technology?

At our newest Electronic Health Record Centre of Excellence in Letterkenny, Ireland, we're assembling a dynamic team committed to revolutionising the healthcare industry. Our mission is simple: to make the healthcare system work better for everyone. Here, you'll collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the field, and what's even more exciting is that prior Epic / electronic health records experience isn't necessary!

We're building a cutting-edge electronic healthcare records and analytics services capability, harnessing the collective expertise of our clinical, consulting, delivery, technology, and operations teams. When you join our team as EHR Reporting Analyst, you'll embark on a comprehensive training programme that equips you with the skills and knowledge needed to excel in your assigned area. You'll become a vital part of our efforts to enhance healthcare technology and improve patient care.

We're interested in individuals with experience handling and manipulating data and building reports, ideally with ideally with Microsoft SQL Server and visualisation skills (Tableau, PowerBI or similar). Solid candidates will be able to demonstrate self-motivation and team collaboration. Epic training will be provided. Most importantly, our team will foster a culture of diversity and inclusion and drive innovation for our company and our clients.

Please note: There would be an initial training program on joining where there may be an expectation to work adjusted hours, depending on trainer location/availability. Following this, hours would be standard local hours with a need for some flexibility when working with US clients.

Careers with Optum offer flexible work arrangements and individuals who live and work in the Republic of Ireland will have the opportunity to split their monthly work hours between our Letterkenny office and telecommuting from a home-based office in a hybrid work model.

Primary Responsibilities


Creating solutions out of Epic data repositories such as raw extracts, visual reports, and dashboards sourced from Microsoft SQL Server databases
Analyse customer reporting inventory and identify opportunities to consolidate, optimize, or decommission reports that are no longer needed
Utilizing SQL to create new solutions, modify existing content, and distribute the data to users and third-party vendors
Extracts Epic data utilizing approved BI tools with SQL code
Assists with Epic upgrades/updates as reporting analyst for the Epic Clarity data models
Configure and test Epic-released foundation reports and dashboards
Review peer reports for data accuracy and efficiency
The BI Developer may create new reports, using third party report writing tools to display Epic data
Communicate effectively with report consumers to explain the data and the logic behind it


You will be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role, as well as providing development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications


Proven experience building reports and data visualizations
Proven experience working with Microsoft SQL Server or other relational database platforms
Proven ability to troubleshoot technical issues related to reports, including reviewing scripts and database issues
Proven experience facilitating meetings and feedback sessions to enhance reporting and implement process improvements
Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint


Preferred Qualifications

We value a diverse range of skills and experiences. While any of the following qualifications are desirable, they are not mandatory for this role. Candidates from varied backgrounds are encouraged to apply.


Degree in Data Analytics, Business Analysis, or a related discipline
Epic certification in relevant modules
SQL Server certification
Proven experience working with Tableau, Power BI, or similar data visualization tools
Proven experience using Microsoft Project and/or Visio
Proven experience working with Microsoft SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), Visual Studio, or similar technologies
Proven experience gathering and documenting business requirements

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
At OnTheGoSystems, we're building AI systems that help people translate content across many languages. Our LLM team works with AI-generated translations, user edits, customer feedback, and quality data to continuously improve translation quality.

We're looking for a Data Analyst who enjoys solving open-ended problems, finding patterns in complex datasets, and turning data into practical recommendations. This is not a reporting role. You'll decide what to measure, investigate why things happen, and help the team make better decisions based on evidence.

What You'll Do

You'll own analytical problems from start to finish.

For example, you may discover that users edit translations much more often for one language pair than another. Instead of simply reporting it, you'll investigate why. You'll form hypotheses, gather the data, test possible explanations, and recommend the next steps.

Your work will include:


Defining meaningful metrics for translation quality, AI performance, and user behavior
Monitoring trends and identifying unusual patterns or quality issues
Turning observations into structured investigations and testing multiple hypotheses
Extracting and combining data from SQL databases, NoSQL databases, logs, APIs, and CSV exports
Comparing results across language pairs, AI models, providers, customers, content types, traffic levels, and other dimensions
Separating real signals from coincidence by validating findings with data
Reviewing translation samples to confirm whether patterns represent genuine quality issues
Investigating root causes and recommending practical improvements
Evaluating multilingual AI output for meaning, terminology, tone, formality, grammar, pronouns, and consistency
Using AI tools, dictionaries, and other resources to investigate languages you don't speak, while recognizing when expert linguistic input is needed
Reviewing AI-generated analyses, identifying incorrect conclusions, and helping improve our automated evaluation systems
Building repeatable reports, scripts, and monitoring processes
Communicating findings clearly to developers, product managers, and linguists


Requirements


Strong analytical thinking, curiosity, and attention to detail
The ability to work independently and define what should be investigated
Experience turning open-ended questions into structured analyses and actionable recommendations
A solid understanding of metrics, segmentation, distributions, correlations, and the difference between correlation and causation
Experience writing SQL, Python, or similar scripts to collect, clean, and analyze data
Experience working with multiple data sources, including databases, logs, APIs, and exported datasets
Strong hands-on experience using AI tools while critically evaluating their output
Fluent English plus at least one additional language (preferably European), with the ability to assess translation quality and explain language issues
Clear written communication and the ability to explain analytical findings to non-technical colleagues


Bonus points for experience with:


Translation quality or localization
Multilingual content
Data visualization or business intelligence tools


Benefits

You'll work on real AI systems used by customers around the world and directly influence how we measure and improve machine translation quality.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys exploring difficult questions, testing ideas, and discovering insights that aren't immediately obvious. You'll have the freedom to propose your own analyses and the responsibility to turn them into evidence-based recommendations.

What We Offer


100% remote work
Body & Mind Movement program
Home office computer budget
Kindle with access to our company library
Local public holidays respected
Excellent opportunities for growth
Collaboration with talented colleagues across the globe


If you're excited by data, languages, AI, and solving complex problems, apply now, and we'd love to hear from you!

Title: Supply Chain Master Data Analyst
Description:
The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Meet The Team

New ideas have a way of becoming not only great products but also best in class practices that can significantly enhance the customer experience. At Dexcom you can make a difference in the lives of millions across the world!

Reporting to the Sr Supply Chain Manager, this role contributes to the coordination of Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) and supports product lifecycle activities, ensuring that system data is accurate and updated in a timely manner. You will help enable effective planning, scheduling, warehouse and execution processes aligned with Dexcom’s operational standards.

Where You Come In


You will collect, validate, and update master data required for Purchasing (Buy Items), Production Planning (Make Items), Warehousing and Inventory processes
You will ensure data accuracy and completeness within ERP systems
You will support coordination and implementation of Engineering Change Orders across make and buy items, assist with updating system data in line with approved changes, Track ECO progress and escalate issues where required
You will assist in managing Phase-in / phase-out of parts, Product revision changes
You will ensure updates are reflected accurately in systems to support production and procurement readiness
You will provide accurate data inputs to support MRP and planning activities
You will support resolution of data-related issues impacting Supply Chain operations
You will identify and support improvements in data accuracy and processes
You will follow established data governance and change control procedures


What Makes You Successful


You have had exposure to master data, planning and purchasing processes
You have familiarity with item master data structures
You are an advanced user of Microsoft Excel, Copilot, Outlook, Teams and Smartsheets is preferable
You have experience in the medical device or CPG industry
You have experience with Oracle EBS, Oracle Fusion, PLM and Anaplan systems networks is advantageous


Experience And Education Requirements


Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field and a minimum of 2-5 years of related experience.


What You’ll Get


A front row seat to life changing CGM technology.
A full and comprehensive benefits program.
Growth opportunities on a global scale.
Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.
An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.


Travel Required


0-5%

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description

More about our mission and what we offer.

We’re looking for a Lead Data Analyst who is passionate about our mission of Money Without Borders to partner with our operational teams to help drive data-driven decisions that would support our fast-growing product through scaling and optimising the team.

As a Lead Data Analyst, you'll be driving our analytics efforts in our operations teams, who do everything from support our customers when they need help, to screening for criminal activity, to verifying customer identities at scale.

Most importantly, you’ll collaborate closely with your operational leads, as well as workforce management, quality, training, and knowledge management, to bring your insights into real change for our customers and help drive our mission!

Analytical Capacity Planning and Forecasting. Focus on building and refining analytical models for strategic capacity planning. Take ownership of forecasting efforts to align with business growth and operational demands.
Data Pipeline Ownership. Take ownership of data pipelines to maintain and improve data flow, ensuring reliability and accuracy.
Predictive Modeling and Cause and Effect Analysis. Develop and implement robust models to predict outcomes and perform cause and effect analysis to identify key drivers, optimise processes, and enhance decision-making and strategic planning.
Strategic Support and Analysis. Provide critical insights to assess the operational health of the KYC/FinCrime function, conduct in-depth cost analysis, and offer detailed analysis of operational metrics (including quality) to understand impacts on customer experiences.
Performance Tracking and Initiative Optimisation. Monitor and track the performance of key strategic initiatives, capitalising on optimisation opportunities to enhance operational outcomes.
KPI Implementation and Target Setting. Lead the development and implementation of the operations KPI tree and the target-setting framework, integrating these within reporting pipelines and strategic operations.

Title: BI datu analītiķis/-e
HTML:
Biznesa datu analītiķis/-e

Baložu iela 20a, Āgenskalns· Hibrīds

  • Pilna laika

Dati ir daudz vērtīgāki par skaitļiem – tie palīdz pieņemt gudrākus lēmumus. Ja Tevi aizrauj un uzrunā Power BI, SQL un datu analīze, kā arī vēlies būt daļa no uzņēmuma datu attīstības un veidot risinājumus, kas ietekmē biznesa rezultātus, pievienojies MADARA Cosmetics finanšu departamentam.

MĒS TEV UZTICĒSIM

  • Izstrādāt, uzturēt un pilnveidot Power BI atskaites, informācijas paneļus (dashboards) un datu modeļus;
  • rakstīt un optimizēt SQL vaicājumus lielu datu apjomu apstrādei no datubāzēm un datu noliktavas;
  • līdzdarboties uzņēmuma pārejā uz mākoņa datu noliktavu (Google BigQuery), sadarbojoties ar datu inženieriem datu avotu un Power BI atskaišu migrācijā, kā arī testēt un validēt rezultātus;
  • sadarboties ar kolēģiem un vadību, lai noskaidrotu vajadzības, definētu rādītājus un sagatavotu skaidras, praktiski izmantojamas atskaites;
  • rūpēties par datu kvalitāti, konsekvenci un dokumentāciju.

MĒS SAGAIDĀM

  • Pieredze datu analīzē / BI, vēlams 2+ gadi;
  • praktiskas iemaņas darbā ar Power BI (DAX, Power BI Service);
  • labas SQL zināšanas - spēja pašam rakstīt un optimizēt sarežģītus vaicājumus;
  • izpratne par datubāzēm, datu noliktavu principiem un ETL/datu plūsmu pamatiem;
  • vēlama pamata izpratne par datu arhitektūras procesiem, lai spētu koordinēt migrāciju uz BigQuery un runāt vienā valodā ar tehnisko komandu;
  • iepriekšēja pieredze ar Google BigQuery (tiks uzskatīta par priekšrocību);
  • pieredze datu migrācijas projektā vai datu platformas pārejas koordinēšanā (tiks uzskatīta par priekšrocību);
  • labas komunikācijas un sadarbības prasmes - spēja izskaidrot tehniskus jautājumus arī netehniskiem kolēģiem;
  • precizitāti, augstu atbildības sajūtu un spēju ievērot termiņus;
  • proaktīvu pieeju darbam un vēlmi iesaistīties procesu uzlabošanā;
  • spēju patstāvīgi organizēt savu darbu un prioritātes;
  • labas angļu valodas zināšanas profesionālai saziņai ar sadarbības partneriem un dokumentu izpratnei.

MĒS PIEDĀVĀJAM

  • Pilna laika darbu klātienē un attālināti, darba dienās plkst. 9:00-18.00, adrese: Laubes nams, Baložu iela 20A;
  • atbalstošus un profesionālus kolēģus, ar kuriem dalīties pieredzē;
  • aizraujošu pilna laika darbu dinamiskā, mūsdienīgā un augošā uzņēmumā, kur varēsi realizēt savas idejas un attīstīt potenciālu;
  • iespēju augt, attīstīties un pilnveidoties;
  • iespēju daļu laika strādāt attālināti;
  • sociālās garantijas, veselības un nelaimes gadījuma apdrošināšanas polisi pēc pārbaudes laika;
  • Bonusa karti 50 EUR vērtībā katru mēnesi (iespēja tērēt ēdināšanai, transportam, ārstniecībai) pēc pārbaudes laika;
  • papildus atvaļinājuma dienas (par darba stāžu, par bērniem, dzimšanas dienas brīvdiena utt.);
  • īpašas darbinieku atlaides MÁDARA produktiem;
  • iespēju ar kolēģiem satikties uzņēmuma kopīgi organizētajos pasākumos un atsevišķi komandu pasākumos;
  • Atalgojums (bruto): no 3000 līdz 3400 EUR.

AS MADARA Cosmetics ir vieta, kur ikviens var justies piederīgs. Kopā mēs veidojam daudzveidīgu, atvērtu un pieņemošu darba vidi. Sūti pieteikumu un esi, kas esi — tieši autentiskums un individualitāte padara mūs izcilus.

Mūs vieno vēlme darīt lietas labāk, vairāk, citādāk – MÁDARA ir vieta, kur tu varēsi augt, attīstīt talantus un atklāt sevī jaunas spējas. Augsim un veidosim nākotni kopā – vērienīgu, ilgtspējīgu un skaistu.

Title: Duomenų mokslo analitikas (-ė)
Description:
„IKI“ – tai vieta, kur žmonės, nepriklausomai nuo to, ar dirba biure, parduotuvėse, gamyboje ar logistikoje, aistrą pirmauti verčia ambicingais pasiekimais! Pirmieji Lietuvoje pristatėme prancūziškus kruasanus ir bagetes, atidarėme autonominę parduotuvę, įdiegėme savitarnos kasas ir elektronines kainų etiketes. Šie žingsniai atspindi mūsų nuolatinį siekį būti žingsniu priekyje ir kurti ateities mažmeninę prekybą – inovatyvią bei tvarią. Jei ieškai dinamiškos, idėjoms atviros aplinkos, kurioje galėtum augti ir kurti naujoves, gali būti, kad darbas „IKI“ yra arčiau tavęs!

Šiame darbe tu:


Kursi, diegsi ir prižiūrėsi statistinius modelius, prognozavimo algoritmus bei mašininio mokymosi sprendimus.
Analizuosi verslo eksperimentų (A/B testų, pilotinių projektų) rezultatus ir vertinsi jų poveikį verslo rodikliams.
Automatizuosi analitinius procesus.
Vizualizuosi analizės rezultatus, rengsi įžvalgas ir rekomendacijas, padedančias priimti duomenimis grįstus verslo sprendimus.
Bendradarbiausi su IT, prekybos, rinkodaros, tiekimo grandinės ir logistikos komandomis, ieškant galimybių gerinti veiklos rezultatus pasitelkiant duomenų analitiką.
Nagrinėsi struktūrizuotus ir nestruktūrizuotus duomenis, identifikuosi tendencijas, dėsningumus bei priežastinius ryšius.
Prisidėsi prie analitikos metodikų, standartų ir gerųjų praktikų kūrimo bei jų diegimo organizacijoje.


Tikimės, kad tu:


Turi universitetinį išsilavinimą tiksliųjų mokslų srityje (matematikos, informatikos, ekonomikos, fizikos ir kt.)
Turi ne mažesnę kaip 2 metų patirtį dirbant duomenų mokslo, analitikos srityje
Turi gerus Python, SQL ir Excel įgūdžius
Puikiai bendrauji anglų kalba
Gebi savarankiškai vykdyti analizės projektus – nuo verslo problemos identifikavimo iki sprendimo rekomendacijų pateikimo


„IKI“ pasiūlymas tau:

Atlyginimas ir finansinė gerovė


atlyginimas: 2800 – 3800 €/mėn. (neatskaičius mokesčių, priklausomai nuo tavo patirties ir įgūdžių),
galėsi pigiau apsipirkti „IKI“ prekybos centruose,
turėsi nuolaidas „IKI“ asortimento naujienoms,
daugiau nei 300 MELP ir partnerių nuolaidų kone visiems gyvenimo atvejams.  


Darbo aplinka ir lankstumas


hibridinis darbo modelis: galimybė dirbti patogiame „IKI“ biure arba namuose,
lankstumas pasirenkant darbo valandas,
įkvėpimui – darbostogos iki 30 d. per metus.


Karjera ir tobulėjimas


karjeros galimybės (tiek Lietuvoje, tiek užsienyje),
profesinio tobulėjimo galimybės (tiek su kolegomis, tiek ir individualiai).


Sveikata ir emocinė gerovė


papildomas sveikatos draudimas, kurį galėsi rinktis net iš 3 planų,
nemokamos sveikatos patikros biure,
dalyvavimas „Walk15“, vidinėse badmintono, dviračių, žygių mėgėjų sporto grupėse,
streso valdymo ir kiti emocinės gerovės mokymai, galimybė gauti anonimines psichologo konsultacijas telefonu.     


Stipri bendruomenė


stiprybėmis grįsta kultūra, kurioje vertinamos visų darbuotojų unikalios savybės ir pasiekimai,
kolegas pagal laisvalaikio veiklas kviečiame burtis į „Hobby Spotlight” klubus,
darbuotojų fondas „VeIKIme drauge“,
esame aktyvūs bendruomenės nariai – savanoriaudami ir finansine parama prisidedame prie „Maisto banko“ ir kitų organizacijų.  


Inovacijos ir dinamiškumas


modernūs darbo įrankiai ir programos,
inovatyvūs sprendimai prekyboje, tvarumo ir kitose srityse,
mūsų komandos projektus ir pasiekimus kviečiame pažinti čia: Tvarumas | IKI. Arčiau Tavęs!


Skamba kaip darbas arčiau tavęs ir tavo tikslų?

Pasidalink savo CV arba susisiek su mūsų atrankų specialiste Vilte, telefonu +370 658 99876 arba LinkedIn platformoje.

Title: Senior IT Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description

Senior Data Analyst

The Role

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will work closely with business and technical teams to drive the creation of scalable and documented data design solutions. They drive adoption of enterprise and industry standard modeling methodologies. They partner with project teams to deliver practical & resilient data model designs that meet business needs and are capable of easily adapting to future business requirements.

The Expertise and Skills You Bring

Requirements And Analysis


Engage with business and technology partners to understand the business requirements, analyze data gaps, and recommend appropriate solutions.
Assess objectives, use cases, data requirements and specifications documents created by other analysts
Analyze and resolve major data issues that arise during the course of projects or in production environments


Data Design


You are an experienced enterprise data modeler who can define conceptual and logical data models, with strong definitions, to capture organizational data needs across multiple subject areas
Create physical design from logical data models for different types of systems such as operational systems, data warehouses, data lakes and others
Research to identify effective data designs, new tools and methodologies for data analysis
Document and present database solutions to product partners for approval.
Promote common data API adoption and reuse.
Map Technical terms to Business terms in data catalog tool.


Technical Leadership


Ensure technology decisions align with enterprise standards and strategy.
Collaborate with DBAs, architects, subject area owners to create scalable data models.
Find opportunities to utilize enterprise data model for new projects to minimize work and data redundancy


Education And Experience

A Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience


5+ years’ experience with data design, analysis and development. Development experience weighted towards PL/SQL and data loading tool/concepts.
Demonstrated experience in the following areas: Data API design and implementation, PL/SQL, data warehouses, data modeling and data profiling.


Skills And Knowledge


Demonstrable experience with SAP Power Designer or similar data modeling tool.
Proficient analytical and problem solving skills
Solid understanding of the database development process including analysis, design, coding, testing, problem resolution and planning, and full competency in all relevant coding environments, languages, tools, and platforms
Good interpersonal skills and strong verbal and written skills to effectively communicate with technical and non-technical associates in the company
Proven interpersonal skills, including the ability to work across the organization and interact/influence/negotiate optimally at all levels of management and peers.
Experience working in cross-functional agile development teams.
Understanding of Financial Services.


The Team

Asset Management Technology is seeking a Senior level candidate in the analysis and data modeling organization. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading analysis and data modeling across different projects with diverse scope and complex business and technical requirements in a highly integrated data environment. This role requires working under experienced leaders, for achieving organizational strategic data goals. You must be comfortable working in a fast paced and highly ambiguous agile environment where there is a focus on timely delivery of data models and other data artifacts.

AM Tech is a global organization, with technologists located across the United States, London, India, and Ireland. The team supports a broad range of functions within the Investment Management and Advisory domain, including Portfolio Management, Research, and Trading, by providing reliable, high impact technology solutions.

We are currently working in a hybrid model with some flexibility for remote working. However, Fidelity is gradually transitioning towards a full-time return to the office. We believe this will help strengthen our culture and enhance both the associate and customer experience. At present, this transition is expected from 2027 onwards, with no fixed timeline in place.

Apie mus

Lietuvos Respublikos socialinės apsaugos ir darbo ministerija yra valstybės institucija, formuojanti ir įgyvendinanti socialinės apsaugos bei darbo politiką. Mūsų tikslas – kurti žmonėms palankią aplinką, stiprinti socialinę gerovę ir gerinti visų Lietuvos gyventojų gyvenimo kokybę.

Pastaraisiais metais ministerija padarė reikšmingą proveržį duomenų analitikos srityje ir tapo viena iš šios srities lyderių Lietuvos viešajame sektoriuje. Jei esi smalsus (-i), iniciatyvus (-i), domiesi duomenų analitika ir nori prisidėti prie modernios, duomenimis grįstos organizacijos kūrimo, kviečiame prisijungti prie mūsų komandos.


Ką veiksi?

Prisijungęs (-usi) prie Strateginių sprendimų paramos grupės:

  • dirbsi su didelės apimties ir sudėtingais duomenų rinkiniais;
  • vertinsi duomenų kokybę ir patikimumą;
  • analizuosi duomenis;
  • analitines įžvalgas paversi aiškiomis rekomendacijomis sprendimų priėmėjams;
  • bendradarbiausi su įvairiais ministerijos padaliniais ir kitomis institucijomis.


Tikimės, kad Tu:

  • gerai moki dirbti su SQL ir Python (privaloma);
  • turi patirties dirbant su Palantir (tai būtų didelis privalumas);
  • moki naudotis R, SPSS ar Stata (privalumas);
  • pasižymi analitiniu mąstymu ir gebėjimu spręsti sudėtingas problemas;
  • gebi dirbti savarankiškai ir efektyviai bendradarbiauti su skirtingomis komandomis bei institucijomis;
  • aiškiai ir argumentuotai pristatai analizės rezultatus bei rekomendacijas;
  • esi kruopštus (-i) ir gebi dirbti su dideliais duomenų kiekiais;
  • laisvai bendrauji lietuvių ir anglų kalbomis.

  • prasmingą darbą, kurio rezultatai daro įtaką šimtų tūkstančių Lietuvos gyventojų gyvenimui;
  • hibridinį darbo modelį (paprastai 2 darbo dienos per savaitę biure Vilniuje);
  • papildomą sveikatos draudimą;
  • draugišką, profesionalią ir palaikančią komandą;
  • papildomas mokamas atostogų dienas mokymuisi ir sveikatos poreikiams;
  • profesinio tobulėjimo ir kvalifikacijos kėlimo galimybes;
  • darbo užmokestį nuo 2 700 iki 3 000 Eur bruto, priklausomai nuo turimos patirties, su galimybe jį didinti pagal pasiektus rezultatus.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
At OnTheGoSystems, we're building AI systems that help people translate content across many languages. Our LLM team works with AI-generated translations, user edits, customer feedback, and quality data to continuously improve translation quality.

We're looking for a Data Analyst who enjoys solving open-ended problems, finding patterns in complex datasets, and turning data into practical recommendations. This is not a reporting role. You'll decide what to measure, investigate why things happen, and help the team make better decisions based on evidence.

What You'll Do

You'll own analytical problems from start to finish.

For example, you may discover that users edit translations much more often for one language pair than another. Instead of simply reporting it, you'll investigate why. You'll form hypotheses, gather the data, test possible explanations, and recommend the next steps.

Your work will include:


Defining meaningful metrics for translation quality, AI performance, and user behavior
Monitoring trends and identifying unusual patterns or quality issues
Turning observations into structured investigations and testing multiple hypotheses
Extracting and combining data from SQL databases, NoSQL databases, logs, APIs, and CSV exports
Comparing results across language pairs, AI models, providers, customers, content types, traffic levels, and other dimensions
Separating real signals from coincidence by validating findings with data
Reviewing translation samples to confirm whether patterns represent genuine quality issues
Investigating root causes and recommending practical improvements
Evaluating multilingual AI output for meaning, terminology, tone, formality, grammar, pronouns, and consistency
Using AI tools, dictionaries, and other resources to investigate languages you don't speak, while recognizing when expert linguistic input is needed
Reviewing AI-generated analyses, identifying incorrect conclusions, and helping improve our automated evaluation systems
Building repeatable reports, scripts, and monitoring processes
Communicating findings clearly to developers, product managers, and linguists


Requirements


Strong analytical thinking, curiosity, and attention to detail
The ability to work independently and define what should be investigated
Experience turning open-ended questions into structured analyses and actionable recommendations
A solid understanding of metrics, segmentation, distributions, correlations, and the difference between correlation and causation
Experience writing SQL, Python, or similar scripts to collect, clean, and analyze data
Experience working with multiple data sources, including databases, logs, APIs, and exported datasets
Strong hands-on experience using AI tools while critically evaluating their output
Fluent English plus at least one additional language (preferably European), with the ability to assess translation quality and explain language issues
Clear written communication and the ability to explain analytical findings to non-technical colleagues


Bonus points for experience with:


Translation quality or localization
Multilingual content
Data visualization or business intelligence tools


Benefits

You'll work on real AI systems used by customers around the world and directly influence how we measure and improve machine translation quality.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys exploring difficult questions, testing ideas, and discovering insights that aren't immediately obvious. You'll have the freedom to propose your own analyses and the responsibility to turn them into evidence-based recommendations.

What We Offer


100% remote work
Body & Mind Movement program
Home office computer budget
Kindle with access to our company library
Local public holidays respected
Excellent opportunities for growth
Collaboration with talented colleagues across the globe


If you're excited by data, languages, AI, and solving complex problems, apply now, and we'd love to hear from you!

Role Profile

Job Title: Data Analyst

Business Unit: Data Services Unit, State Claims Agency

Reports to: Senior Data Analyst

Contract: Permanent

*Closing date for applications: 14th August 2026*

Summary of the Business

The NTMA provides a range of asset and liability management services to Government. These services include borrowing on behalf of the Government and management of the National Debt, the State Claims Agency, NewERA, the Ireland Strategic Investment Fund and the National Development Finance Agency. It also assigns staff and provides business and support services and systems to the National Asset Management Agency, the Strategic Banking Corporation of Ireland and Home Building Finance Ireland.

The NTMA is designated as the State Claims Agency (SCA) when performing the claims management and risk management functions delegated to it under the National Treasury Management Agency (Amendment) Act 2000.

The SCA’s principal objectives are:


While acting in the best interest of taxpayers, to act fairly and ethically in its dealings with people who have suffered injuries and who take legal actions against the State or State bodies, and the families of these people; and
To implement targeted personal injury and property damage risk work programmes to mitigate litigation risk in State authorities and healthcare enterprises, in order to reduce the costs of future litigation against the State.



The SCA’s remit covers personal injury and third-party property damage risks and claims relating to certain State authorities including the State itself, Government ministers, the Attorney General, the Health Service Executive, the voluntary healthcare sector, An Garda Síochána, the Irish Prison Service, the Defence Forces and community and comprehensive schools. It also manages third-party costs arising from certain Tribunals of Inquiry.

Role Summary

This is an exciting opportunity for a talented and motivated individual to join the SCA’s Data Services Unit. The role provides a great opportunity for an individual with a track record of delivery of analytics solutions in a way that assists business units in the execution of key mandates and discovers insights from our data resources. This contributes to the management of claims and risk across personal injury and third party property damage claims across over 250 State authorities.

The successful candidate will work in a small team within the Data Services Unit of the SCA which will be responsible for further developing the capability in respect of predictive modelling in areas that can assist the SCA in the execution of our principal objectives. All members of the Data Services Unit are required to remain flexible and respond to the nature of the SCA business and mandates.

Principal Accountabilities

The Data Analyst will be required to work as part of team comprising one team lead, and one junior analyst, working alongside the other teams within the Data Services Unit, and cross-functionally with other teams in Operations and Corporate Affairs division in addition to the broader State Claims Agency.

Key responsibilities will include:


Actively investigate and pursue other publicly available data sources which could complement the internal data sources and model where appropriate to assist in the execution of the SCA’s principal objectives.
Pursue a mandate of continuous improvement in terms of tooling, processes, and documentation, and engage with cross functional planning and execution teams to drive positive outcomes for the SCA.
Interact, communicate, and gather requirements from a wide variety of stakeholders.
Proactively consider the utilisation of NIMS data to assist in the delivery of the SCA functions and provide innovative analytical and technical solutions to drive improvements and provide new business insights to the SCA.
Communicate and present analytical findings to all levels in the organisation.
Deep-dive statistical analysis of large and complex qualitative and quantitative data sets to support risk and claims management initiatives.
Assist in other activities when required and support the Senior Analyst.



Skills


Strong communication skills, verbal and written.
Proven ability to deliver in a demanding environment with conflicting priorities and deadlines and comfortable with changing priorities.
A positive approach to problem solving and track record of exploring possible solutions
A self-motivated, diligent and flexible individual. Ability to work collaboratively internally and externally.



Knowledge & Experience

The ideal candidate will have:


Knowledge of statistics, predictive modelling and related programming tools, R and Python.
A qualification in analytics, statistics, mathematics, engineering, IT or relevant business area to at least degree or master’s level.
Experience in delivering best in class analytics and reporting capabilities to meet various business needs.
Knowledge & experience of Microsoft Power BI, Tableau and/or other market leading analytics tools is an advantage.
Track record of working with key stakeholders in generating clear, actionable business requirements for predictive modelling requests.
3 years’ experience in relevant analysis and delivery of data solutions in the format of BI reports, dashboards, statistical reports etc.
Experience in change management and the relevant impacts on data management activities.
