Achoimre ar an nGnó

Cuireann GBCN réimse seirbhísí bainistíochta sócmhainní agus dliteanas ar fáil don Rialtas. I measc na seirbhísí sin tá iasachtaí a thógáil amach don Rialtas agus bainistíocht an Fhiachais Náisiúnta, na Gníomhaireachta um Éilimh ar an Stát, RÉnua, Chiste Infheistíochta Straitéisí na hÉireann agus na Gníomhaireachta Airgeadais d’Fhorbairt Náisiúnta. Freisin, sannann sé baill foirne don Ghníomhaireacht Náisiúnta um Bainistíocht Sócmhainní, do Chorparáid Baincéireachta Straitéisí na hÉireann agus do Mhaoiniú Teaghais-Tógála Éireann, agus cuireann sé seirbhísí gnó agus tacaíochta ar fáil dóibh.

Tá GBCN ainmnithe mar an Ghníomhaireacht um Éilimh ar an Stát (GÉS) agus comhlíonann sé na feidhmeanna maidir le bainistíocht éileamh agus bainistíocht riosca a tharmligtear chuige faoin Acht um Ghníomhaireacht Bainistíochta an Chisteáin Náisiúnta (Leasú), 2000 .

Is iad príomhchuspóirí GÉS:


Agus é ag gníomhú ar mhaithe le leas na gcáiníocóirí, gníomhú go heiticiúil, cóir agus é ag déileáil le daoine ar baineadh gortú dóibh agus a thógann caingne dlí in aghaidh an Stáit nó in aghaidh comhlachtaí Stáit, agus le teaghlaigh na ndaoine sin; agus

Role Profile

Job Title: Data Analyst

Business Unit: Data Services Unit, State Claims Agency

Reports to: Senior Data Analyst

Contract: Permanent

*Closing date for applications: 14th August 2026*

Summary of the Business

The NTMA provides a range of asset and liability management services to Government. These services include borrowing on behalf of the Government and management of the National Debt, the State Claims Agency, NewERA, the Ireland Strategic Investment Fund and the National Development Finance Agency. It also assigns staff and provides business and support services and systems to the National Asset Management Agency, the Strategic Banking Corporation of Ireland and Home Building Finance Ireland.

The NTMA is designated as the State Claims Agency (SCA) when performing the claims management and risk management functions delegated to it under the National Treasury Management Agency (Amendment) Act 2000.

The SCA’s principal objectives are:

  • While acting in the best interest of taxpayers, to act fairly and ethically in its dealings with people who have suffered injuries and who take legal actions against the State or State bodies, and the families of these people; and
  • To implement targeted personal injury and property damage risk work programmes to mitigate litigation risk in State authorities and healthcare enterprises, in order to reduce the costs of future litigation against the State.


The SCA’s remit covers personal injury and third-party property damage risks and claims relating to certain State authorities including the State itself, Government ministers, the Attorney General, the Health Service Executive, the voluntary healthcare sector, An Garda Síochána, the Irish Prison Service, the Defence Forces and community and comprehensive schools. It also manages third-party costs arising from certain Tribunals of Inquiry.

Role Summary

This is an exciting opportunity for a talented and motivated individual to join the SCA’s Data Services Unit. The role provides a great opportunity for an individual with a track record of delivery of analytics solutions in a way that assists business units in the execution of key mandates and discovers insights from our data resources. This contributes to the management of claims and risk across personal injury and third party property damage claims across over 250 State authorities.

The successful candidate will work in a small team within the Data Services Unit of the SCA which will be responsible for further developing the capability in respect of predictive modelling in areas that can assist the SCA in the execution of our principal objectives. All members of the Data Services Unit are required to remain flexible and respond to the nature of the SCA business and mandates.

Principal Accountabilities

The Data Analyst will be required to work as part of team comprising one team lead, and one junior analyst, working alongside the other teams within the Data Services Unit, and cross-functionally with other teams in Operations and Corporate Affairs division in addition to the broader State Claims Agency.

Key responsibilities will include:

  • Actively investigate and pursue other publicly available data sources which could complement the internal data sources and model where appropriate to assist in the execution of the SCA’s principal objectives.
  • Pursue a mandate of continuous improvement in terms of tooling, processes, and documentation, and engage with cross functional planning and execution teams to drive positive outcomes for the SCA.
  • Interact, communicate, and gather requirements from a wide variety of stakeholders.
  • Proactively consider the utilisation of NIMS data to assist in the delivery of the SCA functions and provide innovative analytical and technical solutions to drive improvements and provide new business insights to the SCA.
  • Communicate and present analytical findings to all levels in the organisation.
  • Deep-dive statistical analysis of large and complex qualitative and quantitative data sets to support risk and claims management initiatives.
  • Assist in other activities when required and support the Senior Analyst.


Skills

  • Strong communication skills, verbal and written.
  • Proven ability to deliver in a demanding environment with conflicting priorities and deadlines and comfortable with changing priorities.
  • A positive approach to problem solving and track record of exploring possible solutions
  • A self-motivated, diligent and flexible individual. Ability to work collaboratively internally and externally.


Knowledge & Experience

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Knowledge of statistics, predictive modelling and related programming tools, R and Python.
  • A qualification in analytics, statistics, mathematics, engineering, IT or relevant business area to at least degree or master’s level.
  • Experience in delivering best in class analytics and reporting capabilities to meet various business needs.
  • Knowledge & experience of Microsoft Power BI, Tableau and/or other market leading analytics tools is an advantage.
  • Track record of working with key stakeholders in generating clear, actionable business requirements for predictive modelling requests.
  • 3 years’ experience in relevant analysis and delivery of data solutions in the format of BI reports, dashboards, statistical reports etc.
  • Experience in change management and the relevant impacts on data management activities.

Baložu iela 20a, Āgenskalns· Hibrīds

  • Pilna laika

Dati ir daudz vērtīgāki par skaitļiem – tie palīdz pieņemt gudrākus lēmumus. Ja Tevi aizrauj un uzrunā Power BI, SQL un datu analīze, kā arī vēlies būt daļa no uzņēmuma datu attīstības un veidot risinājumus, kas ietekmē biznesa rezultātus, pievienojies MADARA Cosmetics finanšu departamentam.

MĒS TEV UZTICĒSIM

  • Izstrādāt, uzturēt un pilnveidot Power BI atskaites, informācijas paneļus (dashboards) un datu modeļus;
  • rakstīt un optimizēt SQL vaicājumus lielu datu apjomu apstrādei no datubāzēm un datu noliktavas;
  • līdzdarboties uzņēmuma pārejā uz mākoņa datu noliktavu (Google BigQuery), sadarbojoties ar datu inženieriem datu avotu un Power BI atskaišu migrācijā, kā arī testēt un validēt rezultātus;
  • sadarboties ar kolēģiem un vadību, lai noskaidrotu vajadzības, definētu rādītājus un sagatavotu skaidras, praktiski izmantojamas atskaites;
  • rūpēties par datu kvalitāti, konsekvenci un dokumentāciju.

MĒS SAGAIDĀM

  • Pieredze datu analīzē / BI, vēlams 2+ gadi;
  • praktiskas iemaņas darbā ar Power BI (DAX, Power BI Service);
  • labas SQL zināšanas - spēja pašam rakstīt un optimizēt sarežģītus vaicājumus;
  • izpratne par datubāzēm, datu noliktavu principiem un ETL/datu plūsmu pamatiem;
  • vēlama pamata izpratne par datu arhitektūras procesiem, lai spētu koordinēt migrāciju uz BigQuery un runāt vienā valodā ar tehnisko komandu;
  • iepriekšēja pieredze ar Google BigQuery (tiks uzskatīta par priekšrocību);
  • pieredze datu migrācijas projektā vai datu platformas pārejas koordinēšanā (tiks uzskatīta par priekšrocību);
  • labas komunikācijas un sadarbības prasmes - spēja izskaidrot tehniskus jautājumus arī netehniskiem kolēģiem;
  • precizitāti, augstu atbildības sajūtu un spēju ievērot termiņus;
  • proaktīvu pieeju darbam un vēlmi iesaistīties procesu uzlabošanā;
  • spēju patstāvīgi organizēt savu darbu un prioritātes;
  • labas angļu valodas zināšanas profesionālai saziņai ar sadarbības partneriem un dokumentu izpratnei.

MĒS PIEDĀVĀJAM

  • Pilna laika darbu klātienē un attālināti, darba dienās plkst. 9:00-18.00, adrese: Laubes nams, Baložu iela 20A;

  • iespēju daļu laika strādāt attālināti;
  • sociālās garantijas, veselības un nelaimes gadījuma apdrošināšanas polisi pēc pārbaudes laika;

  • papildus atvaļinājuma dienas (par darba stāžu, par bērniem, dzimšanas dienas brīvdiena utt.);
  • īpašas darbinieku atlaides MÁDARA produktiem;
  • iespēju ar kolēģiem satikties uzņēmuma kopīgi organizētajos pasākumos un atsevišķi komandu pasākumos;
  • Atalgojums (bruto): no 3000 līdz 3400 EUR.

About the role




At Cosylab we build software for the world's most advanced scientific and medical systems — particle accelerators, telescopes, fusion reactors, and cancer treatment devices. Our technology helps organizations drive scientific discovery, advance cancer care, and bring clean fusion energy closer to reality.




You will be joining our business analytics team, where your main tasks will involve preparing data for analytical and operational use, working with our data warehouse, and creating reports for internal users of the company, such as management, production, marketing, sales, finance, and others.




Key tasks and responsibilities




Development and maintenance of ETL processes for transferring data into the data warehouse.
Preparation and maintenance of data for reports (views, tables, and scheduled jobs).
Gather and define requirements with internal stakeholders (management, development, sales, finance, and others) and deliver corresponding data solutions.
Integrate new data sources in line with evolving business needs.
Collaborating on the modernization of internal data infrastructure.




Required Qualifications and Skills




Minimum of 2 years of experience in a comparable data engineering or analytics role.
Strong knowledge of SQL.
Understanding of ETL processes and data pipelines.
Solid understanding of data modeling and how to structure data for reliable reporting and analysis.
Comfortable working directly with business users to understand what they need and build data that delivers it.
Proactiveness, a strong sense of responsibility, and well-developed communication and teamwork skills.




You'll stand out if you have experience with




Familiarity with the Microsoft data stack (SQL Server, SSIS, Power Query).
Experience developing reports in Microsoft Power BI.
Interest in AI tools and ideas for applying them to optimize workflows.
Working knowledge of React sufficient to support the maintenance of an internal web application.




Education




Bachelor of Science in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or another related technical field.
Fluency in spoken and written English.




What we offer




Employment contract for an indefinite period with a six-month probationary period.
A work environment with flexible working hours and a hybrid work model.
Plenty of personal and professional growth opportunities combined with a competitive and periodically updated salary tailored to your skills, experiences, and results.
Interesting work full of challenges in an international working environment.
Company-funded licenses for leading AI tools (Claude Code).
High-impact learning culture: regular in-house and external training sessions and a team of international professionals eager to help you grow.
Many recreational after-work activities, additional health insurance (Specialists+), unlimited coffee, soft drinks, fruit, and other well-being goodies.
Cosylab events (Teambuilding, New Year’s Party, Picnic… ).




You will fit perfectly if you share these values




Think bold: We deliver exceptional solutions through courageous thinking, open communication, and the drive to continuously improve.
Be modest: We set our egos aside in actively listening, respecting one another, and embracing the diversity of experience and perspective across the company.
Work smart: We know we get more accomplished by working together, being accountable, focusing our efforts, and going the extra mile.
Enjoy life: We prioritize balance and positivity, nurturing personal wellness and celebrating successes.
Do good: We support one another and are passionate about solving difficult problems that ultimately help make the world a better place.




Apply for the job




Apply by Tuesday, September 1, 2026. Your application should include:




CV,
A brief motivational letter and
potential recommendations or references.




We're looking forward to meeting You!

The Cosylab Team

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
OBDeleven is all about making car tech easy and accessible for everyone. For over 10 years, we've been building powerful yet simple diagnostic and customization tools for car enthusiasts worldwide.

As we continue to grow the OBDeleven ecosystem, we're looking for a Data Analyst who will help us turn data into insights, support better business decisions and uncover opportunities to improve our products and customer experience.

This is not a role focused only on reporting. You'll work with data across different areas of the business, partner closely with Marketing, Sales, Product, Engineering and other teams, and help turn complex questions and data into clear, actionable recommendations.

What You'll Do


Analyse customer, product and business data to support better business and product decisions
Build and maintain dashboards, recurring reports and ad-hoc analyses to answer business questions
Define, monitor and improve KPIs and maintain clear metric definitions
Analyse funnels, cohorts, retention, segmentation and trends to identify opportunities and investigate anomalies
Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and actionable recommendations
Evaluate business initiatives, product features and experiments and help measure their impact
Validate data quality, identify gaps and work with engineers to improve data pipelines and documentation
Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, Engineering and other teams to understand their needs and deliver meaningful insights
Present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and contribute to a culture of data-driven decision-making


We expect


2-3 years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Marketing Analytics, BI or a related field
Strong hands-on SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, subqueries and window functions
Experience analysing customer, business, operational or product data
Experience building and maintaining dashboards and reports using a BI or data visualisation tool
Good understanding of analytical methods such as funnel, cohort, retention/churn, segmentation and trend analysis
Ability to turn business questions into structured analyses and clear, actionable recommendations
Strong communication skills and ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Ability to work independently, take ownership and collaborate effectively with different teams
Experience with Python, A/B testing, product analytics or cloud data platforms would be considered an advantage
Fluency in Lithuanian and full professional proficiency in English


Here's what we offer:


Fair pay for bold work: We reward your expertise with competitive pay that grows as you do
Hybrid Work Flexibility: Work 3 days in the office and 2 days from home or wherever suits you best.
Focus on your well-being: Choose your comprehensive health plan, get paid days off to care for yourself and your family, and enjoy flexible working hours, as well as your birthday day off.
More time that truly counts: Enjoy a 4-day workweek for one month a year, depending on how well the company hits its goals. Plus, earn an additional vacation day for every working year with us - up to 4 extra days
Real learning opportunities: Grow your skills with a 2% gross salary learning budget. Take your monthly paid self-learning day and improve stress-free.
Culture that connects: Enjoy Friday lunches on us, team buildings, company parties, and all the usual office perks like snacks, a cozy lounge, sport communities, and more.
Environment for real impact: Got an idea that'll make OBDeleven better? Share it, get feedback, fine-tune, and take action. We trust expertise and value ownership.


Salary range

Gross salary in a range: 2800 - 4500€ / month. The salary range is flexible, and we're open to discussing your expectations based on your experience and competencies.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Company Description

AppXite is a product software development company based in Riga, Latvia. Our platform is an AI-ready Digital Marketplace, CPQ, and Billing Platform for Telco, SaaS, Cloud, and AI services. It enables partners to build and monetize as-a-service offerings with flexible pricing models. The platform includes pre-built vendor and catalog integrations with major providers such as Microsoft, Google, AWS, and Adobe. It supports a wide range of billing configurations, helping partners efficiently manage and grow their businesses.

Job Description

As a Data Analyst, you will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy, reliability, and timely delivery of billing and invoicing data across the AppXite Platform. You will work extensively with Microsoft SQL Server, APIs, Postman, and Excel to investigate discrepancies, validate financial data, support integrations with external vendor platforms, and help improve business processes through automation and continuous improvement initiatives.This role is ideal for a highly analytical, detail-oriented professional who enjoys solving complex data problems and working at the intersection of technology, business operations, and financial processes.

Qualifications

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications:


Advanced SQL scripting skills and experience working with Microsoft SQL Server.
Hands-on experience using Postman or similar API testing tools.
Strong understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and system integrations.
Advanced Excel skills and experience working with large datasets.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to remain focused and productive when working on complex investigations.
Eagerness to learn and continuously improve.


Nice to Have:


Experience working with billing, invoicing, financial systems, or cloud commerce platforms.
Experience with ETL processes and data transformation workflows.
Experience with Microsoft Azure services, including:
Logic Apps
Data Factory
Storage Accounts
Function Apps
Application Insights

Title: Data Reporting Analyst
Description:
Job Title:

Data Reporting Analyst

Contract Type:

Time Type:

Full time

Job Description:

The Data Reporting Analyst is responsible for ensuring the quality, consistency, and analytical value of trading and financial data used by the Controlling and Accounting functions. The role supports Trading Controllers and business stakeholders through the development of robust reporting solutions, reconciliation analysis, dashboard creation, and data governance activities.

Acting as a key link between Controlling, Accounting, Risk, Trade Support, and IT teams, the incumbent ensures that business data is accurately mapped, validated, and transformed into actionable insights that support financial performance monitoring and decision-making. The role contributes to continuous improvement initiatives through the automation of reporting processes, enhancement of data quality controls, and implementation of analytical tools that improve the visibility of desk profitability, balance sheet positions, and cash flow performance.

The successful candidate combines strong financial acumen with advanced analytical and reporting capabilities, enabling the organization to move from historical reporting toward forward-looking analysis and enhanced business intelligence.

Main Responsibilities

Data Accuracy & Mapping


Collaborate with the Trading Data Reporting Analyst to verify and maintain accurate mappings.
Ensure correct data classification and structure to support precise analysis.



Report Generation & Dashboard Development


Create detailed reports using data from various sources to provide stakeholders with key insights into performance metrics.
Develop interactive dashboards to detect and correct data discrepancies, particularly in:
Desk performance and analytical dimensions view
Desk balance sheet view
Desk cash flow (CF) view

Data Analysis & Reporting


Conduct in-depth analysis of trading data to support decision-making and identify potential improvements.
Provide regular reports on trading data accuracy and mapping, including:
Daily PnL estimation – ensure accuracy and highlight significant movements.
Monthly and year-to-date (MtD & YTD) trading reconciliation – review and explain variations by nature, cost structure, cut-off points, trends, volumes, and counterparties.

Process Documentation & Improvement


Document existing workflows to enhance process visibility and identify optimization opportunities.
Recommend and implement process improvements to streamline data reporting.



Ad-hoc Tasks & Support


Assist with various ad-hoc requests aligned with Trading Controller (TC) goals, targets, and performance initiatives.
Provide replacement for another team member in case of temporary absence (incl. vacation, sickness, business trip, etc.).



Profile


Financial reporting, controlling, management accounting, or business analytics.
Data analysis and reporting within commodities trading, financial services, banking, energy, or related industries.
Proven experience reconciling and analyzing P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow information.
Experience working with large datasets from multiple source systems and ensuring data integrity and consistency.
Strong understanding of reporting processes, financial controls, and performance measurement methodologies.

Title: Duomenų mokslo analitikas (-ė)
Description:
„IKI“ – tai vieta, kur žmonės, nepriklausomai nuo to, ar dirba biure, parduotuvėse, gamyboje ar logistikoje, aistrą pirmauti verčia ambicingais pasiekimais! Pirmieji Lietuvoje pristatėme prancūziškus kruasanus ir bagetes, atidarėme autonominę parduotuvę, įdiegėme savitarnos kasas ir elektronines kainų etiketes. Šie žingsniai atspindi mūsų nuolatinį siekį būti žingsniu priekyje ir kurti ateities mažmeninę prekybą – inovatyvią bei tvarią. Jei ieškai dinamiškos, idėjoms atviros aplinkos, kurioje galėtum augti ir kurti naujoves, gali būti, kad darbas „IKI“ yra arčiau tavęs!

Šiame darbe tu:


Kursi, diegsi ir prižiūrėsi statistinius modelius, prognozavimo algoritmus bei mašininio mokymosi sprendimus.
Analizuosi verslo eksperimentų (A/B testų, pilotinių projektų) rezultatus ir vertinsi jų poveikį verslo rodikliams.
Automatizuosi analitinius procesus.
Vizualizuosi analizės rezultatus, rengsi įžvalgas ir rekomendacijas, padedančias priimti duomenimis grįstus verslo sprendimus.
Bendradarbiausi su IT, prekybos, rinkodaros, tiekimo grandinės ir logistikos komandomis, ieškant galimybių gerinti veiklos rezultatus pasitelkiant duomenų analitiką.
Nagrinėsi struktūrizuotus ir nestruktūrizuotus duomenis, identifikuosi tendencijas, dėsningumus bei priežastinius ryšius.
Prisidėsi prie analitikos metodikų, standartų ir gerųjų praktikų kūrimo bei jų diegimo organizacijoje.


Tikimės, kad tu:


Turi universitetinį išsilavinimą tiksliųjų mokslų srityje (matematikos, informatikos, ekonomikos, fizikos ir kt.)
Turi ne mažesnę kaip 2 metų patirtį dirbant duomenų mokslo, analitikos srityje
Turi gerus Python, SQL ir Excel įgūdžius
Puikiai bendrauji anglų kalba
Gebi savarankiškai vykdyti analizės projektus – nuo verslo problemos identifikavimo iki sprendimo rekomendacijų pateikimo


„IKI“ pasiūlymas tau:

Atlyginimas ir finansinė gerovė


atlyginimas: 2800 – 3800 €/mėn. (neatskaičius mokesčių, priklausomai nuo tavo patirties ir įgūdžių),
galėsi pigiau apsipirkti „IKI“ prekybos centruose,
turėsi nuolaidas „IKI“ asortimento naujienoms,
daugiau nei 300 MELP ir partnerių nuolaidų kone visiems gyvenimo atvejams.  


Darbo aplinka ir lankstumas


hibridinis darbo modelis: galimybė dirbti patogiame „IKI“ biure arba namuose,
lankstumas pasirenkant darbo valandas,
įkvėpimui – darbostogos iki 30 d. per metus.


Karjera ir tobulėjimas


karjeros galimybės (tiek Lietuvoje, tiek užsienyje),
profesinio tobulėjimo galimybės (tiek su kolegomis, tiek ir individualiai).

papildomas sveikatos draudimas, kurį galėsi rinktis net iš 3 planų,
nemokamos sveikatos patikros biure,

stiprybėmis grįsta kultūra, kurioje vertinamos visų darbuotojų unikalios savybės ir pasiekimai,

Pirmieji Lietuvoje pristatėme prancūziškus kruasanus ir bagetes, atidarėme autonominę parduotuvę, įdiegėme savitarnos kasas ir elektronines kainų etiketes. Šie žingsniai atspindi mūsų nuolatinį siekį būti žingsniu priekyje ir kurti ateities mažmeninę prekybą – inovatyvią bei tvarią. Jei ieškai dinamiškos, idėjoms atviros aplinkos, kurioje galėtum augti ir kurti naujoves, gali būti, kad darbas „IKI“ yra arčiau tavęs!

Šiame darbe tu:

  • Kursi, diegsi ir prižiūrėsi statistinius modelius, prognozavimo algoritmus bei mašininio mokymosi sprendimus.
  • Analizuosi verslo eksperimentų (A/B testų, pilotinių projektų) rezultatus ir vertinsi jų poveikį verslo rodikliams.
  • Automatizuosi analitinius procesus.
  • Vizualizuosi analizės rezultatus, rengsi įžvalgas ir rekomendacijas, padedančias priimti duomenimis grįstus verslo sprendimus.
  • Bendradarbiausi su IT, prekybos, rinkodaros, tiekimo grandinės ir logistikos komandomis, ieškant galimybių gerinti veiklos rezultatus pasitelkiant duomenų analitiką.
  • Nagrinėsi struktūrizuotus ir nestruktūrizuotus duomenis, identifikuosi tendencijas, dėsningumus bei priežastinius ryšius.
  • Prisidėsi prie analitikos metodikų, standartų ir gerųjų praktikų kūrimo bei jų diegimo organizacijoje.

Tikimės, kad tu:

  • Turi universitetinį išsilavinimą tiksliųjų mokslų srityje (matematikos, informatikos, ekonomikos, fizikos ir kt.)
  • Turi ne mažesnę kaip 2 metų patirtį dirbant duomenų mokslo, analitikos srityje
  • Turi gerus Python, SQL ir Excel įgūdžius
  • Puikiai bendrauji anglų kalba
  • Gebi savarankiškai vykdyti analizės projektus – nuo verslo problemos identifikavimo iki sprendimo rekomendacijų pateikimo

„IKI“ pasiūlymas tau:

Atlyginimas ir finansinė gerovė

  • atlyginimas: 2800 – 3800 €/mėn. (neatskaičius mokesčių, priklausomai nuo tavo patirties ir įgūdžių),
  • galėsi pigiau apsipirkti „IKI“ prekybos centruose,
  • turėsi nuolaidas „IKI“ asortimento naujienoms,
  • daugiau nei 300 MELP ir partnerių nuolaidų kone visiems gyvenimo atvejams.  

Darbo aplinka ir lankstumas

  • hibridinis darbo modelis: galimybė dirbti patogiame „IKI“ biure arba namuose,
  • lankstumas pasirenkant darbo valandas,
  • įkvėpimui – darbostogos iki 30 d. per metus.

Karjera ir tobulėjimas

  • karjeros galimybės (tiek Lietuvoje, tiek užsienyje),
  • profesinio tobulėjimo galimybės (tiek su kolegomis, tiek ir individualiai).

Sveikata ir emocinė gerovė

  • papildomas sveikatos draudimas, kurį galėsi rinktis net iš 3 planų,
  • nemokamos sveikatos patikros biure,
  • dalyvavimas „Walk15“, vidinėse badmintono, dviračių, žygių mėgėjų sporto grupėse,
  • streso valdymo ir kiti emocinės gerovės mokymai, galimybė gauti anonimines psichologo konsultacijas telefonu.     

Stipri bendruomenė

  • stiprybėmis grįsta kultūra, kurioje vertinamos visų darbuotojų unikalios savybės ir pasiekimai,
  • kolegas pagal laisvalaikio veiklas kviečiame burtis į „Hobby Spotlight” klubus,
  • darbuotojų fondas „VeIKIme drauge“,
  • esame aktyvūs bendruomenės nariai – savanoriaudami ir finansine parama prisidedame prie „Maisto banko“ ir kitų organizacijų.  

Inovacijos ir dinamiškumas

  • modernūs darbo įrankiai ir programos,
  • inovatyvūs sprendimai prekyboje, tvarumo ir kitose srityse,
  • mūsų komandos projektus ir pasiekimus kviečiame pažinti čia: Tvarumas | IKI. Arčiau Tavęs!

Skamba kaip darbas arčiau tavęs ir tavo tikslų?

Pasidalink savo CV arba susisiek su mūsų atrankų specialiste Vilte, telefonu +370 658 99876 arba LinkedIn platformoje.

Title: Reporting Analyst
Description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

About The Role

Do you have a background in reporting or data visualisations? Ready to kick-start a rewarding career in healthcare technology?

At our newest Electronic Health Record Centre of Excellence in Letterkenny, Ireland, we're assembling a dynamic team committed to revolutionising the healthcare industry. Our mission is simple: to make the healthcare system work better for everyone. Here, you'll collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the field, and what's even more exciting is that prior Epic / electronic health records experience isn't necessary!

We're building a cutting-edge electronic healthcare records and analytics services capability, harnessing the collective expertise of our clinical, consulting, delivery, technology, and operations teams. When you join our team as EHR Reporting Analyst, you'll embark on a comprehensive training programme that equips you with the skills and knowledge needed to excel in your assigned area. You'll become a vital part of our efforts to enhance healthcare technology and improve patient care.

We're interested in individuals with experience handling and manipulating data and building reports, ideally with ideally with Microsoft SQL Server and visualisation skills (Tableau, PowerBI or similar). Solid candidates will be able to demonstrate self-motivation and team collaboration. Epic training will be provided. Most importantly, our team will foster a culture of diversity and inclusion and drive innovation for our company and our clients.

Please note: There would be an initial training program on joining where there may be an expectation to work adjusted hours, depending on trainer location/availability. Following this, hours would be standard local hours with a need for some flexibility when working with US clients.

Careers with Optum offer flexible work arrangements and individuals who live and work in the Republic of Ireland will have the opportunity to split their monthly work hours between our Letterkenny office and telecommuting from a home-based office in a hybrid work model.

Primary Responsibilities


Creating solutions out of Epic data repositories such as raw extracts, visual reports, and dashboards sourced from Microsoft SQL Server databases
Analyse customer reporting inventory and identify opportunities to consolidate, optimize, or decommission reports that are no longer needed
Utilizing SQL to create new solutions, modify existing content, and distribute the data to users and third-party vendors
Extracts Epic data utilizing approved BI tools with SQL code
Assists with Epic upgrades/updates as reporting analyst for the Epic Clarity data models
Configure and test Epic-released foundation reports and dashboards
Review peer reports for data accuracy and efficiency
The BI Developer may create new reports, using third party report writing tools to display Epic data
Communicate effectively with report consumers to explain the data and the logic behind it


You will be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role, as well as providing development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications


Proven experience building reports and data visualizations
Proven experience working with Microsoft SQL Server or other relational database platforms
Proven ability to troubleshoot technical issues related to reports, including reviewing scripts and database issues
Proven experience facilitating meetings and feedback sessions to enhance reporting and implement process improvements
Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint


Preferred Qualifications

We value a diverse range of skills and experiences. While any of the following qualifications are desirable, they are not mandatory for this role. Candidates from varied backgrounds are encouraged to apply.


Degree in Data Analytics, Business Analysis, or a related discipline
Epic certification in relevant modules
SQL Server certification
Proven experience working with Tableau, Power BI, or similar data visualization tools
Proven experience using Microsoft Project and/or Visio
Proven experience working with Microsoft SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), Visual Studio, or similar technologies
Proven experience gathering and documenting business requirements


Please note you must currently be eligible to work and remain indefinitely without any restrictions in the country to which you are making an application. Proof will be required to support your application.

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.

Diversity creates a healthier atmosphere: Optum is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, disability, religion, age, race, and membership of the Traveller community, or any other characteristic protected by law. Optum is a drug-free workplace. © 2026 Optum Services (Ireland) Limited. All rights reserved.

Title: AI Analysis & Performance Analyst
Description:
Responsibilities
About the Role

As a AI Analyst within the Performance & Insights Customer Support team, you will play a key role in developing and executing on analytics and reporting initiatives which deliver data-driven insights to internal and external stakeholders, including strategy, operations, business, engineering, and R&D teams in both globally. You are playing a key role in empowering TikTok platform to achieve AI automation. You will contribute to the development of industry-leading capabilities to optimize system configuration, resource allocation, scheduling, and BPO operations in fast-paced environments while monitoring performance and continuously looking for areas to improve efficiency and enable high standards of Customer Service Support.

Responsibilities

This role is responsible for developing and executing on analytics and reporting initiatives which deliver data-driven insights to internal and external stakeholders, including strategy, operations, business, engineering, and R&D teams in both US and globally. You are playing a key role in empowering TikTok’s platform to achieve AI automation. You will contribute to the development of industry-leading capabilities to optimize human-AI task allocation, enhance operational efficiency through intelligent automation, and drive scalable solutions that improve user and agent experiences globally.You must be able to work both independently and as part of a team to deliver on a dynamic set of needs in a fast-paced environment. Specific responsibilities include:
- Work with large datasets to solve problems that could be ambiguous and nuanced using a variety of analytical and statistical approaches.
- Conduct quantitative analysis using statistical regression, machine learning, as well as hypothesis testing and present analysis and recommendations in a user friendly manner to propel business growth and customer satisfaction.
- Develop a scientific approach to measure KPI fluctuation, impact of business initiatives, and customer experience and design indexes for continuous monitoring.
- Design and implement foundational tests including A/B for measuring the effectiveness of customer support automation and customer service.
- Create documentation articulating the underlying assumptions, design of test, success metrics, and conclusion.
- Have familiarity with best practices and pragmatic approaches for addressing common issues including data quality, seasonality, insufficient training dataset, etc.
- Perform predictive analysis and support business partners with revenue and loss forecasts, budgeting, risk and incident management to proactively address foreseeable challenges.
- Conduct deep dive analysis and diagnosis to identify patterns, concentrations, correlations, root causes to provide transparency into business and product performance.
- Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Operations and cross-functional teams to inform, influence, support, and execute strategy and decisions.
- Demonstrate understanding of common challenges facing TikTok business, key products, and the competitiveness of the marketplace.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualification(s)
- You have experience working on AI chatbots, automation, and measurement and impact in an Operations role within a BPO, Social Media, or Call Center environment.
- You have strong interpersonal and communication skills to engage with operational leadership and xfn stakeholders.
- You are efficient and able to prioritize, plan and multi-task with the ability to translate action steps into a systematic process.
- At least 3 years of experience in development or model/data pipeline development, with hands-on experience applying LLM technologies to real-world problems.
- Strong proficiency in programming languages in both Python and SQL.
- Experience in applied ML, particularly with Large Language Models (LLMs) and a strong track record of translating data into user insights and product impact.

Preferred Qualification(s)
- Experience with Customer Support.
- Clear understanding of data pipeline, model development, model testing and deployment.
- Intellectual curiosity, along with excellent problem-solving and quantitative skills, including the ability to disaggregate issues, identify root causes and recommend solutions.
- Prior experience in working on community insights / content understanding.

Trust & Safety
Content that this role interacts with includes images, video, and text related to every-day life, but it can also include (but is not limited to) bullying; hate speech; child safety; depictions of harm to self and others, and harm to animals. Hence, it is possible that this role will be exposed to harmful content on a daily basis. ​
​
TikTok recognises that keeping our platform safe for the TikTok communities is no ordinary job which can be both rewarding and psychologically demanding and emotionally taxing for some. This is why we are sharing the potential hazards, risks and implications in this unique line of work from the start, so our candidates are well informed before joining. ​
​
We are committed to the wellbeing of all our employees and promise to provide comprehensive and evidence-based programs, to promote and support physical and mental wellbeing throughout each employee's journey with us. We believe that wellbeing is a relationship and that everyone has a part to play, so we work in collaboration and consultation with our employees and across our functions in order to ensure a truly person-centred, innovative and integrated approach.​


About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

Title: Supply Chain Master Data Analyst
Description:
The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Meet The Team

New ideas have a way of becoming not only great products but also best in class practices that can significantly enhance the customer experience. At Dexcom you can make a difference in the lives of millions across the world!

Reporting to the Sr Supply Chain Manager, this role contributes to the coordination of Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) and supports product lifecycle activities, ensuring that system data is accurate and updated in a timely manner. You will help enable effective planning, scheduling, warehouse and execution processes aligned with Dexcom’s operational standards.

Where You Come In


You will collect, validate, and update master data required for Purchasing (Buy Items), Production Planning (Make Items), Warehousing and Inventory processes
You will ensure data accuracy and completeness within ERP systems
You will support coordination and implementation of Engineering Change Orders across make and buy items, assist with updating system data in line with approved changes, Track ECO progress and escalate issues where required
You will assist in managing Phase-in / phase-out of parts, Product revision changes
You will ensure updates are reflected accurately in systems to support production and procurement readiness
You will provide accurate data inputs to support MRP and planning activities
You will support resolution of data-related issues impacting Supply Chain operations
You will identify and support improvements in data accuracy and processes
You will follow established data governance and change control procedures


What Makes You Successful


You have had exposure to master data, planning and purchasing processes
You have familiarity with item master data structures
You are an advanced user of Microsoft Excel, Copilot, Outlook, Teams and Smartsheets is preferable
You have experience in the medical device or CPG industry
You have experience with Oracle EBS, Oracle Fusion, PLM and Anaplan systems networks is advantageous


Experience And Education Requirements


Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field and a minimum of 2-5 years of related experience.


What You’ll Get


A front row seat to life changing CGM technology.
A full and comprehensive benefits program.
Growth opportunities on a global scale.
Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.
An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.


Travel Required


0-5%

Only authorized staffing and recruiting agencies may use this site or to submit profiles, applications or resumes on specific requisitions. Dexcom does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to the Talent Acquisition team, Dexcom employees or any other company location. Title: DUOMENŲ ANALITIKĖ (-AS)
HTML:
Ar nori tapti „Ignitis Group“ dalimi?

Šiuo metu ieškome naujos (-o) komandos narės (-io) duomenų analitkos komandoje. Šioje pozicijoje būsi atsakinga (-as) už analizes, elektros energijos prekybai vykdyti. Manai, mums pakeliui? Tuomet laukiame tavęs savo komandoje!

Take YOUR part in #EnergySmart!

Prisidėsi prie žalios ir saugios energetikos ekosistemos kūrimo:


  • Kuriant IT ir analitinius įrankius duomenų gavimui, analizei, procesų optimizavimui, procesų stebėsenai ir automatizacijai;
  • Analizuojant kaip tikslinti duomenų prognozes;
  • Inicijuojant, diegiant ir tobulinant naujus analizės modelius;
  • Kuriant įrankius kitiems įmonės specialistams ruošiant ataskaitas savarankiškai;
  • Vykdant didmeninės rinkos modeliavimą;
  • Rengiant įvairias nestandartines analizes;
  • Tobulinant ir administruojant automatinės prekybos sistemas;
  • Reguliariai besidomint naujausiomis duomenų analizės srities tendencijomis.


Šiai pozicijai svarbu:


  • Aukštasis išsilavinimas (ekonometrijos, statistikos, matematikos ar kitų panašių tiksliųjų mokslo srityse);
  • Analitinis mąstymas, duomenų raštingumas, geri problemų sprendimo įgūdžiai;
  • Gebėjimas vizualiai ir aiškiai pateikti apibendrintą informaciją ir analitines įžvalgas.


Privalumas būtų:


  • Ankstesnė prekybos patirtis elektros / kitų žaliavų / akcijų / valiutų biržoje;
  • Geri programavimo įgūdžiai su Python, R, VBA bei SQL programavimo kalbomis;
  • Elektros rinkos veikimo principų išmanymas;
  • Su energetika susijusių duomenų dalinimosi platformų išmanymas.


Mainais už tvaresnės ateities kūrimą, mes pažadame:


  • Papildomų naudų paketą pasirenkant: pensijų kaupimą, sveikatos draudimą ar kitą naudą iš pasirenkamų naudų sąrašo „MELP“ programėlėje;
  • Papildomas apmokamas dienas: sveikatinimuisi, trumpalaikės ligos atveju, savanorystei, už sukauptą darbo stažą;
  • Nelaimingų atsitikimų draudimą;
  • Hibridinį darbo modelį (3+2) ir lankstų darbo laiko grafiką;
  • Vidines karjeros galimybes;
  • Plačias mokymosi, kvalifikacijos kėlimo programas;
  • Dėmesį fizinei ir emocinei sveikatai: gerovės mentorių iniciatyvas ir psichologinę pagalbą, tinklinio ir krepšinio komandas ir t.t;
  • Galimybę prisidėti prie energetikos transformacijos, siekiant sukurti 100% žalią ir saugią energijos ekosistemą dabarties ir ateities kartoms.


Kviečiame prisijungti prie augančios tarptautinės komandos. Ją sudaro išmaniajai energetikai atsidavę specialistai, kuriuos vienija bendras tikslas – sukurti 100% saugią ir žalią energetikos ekosistemą dabarties ir ateities kartoms. O būdas tai pasiekti – tikrai ne laukti tinkamo laiko. Mes tikime, kad energija veikti įsikrauname patys. Suvienyti prasmės. Geriausi ten, kur svarbu. Prisiimame iššūkius. Drąsūs atrasti ir keistis. Tai mūsų vertybinės nuostatos, drauge jos kuria energiją, kuri yra visko, ką mes darome, varomoji jėga. Energiją, kuri virsta mūsų pasirinkimais. Jei ir tu vadovaujiesi šiomis vertybinėmis nuostatomis – lauksime savo komandoje!

Siekdami strateginių tikslų padidinti lyčių balansą „Ignitis grupėje“, pareigų pavadinimus darbo skelbimuose nurodome pirmiausia moteriškos giminės galūne.

„Ignitis grupė“ yra lygias galimybes užtikrinanti darbovietė, kurioje laukiami visi kandidatai, nediskriminuojant jų dėl rasės, religijos, lyties, seksualinės orientacijos ar lyties tapatybės, amžiaus, negalios ar dėl kitų su darbo vykdymu tiesiogiai nesusijusių požymių.

Pareigybių grupės pastovios atlyginimo dalies intervalas: yra nuo 2770 iki 4150 EUR (neatskaičius mokesčių). Konkretus darbo užmokestis siūlomas atsižvelgiant į darbo patirtį ir kompetenciją. Prie darbo užmokesčio gali būti mokama kintamoji atlygio dalis.

Apie mus:

Norėtum prisidėti prie projektų, keičiančių elektros energijos gamybos ir vartojimo ateitį Baltijos šalyse ir už jų ribų? „Ignitis grupė“ yra Baltijos šalyse pirmaujanti integruota energetikos įmonių grupė, apjungianti beveik 4 800 skirtingų sričių ekspertų vienijamų bendro siekio sukurti 100 proc. saugią ir žalią energetikos ekosistemą dabarties ir ateities kartoms.

Atsakingai investuojame, kad įgalintume elektrifikaciją, užtikrintume tinklų atsparumą ir įgyvendintume strateginį siekį – įdiegti 4–5 GW veikiančių žaliųjų pajėgumų, plėtojant žaliąją gamybą ir lankstumo pajėgumus.

Mažindami ŠESD emisijų intensyvumą energetikos tinkluose, nuosekliai įgyvendiname vertę kuriančią dekarbonizaciją ir kartu užtikriname energetinį saugumą.

„Ignitis grupė“ veikia Baltijos šalyse, Lenkijoje ir Suomijoje. Integruotas verslo modelis grupėje įgalina sinergijas ir naujus verslo modelius, pasitelkiant Baltijos šalyse turimą didžiausią tinklą, energijos kaupimo pajėgumus ir klientų portfelį.

The Company

We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Meet The Team

Our team drives high-level strategy by delivering analysis that informs executive decisions and continuous improvement. We foster a collaborative, growth-driven culture where business acumen meets technical expertise.

We’re looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to help turn data into strategic insight. As part of our Business Intelligence team, you’ll focus primarily on Customer Success insights and play a key role in shaping decisions across the organisation. You’ll be empowered to take ownership, experiment with new ideas, and bridge the gap between data and business needs. If you’re passionate about using data to drive impact and thrive in a team-oriented environment, we’d love to meet you.

Where You Come In


You will build, test and refine: Develop and evolve dashboards and reports through investigative analysis. Form hypotheses, explore data, and test assumptions to deliver insights that drive better decisions.
You will explore and analyse: Tackle complex business questions by combining data from multiple sources. Identify the right questions to ask and uncover insights that shape both daily operations and long-term strategy.
You will tell the story: Use statistical techniques and critical thinking to spot trends and patterns, then translate them into clear, compelling stories that resonate with stakeholders and support key decisions.
You will collaborate and influence: Partner with cross-functional teams and senior leaders to deliver timely, ad hoc analyses. Gather and refine stakeholder requirements, propose improvements, estimate impact, and pitch ideas that influence strategy and process.
You will prioritise and deliver: Engage in multiple projects simultaneously, balancing short-term requests with long-term initiatives. Prioritise effectively to meet deadlines and deliver high-quality outputs that align with business needs.
You will track business impact: Monitor the outcomes of implemented insights and recommendations, helping quantify their effect on key performance indicators and business goals.
You will promote data quality: Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and completeness through rigorous validation and quality checks, building trust in the numbers that drive decisions.
You will innovate and improve: Embrace experimentation and continuous improvement. Stay current with BI trends and proactively trial new tools, predictive analytics, automation, or analytical approaches to enhance our capabilities.


What Makes You Successful


You are strong at exploring complex business problems, testing hypotheses, and translating data into actionable insights that drive meaningful outcomes.
You have advanced proficiency in Tableau and MS Excel, and you can craft clear, engaging visuals and narratives that make complex data accessible and compelling.
You have solid experience with SQL and working with large datasets or data warehouses (e.g., BigQuery). You’re familiar with ETL processes and can combine data from multiple sources. Experience with Looker, Python, or cloud-based analytics is a plus.
You have a deep understanding of business processes and performance metrics, particularly in customer‑centric environments.
You excel at gathering and refining requirements, managing expectations, and building trust with stakeholders across functions.
You have excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, and you can clearly articulate insights to both technical and non‑technical audiences while working effectively in cross‑functional teams.
You demonstrate a proactive mindset with the confidence to take ownership, challenge assumptions, and drive improvements. You’re comfortable proposing new ideas and seeing them through.
You can manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritise tasks effectively, and deliver high‑quality work in a dynamic environment.
You stay current with BI trends and tools, embrace experimentation, and continuously look for ways to improve your skills and enhance the team’s capabilities.
You are familiar with customer lifecycle metrics, support operations, or have experience working with customer‑facing teams (a plus).


What You’ll Get


A comprehensive onboarding and training on the job.
Opportunity to work in a diverse and inclusive environment with colleagues representing 45+ different nationalities.
Hybrid working model, offering the flexibility to work both remotely and in a modern, well-equipped office space.
5 additional vacation days, with potential for more for parents, students, and other cases with approval.
Opportunity to work from other countries for up to 30 days per year.
Health Insurance including reduced premiums available for dependents.
Life and Accident insurance coverage.
3rd Pillar Private Pension plan.
Health and Wellness programs, including access to online coaching and therapy sessions
Fertility, Family forming, Menopause and Men’s health support services.
Regular team-building events that foster collaboration and connection.
Best-in-class training and career development programs.
Exclusive discounts on restaurants, spas, clothing, gyms, entertainment, and more.
Access to a fitness tracking app with rewards for staying active.
Free parking space at the city center office location.
Language premium allowance if applicable.


Travel Required


0-5%


Experience And Education Requirements


Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline, and a minimum of 2-5 years related experience or a Master’s degree and 0-2 years of equivalent experience.


Flex Workplace


Your primary location will be your assigned Dexcom site, but you may work part of the week from a home office. You must live within commuting distance of your assigned Dexcom site (typically within an hour’s commute).


To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies: Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Dexcom. Only authorized staffing and recruiting agencies may use this site or to submit profiles, applications or resumes on specific requisitions. Dexcom does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to the Talent Acquisition team, Dexcom employees or any other company location. Dexcom is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/applications.

Monthly base salary for this position is from €3,102.50 to €3,832.50 gross. Final offer will depend on your qualifications, competencies, and professional experience.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Summary

Covenir is a BPO partner to insurance carriers — and increasingly, a technology company that happens to serve them. The Platform is how that shows up day to day: modules spanning Print, Call Center, Virtual Mailroom, and Premium & Lockbox, built with an AI-assisted, 80/20 development model where AI handles the first draft and people handle the judgment. The Data Analyst owns the data and reporting that support Covenir’s business — building and maintaining the analytics that give Operations, Sales & Marketing, and leadership a single, trustworthy view of performance, while scouting the AI tools and partnerships that inform Covenir’s build-versus-partner decisions. The Platform is this role’s current top priority, but scope extends to Covenir’s broader data and reporting needs as priorities shift.

Job Description

How Covenir’s Values Show Up in This Role


Committed to WOW our Customers: The dashboards and numbers you produce are what leadership uses to make real calls — you make sure they’re right, not just plausible.
Great Just Isn’t Good Enough: You don’t stop at a working report. You ask if the metric is actually the right one, and if there’s a cleaner way to show it.
One Team, One Goal: Operations, Sales & Marketing, and IT/R&D all come to you with different questions — you treat all of them as your team, not just IT.
Passion for Excellence: Your analysis is clean enough that someone unfamiliar with the data could follow your logic without a walkthrough.


What You’ll Do


Write SQL for data extraction, transformation, and reporting across Covenir’s systems
Build and maintain executive-facing analytics and KPI dashboards — volumes, postage, and SLA performance by customer and business unit
Use Azure data services (Azure SQL, Microsoft Fabric, Blob Storage) supporting the platform’s data warehouse
Research and evaluate AI tools, vendors, and partnership opportunities (for example, document-intelligence platforms) to inform build-versus-partner recommendations
Translate operational and business questions from Operations, Sales & Marketing, and leadership into data requests and reporting
Apply AI-assisted analysis and workflow tools, consistent with Covenir’s 80/20 model
Support data retention, security, and SOC compliance requirements as they apply to platform data


Requirements


2+ years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or business intelligence, with proficient SQL skills
Working knowledge of Azure data services (Azure SQL, Microsoft Fabric, Blob Storage) or equivalent cloud data tools; AWS experience a plus
Fundamental knowledge of insurance BPO business processes across Print, Call Center, Virtual Mailroom, and Premium & Lockbox
Working knowledge of data collection across multiple business functions, and of data retention and access-control policies
Basic understanding of the AI/API sandbox and its available data workflows
Experience building executive-facing dashboards or KPI reporting
Comfortable researching and evaluating vendors, tools, or partnership opportunities
Ability to create clear, concise data analysis and reporting documentation for stakeholders across Operations, Sales & Marketing, and IT & R&D
Completes data security and confidentiality training, SOC compliance training, and cross-functional onboarding across Platform modules
Bachelor’s degree in a related field (Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Business), or equivalent experience
Performs other duties as assigned by the R&D Manager in support of Covenir’s broader business needs


What An A Player Looks Like


Numbers you can defend. A players can explain exactly how a metric was calculated and why it’s the right one, not just hand over a dashboard.
Translates business questions into data. When Sales & Marketing or Operations asks a vague question, A players know how to turn it into the right query.
Curious about AI tooling. A players actively track what’s out there, not just when asked to evaluate a specific vendor.
Comfortable being the single source of truth. When numbers conflict across teams, A players are the ones who resolve which version is right.
Documents the logic, not just the output. A players leave behind reporting anyone can pick up, not a black box only they understand.


Is This Role For You?

Strong fit


Proficient in SQL and comfortable owning data
extraction, transformation, and reporting end to end
Enjoys translating vague business questions into
concrete data requests
Genuinely curious about AI tools and vendor
landscapes, not just the data itself
Comfortable being the tie-breaker when numbers
across teams don’t match


Skip this role if


You want a narrowly scoped reporting role with no ambiguity
You’re not interested in researching AI tools or vendors
You’d rather avoid being the one who resolves conflicting numbers
You need requests to come from a single, consistent source


Worker Type

Regular

Number Of Openings Available

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
About Purple Carrot

Founded in 2014, Purple Carrot delivers clean, long-lasting energy through the power of plants. As the only company in America devoted entirely to plant-based eating, we have spent over a decade perfecting the balance of protein and fiber that only plants can provide. Offering chef-crafted, dietitian-designed meals delivered right to your door, we make plant-forward eating effortless, flexible, and endlessly exciting. Our menu spans quick weeknight dishes, occasion-worthy dinners, breakfast, lunch, snacks, and ready-to-eat meals.

Purple Carrot prioritizes taste and flexibility, offering no membership fees, the freedom to skip or unskip weekly deliveries whenever you want, and a no-pressure, cancel-anytime policy. We pride ourselves on doing plants better than anyone else - and we have the receipts to prove it.

Description

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer to join our mission-driven team. As an integral part of the Data team, you will join forces with the Senior Analytics Engineer in our continued effort to inspire people to eat more plants.

This position will play an important role in building and maintaining resilient, scalable data pipelines and company-wide data infrastructure that empowers Purple Carrot employees to better understand, manage, curate, and analyze the data most relevant to their work.

As the Analytics Engineer, you will be focused on maintaining and improving our data pipelines, supporting data systems and analytics, and helping develop rigorous data products within our modern data stack. This role will synthesize feedback from teams across the business and help translate data needs into reliable, well-documented solutions that allow us to move faster and gain better insights into how our business performs.

We greatly thank all applicants; however, only those under serious consideration will be contacted.

Location


This hybrid role is based in Dedham, MA
Our hybrid approach includes 3 days in-office each week, giving teams the best of both flexibility and collaboration. Many team members choose to come in more often - it's a great way to stay inspired and engaged with the team



On the Plate


Lead and contribute to the implementation and maintenance of end-to-end data pipelines and infrastructure, from ingestion through transformation and analytics
Develop, test, and optimize data models and data warehouse architecture with a focus on performance, scalability, and reliability
Ensure data quality through validation, monitoring, testing, and strong documentation practices
Implement and uphold data governance standards, including data dictionaries, lineage, access controls, and clear ownership of business logic
Build and maintain BI dashboards and reporting tools that help teams understand performance and make data-informed decisions
Support occasional ad hoc and exploratory data analysis to help answer business questions and identify trends
Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for data models, pipelines, reporting logic, and key data definitions
Collaborate closely with the Senior Analytics Engineer and cross-functional partners to execute on defined workstreams within an established data framework
Assist with ad-hoc projects and tasks as necessary



Main Ingredients for the Role


2-3 years of experience in the data space as a senior data analyst, data analyst, analytics engineer, data engineer, or equivalent role
Bachelor's degree in data analytics, computer science, information systems, business analytics, mathematics, statistics, or a related field, or equivalent experience
Able to commute to the Dedham, MA office 3 days per week
Proficiency in SQL and dbt for data transformation, automation, and modeling
Experience building and maintaining data pipelines using modern data stack technologies such as Git, dbt, Stitch, cloud data warehouses, or similar tools
Strong background in data quality assurance, governance frameworks, and best practices for documentation
Experience with BI and reporting tools such as Looker, Omni, or similar platforms
Ability to work independently on assigned workstreams while collaborating closely with a senior team member
Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment



Extra Special Sauce


Experience working in or supporting a B2C subscription business model
Comfortable working within an established data framework while driving execution independently on defined workstreams
Strong curiosity and ability to translate business questions into clear, scalable data solutions
Excitement for working in a dynamic environment where data helps teams make faster, smarter decisions
You enjoy documentation, process improvement, and building systems that make work easier for others



Compensation

That’s why we deliver 100% grass-fed, grass-finished beef, free-range organic chicken, pork raised crate-free, and wild-caught seafood directly to our members’ doors. All of our products are humanely raised or wild-caught and never given antibiotics or added hormones ever. We’re working to build a world that’s better for all, and we’re inviting everyone to come along. For us, better means treating our planet with respect. It means improving the lives of animals and the livelihoods of farmers. It means never cutting corners when it comes to doing business. Ultimately, it means better meals, enjoyed together. Our team is made up of people who collaborate and support one another. We’re always looking for outstanding people to join our mission! 

About the Role

Department: Commercial Operations

Reports To: Associate Director of Commercial & Marketing Analytics

Location: Watertown, MA - in office 3 days/week 

Level: Individual Contributor, mid-level

Base Salary: $103,000 - $120,000

 

About the Role

ButcherBox is looking for a Growth Analyst to own new member acquisition analytics. This isn't a build-dashboards-and-hand-off-findings role. You'll identify opportunities, design tests, drive analysis, and follow it through to a decision. The expectation is that you're the connective tissue between data and action; not just telling us what the numbers say, but making sure something happens because of it. 

Our marketing and commercial teams embrace a hybrid model that provides personal flexibility as well as in-person collaboration. The ideal candidate will find value in coming to our Watertown office two to three days per week. You’ll be embedded in the growth team, owning critical metrics alongside them and supporting weekly channel deep dives. 

Responsibilities

Own analysis across paid (social, SEM, affiliate) and non-digital channels (TV, radio, podcast, OOH), plus site funnel and lead/email flow — from surfacing what's happening to advising what to do next 
Design, analyze, and report on A/B and incrementality tests with a bias toward action and iteration 
Build and maintain self-service reporting tools and data resources that enable self-service analytics by the growth team 
Lead the development of our next phase of media attribution, including MTA and media mix  
Build a deep understanding of the new member journey (predictive LTV, LTV:CPA, funnel conversion) and use it to sharpen acquisition strategy 
Translate analytical findings into decisions in partnership with the growth marketing team 
Drive work from question to answer to outcome, including identifying and resolving whatever's in the way 

Qualifications

Excellent SQL skills; proficiency in Power BI or other visualization tools 
Experience in paid media analytics and growth marketing measurement 
Deep knowledge of incrementality testing, multi-touch attribution, media mix modeling, and other measurement tools 
Strong sense of “so what?”, driving action through analysis 
Comfort working in a fast paced environment where decisions cannot wait to be made 
Ability to translate technical analysis into clear, specific recommendations, communicated clearly and concisely to non-technical stakeholders 
Track record of driving projects to closure in cross-functional environments, including navigating ambiguity and multiple priorities, with a bias towards speed

Title: Master Data Analyst
Description:
Job Overview:

The Master Data Analyst coordinates and performs day to day tasks for the creation, maintenance, and data quality throughout the lifecycle of a material for all Routes to Market, Business Units, and Bottlers. Develops knowledge and understands the end-to-end processes including impacts to up and down stream processes and systems. Supports the initiatives product launch process to ensure master data successfully supports flawless execution. Is responsible for data accuracy, performing and reporting on periodic audits and data integrity checks. Provides data verification and analysis in SAP material master and applicable systems. Reviews data input and processes to ensure quality, consistency, and timeliness. Maintains and supports relationships with all business partners related to material Master Data. Collaborates with functional groups on effectiveness and efficiencies of Master Data processes, including Sales Operations, Marketing, Supply Chain, IT, etc. Leverages data tools to analyze SAP and Legacy systems data to ensure compliance with business processes and a high level of data quality. Develops and maintains up-to-date and accurate documentation and provides knowledge transfer for business processes & workflows within functional area. Improves and streamlines business processes within functional area. Participates in and/or leads projects internally to include material testing and supporting business design requirements, if applicable.

Total Rewards:


Salary range: USD $62,500.00 - USD $80,000.00
Actual placement within the compensation range may vary depending on experience, skills, and other factors
Benefits, subject to election and eligibility: Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, Paid Time Off (including paid parental leave, vacation, and sick time), 401k with company match, Tuition Reimbursement, and Mileage Reimbursement
Annual bonus based on performance and eligibility

Qualification:


Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited institution preferred
3+ year professional work experience in the field of Finance or General Business
SAP experience highly preferred
Proficient in Microsoft Outlook (using advanced functions in MS Excel such as pivot tables, V look ups and some base knowledge of MS Access).
Excellent attention to detail, accuracy, advanced analytical skills, quality, and strong organizational skills
An understanding of how to manipulate large datasets, combined with strong customer service and interpersonal skills
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, both quantitative and qualitative

We’re looking for an Analytics Engineer with a background in Data Engineering or Analytics Engineering who operates as a true full-stack analyst, owning everything from raw data to insights to operationalization.

Strong SQL and analytical data modeling skills (ideally dbt or SQLMesh).
Experience with ELT/ETL workflows and cloud warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks).

Experience with dashboards, BI tools, and self-serve analytics.

Own and improve data pipelines, ingestion workflows, and data quality testing.

Enjoy building clean, reliable, reusable data models.

Want to help define and scale Lovable’s data foundations and culture.
Care about the rep experience and view analytics as a product.

Fill in a short form then jump on an initial exploratory call.
Discuss your experience in more depth during a round of interviews with us.

The Compliance Data and Reporting Analyst (“CDRA”) is part of the Brown University Health Corporate Compliance team and reports to the Manager of Compliance and Program Effectiveness. This position serves as a key member of the compliance team and data analyst for compliance and privacy reporting matters. The CDRA is responsible for assisting the compliance team with facilitating, executing, monitoring the overall management of the compliance, policy & privacy, and revenue compliance data and reporting functions. Will assist with general audit projects.

Principal Duties And Responsibilities

Brown University Health employees are expected to successfully role model the organization’s values of Compassion, Accountability, Respect, and Excellence as these guide our everyday actions with patients, customers and one another.

Data Analyst


Design business analysis and data recording systems for use throughout the department.
Maintain databases and perform updates as necessary to ensure accuracy.
Track and identify trends in reported compliance issues and inquiries.
Regularly examine data reports to locate and resolve mistakes throughout.
Accurately analyze and collect data for various types of business reports.
Create business reports and dashboards that provide insight into key data points.
Communicate the results of data analysis in written and verbal form to managers.
Assists the Team with the maintenance of electronic data management systems in use in the Department. Including but not limited to – NAVEX; Imprivata; MDaudit; COI -Smart; Intelligent Contracts


Privacy


Assists the Privacy team with the coordination, development, facilitation, and enhancement of the Privacy Program through reporting trends, metrics and dashboards.
Assists the VP and Manager with coordinating system wide privacy and compliance projects which may include working closely with Information Security, Information Services, Human Resources, or operations teams to identify and implement process or system changes.
Responsible for the collection and analysis of privacy program data and analytics and development of standard and ad hoc reports.
Provides support to privacy-related initiatives including the planning and performance of privacy-based risk assessments and data-inventory processes. 
Provides support to the VP and Department Manager(s) and members of the compliance team in meeting federal and state reporting requirements, including the Office for Civil Rights, regarding breach notification and follow-up investigations.
Maintains a working knowledge of relevant privacy laws, regulations, rules, and standards and keeps abreast of privacy trends.
Assists the Manager and VP with requests for data sharing with external entities.


Compliance and Revenue Compliance


Assisting the Compliance Team with the management of general audits identified on the Annual Workplan and other audits as needed.
Develop and facilitate designated monitoring activities to assess compliance with policies. Responsible for ensuring monitoring is occurring on a consistent basis.
Assists with implementation of compliance training and education.
Supports the activities of the System Compliance Committee and Audit & Risk Committee, and implementation of the Compliance work plan.
Develop a strong understanding of the Compliance Services software tools to help optimize each tool to full potential.
Participates in committees and work groups representing Compliance as requested.
Handles all compliance and privacy matters with sensitivity and maintains strict confidentiality of all work material and activities.

Demonstrated ability to manage time and prioritize projects to meet deadlines
Ability to use SQL and Microsoft Excel to create pivot tables, graphs and charts. Experience with Tableau and/or Microsoft PowerBI

Tendency to pay close attention to small details that could impact results
