The CDRA is responsible for assisting the compliance team with facilitating, executing, monitoring the overall management of the compliance, policy & privacy, and revenue compliance data and reporting functions. Will assist with general audit projects.

Principal Duties And Responsibilities

Brown University Health employees are expected to successfully role model the organization’s values of Compassion, Accountability, Respect, and Excellence as these guide our everyday actions with patients, customers and one another.

Data Analyst

  • Design business analysis and data recording systems for use throughout the department.
  • Maintain databases and perform updates as necessary to ensure accuracy.
  • Track and identify trends in reported compliance issues and inquiries.
  • Regularly examine data reports to locate and resolve mistakes throughout.
  • Accurately analyze and collect data for various types of business reports.
  • Create business reports and dashboards that provide insight into key data points.
  • Communicate the results of data analysis in written and verbal form to managers.
  • Assists the Team with the maintenance of electronic data management systems in use in the Department. Including but not limited to – NAVEX; Imprivata; MDaudit; COI -Smart; Intelligent Contracts

Privacy

  • Assists the Privacy team with the coordination, development, facilitation, and enhancement of the Privacy Program through reporting trends, metrics and dashboards.
  • Assists the VP and Manager with coordinating system wide privacy and compliance projects which may include working closely with Information Security, Information Services, Human Resources, or operations teams to identify and implement process or system changes.
  • Responsible for the collection and analysis of privacy program data and analytics and development of standard and ad hoc reports.
  • Provides support to privacy-related initiatives including the planning and performance of privacy-based risk assessments and data-inventory processes. 
  • Provides support to the VP and Department Manager(s) and members of the compliance team in meeting federal and state reporting requirements, including the Office for Civil Rights, regarding breach notification and follow-up investigations.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of relevant privacy laws, regulations, rules, and standards and keeps abreast of privacy trends.
  • Assists the Manager and VP with requests for data sharing with external entities.

Compliance and Revenue Compliance

  • Assisting the Compliance Team with the management of general audits identified on the Annual Workplan and other audits as needed.
  • Develop and facilitate designated monitoring activities to assess compliance with policies. Responsible for ensuring monitoring is occurring on a consistent basis.
  • Assists with implementation of compliance training and education.
  • Supports the activities of the System Compliance Committee and Audit & Risk Committee, and implementation of the Compliance work plan.
  • Develop a strong understanding of the Compliance Services software tools to help optimize each tool to full potential.
  • Participates in committees and work groups representing Compliance as requested.
  • Handles all compliance and privacy matters with sensitivity and maintains strict confidentiality of all work material and activities.
  • At the direction of the Manager performs special projects related to Compliance.
  • Supports the development and implementation of a sustainable Privacy and Compliance management program.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree and at least a minimum of 2 years’ experience working as a data analyst, preferably in healthcare. Master’s degree preferred.

Experience

The ideal candidate will have strong data analytics skills. While we understand that no candidate will possess every skill listed, a minimum requirement for this position is proficiency in data analytics, including development of data driven reports, dashboards, and use of data analytics tools.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage time and prioritize projects to meet deadlines
  • Ability to use SQL and Microsoft Excel to create pivot tables, graphs and charts. Experience with Tableau and/or Microsoft PowerBI
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively relate data to coworkers
  • Tendency to pay close attention to small details that could impact results
  • Certification/Licensure: Certification in Healthcare Compliance (CHC) required within 12 months of hire.
  • Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint Skills Required.

Experience with Artificial Intelligence; Imprivata/or Privacy Surveillance software, NAVEX/Compliance Tracking Software; Revenue Cycle Audit solutions, and electronic health records preferred

Title: Enterprise Data Analyst
Description:
Husch Blackwell LLP is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations.

At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight


Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency


Dashboarding & Reporting


Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics


Data Management & Quality


Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities


Continuous Improvement & Growth


Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence


Position Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role (the role may be filled at more than one level; strong candidates earlier in their careers will also be considered)
Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations

The Data Visualization Analyst role is designed to help the commercial teams extract, summarize and visualize relevant past performance metrics to drive future performance. Work across multiple business teams learning how they operate, understanding insights they need to make decisions
Analyze information from multiple data sources, external and internal to identify business drivers that affect growth and efficiency
Design reports, tools and tracking mechanisms
Translate ideas into tangible output


A Day in the Life...


Delivering insights using compelling Power BI or SAC visualization techniques for business team.
Ability to translate business needs into actionable reporting and visualization thru rapid prototyping and storytelling.
Building models and designing experiments that seek to uncover insights that drive performance.
Analyzing complex data made of unstructured, semi-structured and structured datasets to drive insights.
Active participant in designing creative new ways to use data to help commercial team drive growth.
Work in an environment with internal IT, business teams and external vendors to design and scale work-flows, templates and dashboards .

BA/BS in computer science or related field or equivalent relevant experience, preferably with a focus on data visualization
Minimum 5 years of related experience
Extensive experience with Data Visualization using tools like PowerBI (preferred) and Tableau
Demonstrate ability to work effectively with others within a complex, cross-functional and fast paced organization
Excellent communication. Ability to present ideas and insights to business stakeholders
CPG industry knowledge

At least 3 Years of Experience

Title: CEMA Business Intel Analyst
Description:
Job Description


Do you love to improve business processes and drive improvement through data analytics? Are you looking for a role that supports a diverse and growing portfolio developing and producing the most advanced electronic systems that protect our warfighters? Are you inspired to join an organization with a strong culture that’s focused on ensuring we hear all voices, being brilliant on the basics, and developing our teams and leaders? BAE systems put our customers first – exemplified by our mission “We Protect Those Who Protect Us®. Come join our team!

We are seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst who will partner with a diverse team of directors, managers, engineers, technicians, and operators to develop solutions for gathering and analyzing data to help overcome challenges and improve business execution. The role requires use of your process knowledge to rapidly translate complex data into actionable insights, improving data accuracy and automation to accelerate ramp to rate, and serve as the factory‑floor liaison to ensure that quantitative findings lead to tangible quality and throughput gains. Candidates must have strong analytical, statistical, and communication skills, a solid foundation in manufacturing processes, and thrive in fast‑paced, dynamic environments.



Key Responsibilities



Partner with cross‑functional teams to turn production data into insights that boost product yield, flow, and cost efficiency.
Be a spokesperson for the factories and get involved in the design, testing, and implementation of dashboards and other data tools with the Analytics Team.
Use data analysis to determine areas for improved process yields, flows, on-time delivery and cost savings measures.
Work directly with the process and product teams to implement improvements.
Champion the implementation of AI solutions and assistants to the factory end users.


If you want an exciting opportunity in a fast-paced environment, where you can partner with a diverse team and contribute to our mission, then this position will provide tremendous professional and personal satisfaction.



Required Education, Experience, & Skills



Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of related work experience
Experience with manufacturing standards, processes and techniques
Strong technical skills in data analysis
Strong communication skills
Experience working in cross functional teams
Experience using dashboards and reporting for business intelligence
Experience using GenAI models for analysis




Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills



Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or a technical field
Background in data analytics or data science
Experience with Mat lab, Python, SQL, or other programming language
Experience in project management
Process or Product Engineering experience
New product introduction experience
Proven success with change management in a fast-paced, manufacturing environment



Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $118095 - $200762

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.

Title: Product Analyst
Description:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance and healthspan. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is hiring Product Analysts to embed across the product organization and serve as strategic analytics partners to teams across Healthcare, Algorithms, AI, Hardware, and other product areas. In this role, you will help define how WHOOP measures product success, uncover insights that shape roadmap decisions, and translate complex data into clear recommendations that improve the member experience. You will bring strong analytical rigor, product intuition, and intellectual curiosity to help teams make faster, smarter, and more impactful decisions with data.

Responsibilities


Partner with Product, Engineering, Research, Design, and cross-functional leadership to inform strategy and roadmap decisions with data.
Own the analytical narrative for your product area, illustrated by defining KPIs, refining measurement frameworks, and surfacing insights that drive action.
Support experimentation and feature launches end-to-end: from defining success metrics to post-launch analysis and iteration.
Build scalable, self-serve reporting & tooling that lets your stakeholders make decisions without waiting on you.
Develop deep context on your product domain and use it to ask sharper questions, challenge assumptions, and push the product forward.
Proactively surface insights and recommendations that go beyond the ask; identify opportunities others haven't seen yet.
Collaborate with a high-performance analytics team in a fast-paced environment where intellectual curiosity is the baseline expectation.


Qualifications


You've done this before: 2-6+ years in an analytical role where you owned business-critical metrics or initiatives. (We're hiring across levels; we'll figure out the right fit together.)
You use AI tools proactively and hold AI-assisted work to the same bar as your own.
You can take a vague question, wrangle the right data, isolate insights, and communicate actionable recommendations to stakeholders who aren't data people.
You're a strong storyteller: you know how to make a compelling, concise case for action.
You're technically sharp: advanced SQL is table stakes. Familiarity with modern data stacks (Snowflake, dbt, ELT workflows) and visualization tools (Hex, Sigma, Amplitude, Looker) is a plus.
You have product sense: you think about the member experience, not just the numbers.
You're curious about how things work. Algorithms, hardware, health science: you don't need to be an expert, but you should want to understand.
You're a self-starter who thrives in ambiguity and doesn't wait to be told what to work on.
TEAMS WE'RE HIRING FOR


We’re Looking For Multiple Analysts To Work Across Our Product Teams. During The Interview Process, We'll Work With You To Find The Right Team Fit Based On Your Interests And Strengths


AI Product: The future of intelligent coaching and personalized insights powered by AI/ML.
Algorithms: Where the science meets the product; sleep, recovery, strain, and how algorithmic outputs translate into member value.
Hardware Product: The physical device experience; sensors, wearability, and next-gen hardware.
Healthcare Product: Building WHOOP's Health Operating System; health outcomes, clinical features, personalized wellness.


This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $100,000 - $155,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

Title: Business Intelligence Developer
Description:
Role Purpose

Your job is to turn data into decisions. Hollingsworth & Vose is a global specialty manufacturer with mill operations across the Americas, Europe, and Asia — and the people running those operations, from the mill floor to senior management, need numbers they can trust and analytics they can act on. You build those.




A dashboard is not the outcome. The outcome is a plant manager who catches a margin problem a month earlier, or a finance team that stops arguing about whose number is right. We measure this role by results that matter to the business, not by reports shipped. Trust is the product — you treat it that way.




This is also a role for someone who wants to build with AI, not just read about it. We are embedding AI into how IT delivers — natural-language access to data, automated insights, AI-assisted development — and this role sits at the center of that work.




What You Own

Analytics people rely on. Power BI dashboards and reports covering trend, variance, cost, and margin analysis — with drill-through, drill-down, parameters, and dynamic filtering that let people answer their own next question.
Semantic models that hold up. Accurate models, measures, and KPIs. Multi-site, multi-currency, imperial/metric — handled correctly, to our site and item naming conventions, every time. If two reports disagree, that’s your problem to run down.
The data behind the numbers. Strong SQL against Oracle EBS and our MES database to source, validate, and shape data. You verify before you publish — and when a number is wrong, “the source data was bad” is where your job starts, not where it ends.
The sales cube. Develop against our central SSAS multidimensional cube (live connection / MDX) for cross-ERP, multi-currency sales and margin analysis.
The existing SSRS estate. Maintain and rationalize current SSRS reports while the future state takes shape.
AI in production. Build AI features into Power BI and our internal applications — natural-language Q&A, automated insights, anomaly detection, AI-assisted workflows — and use AI tools daily in your own development.
The relationship. You listen first. You partner with stakeholders to understand the goal behind the question, and you deliver recommendations, not just charts. Nobody who depends on your work waits in the dark for a status update.
Trust in the numbers. Data accuracy, documentation, and version control. Done means running in production, validated against source, documented, and handed off.




The Environment You’ll Work In

We’re honest about this: it’s a real manufacturing systems landscape, not a greenfield. The craft here is turning a complex environment into analytics people trust — if that sounds like work worth doing, you’ll like it here.

Oracle E-Business Suite — OPM process and discrete manufacturing (recipes, batches, inventory, standard costing), AP/AR/GL, and order management, with significant in-house customization.
A manufacturing execution system (MES) — sales orders, machine utilization, mill cost, raw-material consumption, quality metrics, and production scheduling.
A central SSAS multidimensional sales cube aggregating data across ERP systems, with multi-currency and standard-vs-actual cost and margin analysis.
Reporting today is largely SSRS and Power BI; AI tooling is expanding rapidly.




Required

3–5 years building analytical Power BI reports and dashboards — DAX, semantic modeling, performance tuning, row-level security.
Strong SQL with hands-on experience querying Oracle databases.
Experience consuming SSAS multidimensional cubes from Power BI, including MDX — not tabular/DAX only.
SSRS report development or maintenance experience.
Hands-on use of AI tools in your development work (tool-agnostic), and a genuine interest in building AI features into reports and applications.
An analytical mindset — you interpret data, spot trends, and frame insight for decision-making.
A strong communicator who partners well with non-technical stakeholders and works as part of a team.
Comfortable working on-site at a manufacturing mill.




Preferred

Oracle E-Business Suite experience, especially OPM process manufacturing.
MES experience (Tieto TIPS a plus).
Manufacturing or process-industry domain knowledge — costing, recipes, production and quality data.
Master data management (MDM) exposure — working with item, customer, or site master data across multiple systems, or contributing to data governance and standardization efforts.
Power Query / dataflows, paginated reports, or Microsoft Fabric experience.

Title: BI Developer II
Description:
Job Description

We are currently hiring a BI Developer II in Boston, MA.

The BI Developer II role drives business insights at BBC by delivering dashboards, reports, and semantic models on the Power BI platform. This role combines business intelligence development with a consultative approach, partnering with stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver scalable analytics solutions aligned to business objectives. Within the Power BI Center of Excellence (COE), the role promotes best practices and supports self-service analytics through documentation, coaching, and user enablement. It also contributes to data preparation and modeling to ensure data quality and performance, while supporting enterprise BI platforms by maintaining reliability, troubleshooting issues, and responding to user needs.

What You'll Brew:


Partner with stakeholders to define analytics requirements and deliver dashboards, semantic models, and data analytics products aligned to business objectives
Support data modeling and transformation activities to ensure data quality, performance, and well-structured semantic models
Promote best practices and provide coaching, documentation, and training to support adoption of self-service analytics through the Power BI COE
Support enterprise BI platforms by troubleshooting data, reporting, and platform issues, and contributing to performance improvements
Ensure analytics solutions follow governance and security standards, including adherence to enterprise policies and access controls
Provide responsive user support, identify opportunities to improve processes and automate workflows, and serve as backup for IT Data & Analytics team members as needed


What Ingredients You'll Bring:


2+ years of professional experience within the Data & Analytics space
1+ years of Power BI experience, including semantic modeling and visualization
1+ year of experience with SQL and data transformation workflows
Experience in a customer-facing role working with end users on requirements, coaching, and training


Desired Experience:


Experience support enterprise solutions for Corporate & Sales functional areas
Experience with programming languages such as Python


Additional Skills:


Strong understanding of semantic data modeling, DAX, and BI best practices, with experience working in Power BI and structured data environments
Ability to translate data into clear, actionable insights that support business decision-making
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to partner effectively with stakeholders
Curiosity and interest in emerging analytics technologies, including AI and automation, with a willingness to learn and apply new capabilities


Level: 7

At the Boston Beer Company and in accordance with pay transparency laws, we are open about our salary ranges. For this role, the salary range is between $77,000 and $132,000. However, it’s important to note that where the person hired starts in this range is dependent on their related experience, skillset and location. Additionally, this position qualifies for a discretionary annual bonus based on company and individual performance, and certain sales roles might include a car allowance.

Job Description

Business Intelligence Engineer II

Boston, MA – Marketing Operations – Full time – R30321

What You’ll Do


Develop and implement analytical frameworks to measure the impact of digital assets on customer behavior, operational performance, and financial outcomes.
Support experiment design, analyze results from product launches and feature enhancements, and translate findings into actionable insights.
Design, build, and maintain scalable analytics dashboards and reporting solutions that provide accurate, timely, and intuitive insights for internal and external stakeholders.
Design, develop, optimize, and maintain data architectures and data pipelines using SQL to support analytical and reporting needs in alignment with business requirements and data engineering st practices.
Assess data requirements for Healthcare and related business functions, collaborate with technical teams to deliver proof-of-concept analyses, perform data quality validation, and develop new data tables, metrics, and analytical products.
Contribute to automation initiatives for data ingestion, transformation, and distribution of recurring reports and datasets to multiple stakeholder groups, maintain and enhance documentation for key metrics and datasets, and participate in data governance and quality assurance processes.
Document technical designs and analytical work using tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Git, monitor existing metrics and report outputs, propose refinements and optimizations, and collaborate cross-functionally to deliver data-driven insights that support business decision-making.


Other: 5% domestic travel required. Telecommuting permitted up to 2 days per week.

What You’ll Need


Minimum Requirements: Bachelors degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Engineering, or related field, and 5 years of experience as a Business Intelligence Analyst, or related position/occupation.
Alternative Requirements: Masters in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Engineering, or related field, and 2 years of experience as a Business Intelligence Analyst, or related position/occupation.
Experience or coursework must include:
Automating data processes, developing dashboards, and building scalable analytics solutions in an ecommerce, omni-channel, or retail setting;
Managing ETL or data transformation processes, technical architecture documents, and deliver net new or enhancing existing data warehouses;
Data platforms such as: Snowflake, AWS, Vertica, or comparable data pipelines;
SQL;
Writing, debugging, and optimizing SQL queries; and
Data modeling in large, cloud-based data warehousing/data lake environments.

Here are the details:

Position: Technical Data Analyst

Client: Commonwealth of MA (EHS)

Location: Boston, MA

Duration: Thru 6/30/27 (with possibility of extension)

Pay rate: $62-$65/hour

Description of Role and Responsibilities:

The Commonwealth of MA is looking for a Technical Data Analyst to support enterprise data quality, migration and integration initiatives. The ideal candidate will have experience assessing, profiling, cleansing, validating, and transforming large datasets while developing reporting and integration solutions to support business and technical teams.


Data Quality & Analysis
Perform data profiling and quality assessments to identify gaps, inconsistencies, duplicates, and validation issues across enterprise datasets.
Analyze data completeness, accuracy, consistency, uniqueness, and validity.
Design and execute data cleansing, standardization, transformation, and reconciliation activities to improve data quality.
Develop automated validation routines to compare source and target datasets and identify data issues.
Reporting & Analytics
Build and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using Tableau and/or Microsoft Power BI.
Develop KPIs and visualizations to track data quality, migration readiness, and operational performance.
Analyze data quality metrics and communicate findings through executive dashboards and technical reports.
Data Migration & Documentation
Create and maintain data mapping documents, conversion templates, validation templates, reconciliation reports, and data quality scorecards.
Support enterprise data migration initiatives by ensuring accurate transformation and movement of data between systems.
Maintain detailed documentation of data processes, mappings, and validation activities.
Automation & Technical Development
Develop scripts and automated processes using SQL, Python, PowerShell, or similar technologies.
Automate data cleansing, validation, transformation, reconciliation, and exception reporting processes.
Support database analysis and data modeling activities within enterprise environments.
Integration & API Support
Support API integrations and enterprise data exchange using MuleSoft and REST APIs.
Assist with API testing, validation, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.
Work with JSON, XML, and enterprise integration patterns to support data connectivity.
Support integrations with cloud applications, including CRM platforms such as Salesforce.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with business and technical teams to define data requirements and quality standards.
Collaborate with stakeholders to support enterprise data governance and lifecycle management initiatives.
Participate in Agile delivery environments and contribute to project planning and execution activities.
Preferred Experience
Salesforce CRM implementation, migration, or data quality experience.
Experience with ETL and enterprise data integration tools.
Familiarity with Cloudingo, DemandTools, Informatica, Talend, or similar data quality platforms.
Experience working within healthcare, provider, payer, or other regulated industries.


Required Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
5+ years of experience in data analysis, data quality, or data management in enterprise environments.
Strong understanding of data governance, data quality principles, and data lifecycle management.
Strong SQL skills and experience with scripting languages such as Python or PowerShell.
Experience with Tableau and/or Microsoft Power BI.
Experience supporting MuleSoft integrations and REST APIs.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

Description:
About Us:

As a company, we promote a culture of honesty and integrity, and value the trust it allows us to build with customers and employees alike. Our focus on our people is what sets us apart and keeps our customers coming back to work with us!

If you are seeking to be a part of a family, this is the place for you!

Maersk Logistics & Services USA, Inc. handles end-to-end warehousing and distribution logistics needs utilizing our strategic network of storage facilities. Our facilities are capable of receiving, storing, processing and dispatching cargo, so we can build flexibility and resilience into the supply chain process. Our integrated solutions allow us to be prepared for supply chain risks, so we can plan distribution to better achieve lead time and goals despite unexpected conditions. Our extensive experience, connections, and deep expertise across different sectors, industries, and transportation modes, means we can be counted on for process excellence that will save time and money.

Summary

The Data Analyst supports warehouse operations by transforming operational data into actionable insights that improve productivity, quality, labor utilization, and customer service. This role partners closely with operations leadership to identify trends, develop reporting, and drive data-informed decision-making across a fast-paced distribution environment.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills with the ability to communicate findings to business leaders and develop scalable reporting solutions.

Key Responsibilities:


Analyze operational performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and root causes.
Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and recurring reports using business intelligence tools.
Monitor key operational metrics, including productivity, quality, throughput, inventory accuracy, labor utilization, and service performance
Partner with operations managers to support labor planning, staffing analysis, and capacity forecasting.
Conduct ad hoc analyses to support business initiatives and operational improvements.
Translate complex datasets into clear recommendations for frontline leadership and senior management.
Validate data accuracy and investigate discrepancies across multiple systems.
Automate recurring reporting processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
Support continuous improvement initiatives through statistical analysis and performance measurement.
Present findings and recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders.


Qualifications:


1-3 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, supply chain, manufacturing, or distribution operations.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills including Pivot Tables, Power Query, Power Pivot, and complex formulas.
Experience writing SQL queries to extract and analyze data.
Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence platforms.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced operational environment.


Company Benefits:


Medical
Dental
Vision
401k + Company Match
Employee Assistance Program
Paid Time Off
Flexible Work Schedules (when possible)
And more!

$60,000-$69,000*

Title: Supply Chain Planning Analyst
Description:
Who We Are

At Harvey Performance Company, we're more than a team; we're a community. Our thriving, dynamic, and rapidly expanding organization values community, celebrates success, and fosters personal and professional growth opportunities.

The Opportunity

The Planning Analyst builds the data, dashboards, and KPI reporting that support Demand Planning, Production Planning, and inventory optimization at Harvey Performance Company. This is a newly created role for an analyst who can write SQL, build Power BI dashboards, and translate a planner's question into a query and a useful report. You'll work closely with our planning leadership and database team, with direct mentorship and support as you grow into the role. You'll also contribute to a new planning and inventory optimization system going in later this year. Rowley, MA preferred with one day per week onsite. Remote across New England considered for the right candidate.

In This Role, You Will


Build and maintain KPI reporting and dashboards for Demand Planning and Production Planning, covering service performance, inventory health, forecast accuracy, and planning execution.
Write SQL against ERP sources (Epicor P21, SAP, Kinetic) to produce repeatable, validated datasets that planners and buyers can trust.
Develop planning data models in Power BI that surface what matters and leave out what doesn't.
Help establish data validation routines and refresh cadences that create a single source of truth for planning data.
Support tuning of planning parameters (lead times, MOQs, safety stock) alongside Production Planning and Demand Planning.
Contribute to the upcoming inventory optimization and demand planning system rollout, including requirements gathering, field mapping, testing, and post-deployment KPI validation, with guidance from planning leadership.
Partner with IT and the database team on data access and reporting.
Build repeatable analytical workflows that reduce manual effort over time.


You'll Bring


2+ years in analytics, BI, or supply chain/planning analysis, ideally in a manufacturing or distribution environment.
Solid SQL skills, including joins and validation logic. You can write queries from scratch, not just modify existing ones.
Power BI experience building dashboards that operating teams actually use.
Familiarity with supply chain basics: PO flow, sales order flow, and planning master data (items, lead times, MOQs, safety stock), or a strong interest in learning them.
Exposure to an ERP system. Epicor or SAP a plus, but any major ERP works.
Ability to translate business questions into analytical solutions and work cross-functionally with IT and operations.
Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain a dashboard to a non-technical stakeholder and a data model to an IT partner.


Nice To Have


Exposure to a planning systems implementation (requirements, field mapping, UAT, post-deployment validation).
Familiarity with a modern demand planning or inventory optimization tool (Kinaxis, o9, Logility, Blue Yonder, OMP, RELEX, SAP IBP, or similar).
Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Analytics, Engineering, Finance, MIS, or related field.


Where You'll Work

Find yourself in the heart of Rowley, MA, where our modern facility resides. Experience the balance between vibrant professional growth at Harvey and the soothing, scenic lifestyle of this quaint North Shore town. We champion work-life harmony and invite you to be part of our journey.

What Harvey Provides


A fun, rapid-growing environment where new opportunities are regularly made available.
Opportunities for training and development, including tuition reimbursement.
A comprehensive benefits package, including PTO, paid holidays, health, dental, vision insurance, and a 401k match program, along with profit sharing.


The pay range for this position is $75K to $85K annually. This range reflects what the company reasonably expects to pay at the time of posting. Where an individual’s pay falls within the range will depend on their skills, background, and performance.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Title: Business Intelligence Engineer, Amazon Robotics
Description:
Description

We are looking for an experienced and enthusiastic Business Intelligence Engineer to join the BI Engineering, Analytics, & Data Science (BAND) team supporting Robotic Storage Tech (RST) programs within Amazon Robotics. In this role, you will bring a strong foundation in statistics to support the introduction of new containerized and workcell robotic products — from early concept through deployment. You will partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders to translate ambiguous questions about new product performance into structured analyses, and author recommendation-focused deliverables that inform program decisions and shape how new robotic systems progress through RST's development lifecycle. You will design, develop, and maintain dashboards, reports, and other analytics artifacts purpose-built for new product introduction — tracking system maturity, surfacing readiness gaps, and enabling data-driven milestone decisions. You are a collaborative problem-solver who thinks holistically about how new systems evolve from prototype to production and uses data to accelerate that journey.

Key job responsibilities


Statistical Analysis for New Products: Execute foundational statistical methods including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, design of experiments, and regression analysis to evaluate new containerized and workcell system performance against readiness criteria at each development phase.
Stakeholder Partnership: Collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Program Managers, and engineering teams to translate ambiguous new product questions into structured analyses that support milestone decisions.
Data Source Development: Identify and onboard data sources from new containerized and workcell systems as they come online, define NPI-relevant metrics, and build data pipelines that enable performance tracking.
Whitepaper & Insights Delivery: Author recommendation-focused whitepapers and deep-dive analyses that inform new product development decisions — including system configuration trade-offs, readiness assessments, and deployment strategy recommendations.
BI Ownership: Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reporting solutions that track new containerized and workcell products through their Alpha, Beta, and General Availability phases, providing visibility into system maturation and operational readiness.


A day in the life

On any given day, you might be helping run a designed experiment to evaluate a configuration change on a new workcell system, building a readiness dashboard for a containerized product approaching its Beta milestone, or authoring a whitepaper that supports a recommendation whether a new system is ready to advance to the next development phase. You will own major components of the BAND team's NPI analytics infrastructure for RST, including contributing to data architecture decisions and delivering reports that track new products from through General Availability.

You will maintain a deep understanding of data lineage across your BI solutions — from the telemetry and event streams generated by new containerized and workcell systems, through metric aggregation processes, to how insights are consumed at milestone reviews and program readiness gates. You will create and optimize scripts (SQL, Python, R, Shell) to streamline BI processes and select appropriate analytics and visualization tools to meet diverse new product evaluation needs.

Your work will directly influence how new containerized and workcell products move through RST's development pipeline and shape the future of Amazon's robotic storage technology landscape.

About The Team

Robotic Storage Tech (RST) invents, designs, and develops transformational storage solutions used in the Amazon Logistic Network. We will realize the next generation of automated containerized systems, and optimize our existing install base. We are a team of talented engineers, product evangelists, and creators focused on technologies that make inventory pick, stow, and count safer and more efficient for Amazon. We deliver value with our elite robotic technologies because we listen and respond to our many customers, develop robust and reliable solutions, and invest in both our people and our products.

Basic Qualifications


3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
Experience writing complex SQL queries
Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets

Title: Customer Experience Analyst
Description:
About SimpliSafe

We're a high-tech home security company that's passionate about protecting the life you've built and our mission of keeping Every Home Secure. And we've created a culture here that cares just as deeply about the career you're building. Ours is a no ego culture of collaboration and innovation where those seeking their next challenge can find big opportunities and make a huge impact on the lives of all those who we protect. We don't just want you to work here. We want you to grow and thrive here.

We're embracing a hybrid work model that enables our teams to split their time between office and home. Hybrid for us means we expect our teams to come together in our state-of-the-art office on two core days, typically Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday – working together in person and choosing where they work for the remainder of the week. We all benefit from flexibility and get to use the best of both worlds to get our work done.

Why are we hiring?

Well, we're growing and thriving. So, we need smart, talented, and humble people who share our values to join us as we disrupt the home security space and relentlessly pursue our mission of keeping Every Home Secure.

About The Job

The SimpliSafe CX Analytics team is looking for a Senior Analyst to co-own performance for our rapidly growing Telesales and Loyalty channels — both key strategic priorities for SimpliSafe's future growth. In this role, you won't just measure a team of 150+ agents driving new customer acquisition and subscriber retention — you will help set the strategy that determines whether they succeed.

This is a unique opportunity to build deep, sustained fluency in how Telesales and Loyalty actually operate — and to use that fluency to identify what the business should be doing differently, not just report on what it did. You will define the KPIs that matter, understand what truly drives them, forecast where they're headed, and then support experiments aimed at identifying the right tactics to beat that forecast. You will share accountability for the outcome with Operational leadership, not just for the accuracy of the analysis. Your responsibilities will include:


Own the full KPI lifecycle for Telesales and Loyalty performance: define the right KPIs at the channel and agent level, build and maintain the forecasts for them, and develop a deep understanding of what drives them
Originate and lead experimentation aimed at beating those forecasts — partnering with the business to identify test ideas and ensuring rigorous setup and measurement so the business can trust the read
Get close enough to the operation — the agents, the workflows, the day-to-day realities of Telesales and Loyalty — to spot risks and opportunities Operations can't see from the inside, and bring recommendations to leadership before they ask
Share accountability with Operational leadership for the business results, not just the integrity of the analysis — success is measured by whether Telesales and Loyalty performance improves, not just whether the reporting is right
Serve as data steward for the datasets underlying these KPIs, and use AI tools and automation to eliminate as much manual reporting and one-off analysis as possible — reinvesting that time into the work above


Qualifications:


BS in a quantitative field or equivalent experience (Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or related field)
5+ years of equivalent experience, or Masters + 3 years
Strong technical skills, including experience with query and data visualization tools. SQL and Excel are core requirements; experience with Tableau, Hex, or programming languages (Python, R, etc.) is a plus
Track record of proposing ideas and driving them to business impact, not just delivering requested analysis — comfortable being judged on whether the business outcome moved, not only on whether the work was correct
Experience designing and running experiments or pilots — including forming the hypothesis, not just measuring someone else's
Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with extreme attention to detail and the ability to work collaboratively in a dynamic, cross-functional environment
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to synthesize concepts for non-technical audiences and effectively engage partners across all levels of the company
Genuine interest in learning how a complex operation runs day-to-day — willing to spend real time with Ops and agents, not just their data — in order to identify the question behind the question
Comfort using AI tools to accelerate data prep and analysis, so more time goes toward business understanding and origination
Experience supporting contact center operations is a plus


What Values You'll Share


Customer Obsessed - Building deep empathy for our customers, putting them at the core of our work, and developing strong, long-term relationships with them.
Aim High - Always challenging ourselves and others to raise the bar.
No Ego - Maintaining a "no job too small" attitude, and an open, inclusive and humble style.
One Team - Taking a highly collaborative approach to achieving success.
Lift As We Climb - Investing in developing others and helping others around us succeed.
Lean & Nimble - Working with agility and efficiency to experiment in an often ambiguous environment.


What We Offer


A mission- and values-driven culture and a safe, inclusive environment where you can build, grow and thrive
A comprehensive total rewards package that supports your wellness and provides security for SimpliSafers and their families (For more information on our total rewards please click here)
Free SimpliSafe system and professional monitoring for your home.
Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that bring people together, give opportunities to network, mentor and develop, and advocate for change.


The target annual base pay range for this role is $80,000 to $105,000

This target annual base pay range represents our good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role. We use a market-based compensation approach to set our target annual base pay ranges and make adjustments annually. We carefully tailor individual compensation packages, including base pay, taking into consideration employees' job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and other relevant business factors.

Beyond base pay, we offer a Total Rewards package that may include participation in our annual bonus program, equity, and other forms of compensation, in addition to a full range of medical, retirement, and lifestyle benefits. More details can be found here.

We're committed to fair and equitable pay practices, as well as pay transparency. We regularly review our programs to ensure they remain competitive and aligned with our values.

We wholeheartedly embrace and actively seek applications from all individuals, no matter how they identify. We are committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we believe our work is enriched when we incorporate a multitude of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. We want everyone who works here to thrive and contribute to not only our mission of keeping every home secure, but also to making our workplace safe and supportive for others. The Enrollment Management Data Analyst will support the Enrollment Division’s data and reporting needs by providing advanced data analysis, reporting, and visualization to inform strategic enrollment decisions. Reporting to the Associate Director, Enrollment Systems & Technology, the Data Analyst position will work collaboratively across departments, including Undergraduate and Graduate Admissions and Student Financial Services, to provide insights and actionable recommendations on process effectiveness. The analyst will leverage data from the Student Information System, and additional internal and external sources to support the achievement of the enrollment goals.

Essential Job Duties


Analyze and report on key enrollment metrics, including applications, yield, retention, and financial aid data, to inform strategy and decision-making.
Develop and maintain dashboards and reports using data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) to provide stakeholders with accessible and actionable insights.
Extract, clean, and integrate data from various systems, including Slate, Banner/Workday, and other institutional platforms, to support comprehensive reporting.
Collaborate with Enrollment Division teams to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for improving recruitment, retention, and student success.
Ensure data quality and consistency by developing and implementing data validation processes, resolving discrepancies, and maintaining accurate records related to student data across all enrollment systems.
Conduct predictive modeling for yield rates and statistical analysis to forecast enrollment trends and assess the impact of recruitment and financial aid strategies.
Support ad hoc data requests and analyses to address emerging needs and priorities across the Enrollment Division.
Ensure the integrity, accuracy, and security of enrollment data in compliance with institutional policies and FERPA regulations.
Partner with Institutional Research and IT to improve data workflows and systems integrations.
Provide training and support to Enrollment Division staff on data tools and analytics best practices.


QUALIFICATIONS – Qualifications are deemed required or preferred and represent what is needed to effectively perform the job.


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline such as Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field required.
3+ years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or related functions, preferably in higher education or enrollment management required.
Proficiency in SQL and experience working with relational databases required. Knowledge of Python or R preferred.
Familiarity with CRM systems such as Slate or other higher education platforms required.


KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES – May be representative, but not all-inclusive, of those knowledge, skills, and abilities commonly associated with the job.


Strong skills in data visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Strong verbal and written communication skills to convey complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
High level of initiative and ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
Understanding of data governance and ethical considerations in data analysis.
Flexibility to adapt to changing needs and priorities in a fast-paced environment.


PHYSICAL ABILITIES – Activities commonly associated with the performance of the functions of this job. The physical demands described below are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.


This position is generally sedentary in nature, movement throughout the area is required from time to time.
Ability to have continuous oral and written communication with students, co-workers and supervisors is essential.
Repetitive movements, occasional lifting of up to 10 pounds, reaching, lifting, stooping and the ability to read a computer screen, detect color-coding and read fine print will be expected.


WORK ENVIRONMENT – Environmental or atmospheric conditions commonly associated with the performance of the functions of this job.


Usual office conditions
Exposed to moderate noise levels

Employees may be required to follow other job-related instructions and to perform other job-related duties as requested, subject to all applicable state and federal laws. Certain job duties described herein may be subject to possible modification in accordance with applicable state and federal laws.

Compensation: $74,500.00 - $91,350.00 annually, commensurate with experience.

Grade of Position: 23-09E

Employment Category: Regular

Scheduled Weekly Hours: 36.25

In addition to a competitive salary, Emerson College is committed to the health and well-being of our employees and family members. We offer a generous benefits package to regular staff scheduled to work 20+ hours per week.

Emerson Employment Categories influence work schedules, benefits eligibility, and time off policies. Benefits include outstanding health plans with limited out-of-pocket expenses, dental plans, generous time-off programs, and a 403(b) retirement benefit with a 9% employer contribution once eligible. Additional benefits, such as life and disability coverage and commuter offerings, are available.

Title: Manager, Advanced Data Analytics and Insights
Description:
Job Description

Note: Fidelity will not provide immigration sponsorship for this position.

The Role

As a Manager, Advanced Data Analytics in the Advanced Analytics and Customer Insights organization you would have the opportunity to directly contribute towards this future. We are looking for an analytics professional to be a creative and collaborative team member, helping develop and lead data and hypothesis driven initiatives. You'll be embedded in our Digital Assets business and will partner together to help support and evolve Fidelity Digital Assets® offerings that demonstrate Fidelity’s commitment to customer value and high customer experience standards.

This role requires a dedicated, committed, and passionate individual who can:


Create and summarizes large datasets in structured and unstructured data.
Collect and analyze data / develop insights and reporting capabilities to empower organizational leaders to make decisions.
Create solutions leveraging deep statistical analysis to drive thought leadership across the Digital Assets organization
Work across diverse skilled teams to find success for Fidelity and our customers.
Have a natural intellectual curiosity, initiative, and love for learning new skills and capabilities.


The Expertise And Skills You Bring


Bachelor’s degree required, Advanced Degree a plus.
4 plus years of experience generating analytical insights to drive business actions.
Experience with a range of analytical tools and programming languages such as SQL, Python, R, etc.
Experience in designing and developing dashboards and reports by using Tableau, Power BI, Qlik, etc; Business Objects experience a plus.
Experience using and querying big data technologies such as Snowflake, Athena, etc.
Experience with digital analytics using tools such as Adobe Analytics.
Experience in Digital Assets a plus.


The Team

Fidelity Digital Assets® is dedicated to building products and services that help institutions adopt digital assets and innovate within the increasingly digital world of finance. Fidelity Investments began researching blockchain technology and digital assets solutions in 2014, where years of research and development have provided us with the deep expertise necessary to build the future of finance.

The Fidelity Digital Assets® Advanced Analytics and Customer Insights team is central to enhancing and delivering reporting and data analysis capabilities that serve Fidelity Digital Assets® Product and Operations stakeholders with insights on our products and customer segments. Members of our team are highly dynamic, team-oriented and partner with each other, business partners and their teams. We lead by example, seek to continuously improve, deliver creative solutions that solve complex challenges and/or advance the business, and seek to increase the value we provide through our business insights practice.

Fidelity’s Onsite Working Model

Fidelity is transitioning to a full-time onsite working model through a phased rollout across regions and roles. Currently, some roles and locations require 100% onsite presence, while others require less. Onsite expectations are likely to evolve as the rollout continues. This transition does not apply to fully remote roles.

Certifications

Category:

Data Analytics and Insights

Those laws and regulations may restrict Fidelity from hiring and/or associating with individuals with certain Criminal Histories.

Title: Senior Data Analyst (Remote)
Description:
Job Description


You don’t see it, but it’s there. Our employees work on the world’s most advanced electronics – from saving emissions in the City of Lights to powering the Mars Rover to protecting the F-35 fighter jet. At Electronic Systems, you’ll be among the brightest minds, working on the aerospace and defense industry’s most difficult problems. Drawing strength from our differences, we’re innovating for the future. And you can, too. Our flexible work environment provides you a chance to change the world without giving up your personal life. We put our customers first – exemplified by our missions: “We Protect Those Who Protect Us®” and “We Innovate For Those Who Move The WorldTM.” Sound like a team you want to be a part of? Come build your career with BAE Systems.

Our engineers are the lifeblood of our company and we’re more than 5,000 strong. With our robust offering of educational and career development opportunities, your chances to grow are limitless.

The Engineering Operations & Capability group is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to help develop, transform, and model data to improve decision making. You are responsible for data extraction and manipulation of data sets resulting in workflows and predictive models for end-users using system tools (dashboards). You will conduct analysis on data to ensure correct predictive forecasting. You will manage the analytics request process by capturing requirements and are responsible for the creation and maintenance of the resulting analytic dashboards.



Roles And Responsibilities



Integrate diverse data streams
Ensure data integrity and accuracy, adhering to security and confidentiality protocols
Establish data standards and act as custodian of data sets and streams
Collect, process, and perform statistical analyses on large datasets to support decision-making
Develop dashboards and visualizations for programmatic and functional teams
Collaborate with multiple stakeholders to understand data needs and provide tailored analytical solutions
Utilize advanced analytical tools and techniques to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies in intelligence data




Required Education, Experience, & Skills



Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, Software Engineering, or related field
4+ years of data system engineering, data analytics, data science, or related field
Proven experience in leading projects for data engineering and data analysis and integrating diverse data streams
Strong technical skills in data engineering, data analysis, data visualization, and data storytelling
Experience in data cleaning, performing statistical analysis, and visualizing data using tools like Tableau or Power BI
Proficiency in programming languages and frameworks such as C# and Python.
Strong understanding of database management and data warehousing concepts
Knowledge of the complex environment involving shared networks
Strong understanding of data management principles, including data governance, data quality, data security, and data literacy
Team player with a proactive attitude and the ability to be productive in a dynamic/collaborative environment
Strong oral and written communications skills




Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills



Experience with machine learning, deep learning, or natural language processing
Database design using SQL or NoSQL based data management systems
Certification in data analytics, data science, or related field (e.g., Certified Data Scientist, Certified Analytics Professional)
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities
Ability to motivate and inspire team members to achieve high-performance results
Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills



Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $97008 - $164914

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.



About BAE Systems Electronic Systems


BAE Systems, Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems plc, an international defense, aerospace and security company which delivers a full range of products and services for air, land and naval forces, as well as advanced electronics, security, information technology solutions and customer support services. Improving the future and protecting lives is an ambitious mission, but it’s what we do at BAE Systems. Working here means using your passion and ingenuity where it counts – defending national security with breakthrough technology, superior products, and intelligence solutions. As you develop the latest technology and defend national security, you will continually hone your skills on a team—making a big impact on a global scale. At BAE Systems, you’ll find a rewarding career that truly makes a difference. Electronic Systems (ES) is the global innovator behind BAE Systems’ game-changing defense and commercial electronics. Exploiting every electron, we push the limits of what is possible, giving our customers the edge and our employees opportunities to change the world. Our products and capabilities can be found everywhere – from the depths of the ocean to the far reaches of space. At our core are more than 14,000 highly talented Electronic Systems employees with the brightest minds in the industry, we make an impact – for our customers and the communities we serve.

This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

Title: Founding Data Analyst
Description:
About Counsel

Counsel’s mission is to multiply the world's healthcare capacity. We believe in a future in which every person has a personalized, AI-enabled doctor always in their pocket. To accomplish this, we’re building the first fully-vertical, AI-native medical group from the ground up. We’ve redesigned the entire clinical stack with custom AI tools that make our in-house physicians 10x faster and smarter. [learn more on our blog]

Since our founding in 2023, we have formed partnerships with leading healthcare organizations and are on track to serve hundreds of thousands of patients on our platform within the next year. We have raised over $35M from a16z, Google Ventures, Pear VC and other top-tier VC firms.

Our team combines deep expertise in medicine (Harvard, Mt. Sinai, Mass General, UCSF) and technology (MIT, Google, DeepMind, NVIDIA, Stripe, Meta) — and we’re looking for exceptional people to join us as we scale.

Join us as we build the future of AI in healthcare!

About The Role

We're hiring a Founding Data Analyst to join our FinOps team and build the data foundation that powers Counsel's growth. This is an early-stage, high-impact founding role spanning data wrangling and pipeline development, defining and tracking core operating metrics, and improving reporting and operational workflows across the business.

You'll work directly with our SVP, Finance & Operations and collaborate across Commercial/GTM, Finance, Clinical Ops, and Operations. Instead of owning a small slice of the business, you'll gain broad exposure and take on increasing responsibility as you help build and improve the systems that keep the company running and scaling. This role will have executive level cross functional partnership and requires the ability to connect dots across stakeholders in various organizations.

What You'll Do


Build and maintain the data foundation that will power the entire company.
Support the data needs of stakeholders across every function at the company. This will range from product metrics, commercial / client reporting, internal financial and operating metrics.
Build the Operating Scorecard and management dashboards so the entire team can have visibility on business performance and one source of truth.
Partner with Analytics Engineer to validate pipelines and metric definitions.
Turn messy datasets into answers people can act on.
Build and adopt AI-powered tools and workflows that make FinOps faster and efficient.


What You'll Bring


Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (CS, statistics, applied math, or similar), with meaningful programming experience
