Title: Business Analyst II, Operations
Description:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance and healthspan. Our wearable technology provides personalized insights that help millions of members better understand their bodies, and make smarter decisions about training, recovery, and lifestyle.

We're looking for a Business Analyst to embed with our Operations team, specifically supporting the Manufacturing & Quality streams by helping bridge the gap between operational processes and data. This role will be instrumental in building out quality analytics capabilities across the product lifecycle, from production through field performance. You'll own key quality metrics, develop new reporting, build new tools, and partner with manufacturing and field quality engineers to turn operational data into decisions.

This is a high-impact role for someone who is able to successfully use analytical skills to target operational challenges and drive continuous improvement.

Responsibilities


Partner with Field Quality, Manufacturing, and Reliability Engineering teams to define and monitor product quality KPIs across the supply chain
Own quality metrics reporting on production yields, field failure rates, supplier quality indicators to proactively surface trends related to product build and performance
Develop and maintain reporting and self-service analytics tooling for operations stakeholders
Support ad-hoc analyses for test result validation, issue containment & impact sizing, failure mode investigations, cost quantification
Collaborate with Data Platform and Analytics Engineering to land new relevant quality data sources in Snowflake and build them into usable models
Help define data capture standards for new processes (e.g., incoming inspection, NPI qualification, supplier data) where structured data doesn't exist today
Translate between technical data requirements and operational stakeholders, ensuring operations teams get answers without needing to have detailed technical background


Qualifications


2+ years of experience in an analytical or operational role with a focus on data and analytics. Functional experience working with quality processes and data is a plus.
Demonstrated experience working with cross-functional partners to use data to drive results and initiatives.
Strong technical and analytical skills, including proficiency in SQL and familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Sigma, Hex, or similar). Familiarity with modern data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake) and analytics workflows (e.g., dbt, ELT) is a plus.
Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions
Ability to translate complex analyses into clear, actionable recommendations, enabling technical and operational stakeholders to make informed decisions and drive measurable improvements.
Comfortable operating in evolving environments where processes, systems, and data structures are still being built and refined.
Proactive mindset with a desire to deeply understand operational processes and continuously improve them through data.


This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $100,000 - $125,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

We seek individuals who share our passion and determination. Our commitment to customer success drives us to go the extra mile. If you’re ready to join us in this mission, take a closer look at the minimum criteria for the position.


5+ years of professional experience in data governance, data quality, data engineering, analytics engineering, or a related data role.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience with data platforms and tooling and enjoys partnering with data owners, stewards, architects, and engineers.

  • Lead the implementation and operationalization of enterprise data governance standards, policies, and controls across core data domains.
  • Develop data quality checks, validation rules, monitoring frameworks, technical metadata, business glossaries, and lineage documentation.
  • Collaborate with Data Owners, Stewards, architects, engineers, and application teams to define business rules, critical data elements, and ownership models.
  • Build and configure data governance, data quality, and catalog tools while integrating governance capabilities into data pipelines, ERP systems, and analytics platforms.
  • Support root cause analysis, remediation of data quality issues, governance onboarding, training, and adoption for stewards and technical teams.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to continuously improve Teradyne’s data governance operating model and proactively identify governance and data quality risks.

All About You

We seek individuals who share our passion and determination. Our commitment to customer success drives us to go the extra mile. If you’re ready to join us in this mission, take a closer look at the minimum criteria for the position.

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data governance, data quality, data engineering, analytics engineering, or a related data role.
  • Working knowledge of data governance concepts such as data ownership and stewardship, business glossaries and metadata management, and data quality dimensions and controls.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL, relational databases, data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Azure, AWS, or GCP.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical governance solutions.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to identify and resolve data quality issues across source systems and downstream platforms.
  • Experience with data governance, data quality, or catalog tools such as Informatica, Collibra, Alation, Atlan, or similar platforms.
  • Exposure to ERP systems such as Oracle and master data domains.
  • Experience supporting analytics, reporting, or AI/ML use cases.
  • Familiarity with data privacy and compliance concepts such as GDPR and SOX.
  • Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work closely with data owners, stewards, architects, engineers, and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to support training, onboarding, mentorship, and adoption for stewards and technical teams.
  • Data ownership and stewardship
  • Business glossaries and metadata management
  • Data quality dimensions and controls
  • SQL and relational databases
  • Data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes
  • Cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Azure, AWS, GCP)

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $116,900 - $187,100. This range is a good faith estimate, and the amount of base salary will correspond with experience and skill set. This range can also fluctuate depending on demand and location.

Incentive Plan: This job is eligible for discretionary bonus(es) based on financial performance.

Title: Marketing Analyst
Description:
Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are…

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.


WB Games is a leader in the games industry across all game platforms and mobile devices. Our diverse and inclusive workforce creates and brings to life the most beloved characters, franchises, heroes, and wizards in the world. We are fans of what we make and proud of what we do. We have studios and offices across the globe.




The Job

We produce hundreds of UA creative assets a month. We are looking for a UA Marketing Analyst to connect what we spend with what we make and turn that into insights the team can act on.

As our UA Marketing Analyst, you will run the weekly rhythm of what is working and why, build the visualizations and reporting the team lives in, and drive the recommendations that shape what we produce next, where spend goes, and how efficiently we scale.




The Daily

1. Insights and Weekly Reporting
Run the weekly performance readout: what is working, why, and what it means for creative production priorities.
Creative performance insights: Including creative performance by concept, hook, format, network, and geo; Winner rate; Fatigue curves.
Creative ROI: spend and return attributable to individual creatives and concept
Production efficiency: cost and cycle time per asset by production source (GenAI pod, playables, vendors), measured against the performance those assets deliver.
Translate all of the above into recommendations that help inform what the team produces
2. Visualizations and Reporting Infrastructure
Make performance data self-serve: visualizations and reporting that put answers where the team already works, so insight doesn't bottleneck on one person.
Decide what belongs in a dashboard, what belongs in an explore, and what belongs in a recurring readout.
Partner with central data and engineering teams on pipeline and warehouse dependencies.
3. Data Foundation and Hygiene
Inform the governed definition of creative performance tiers: the thresholds, the minimum spend and impression floors, the lookback windows, and the review cadence for changing them.
Build and monitor data quality checks. Surface discrepancies before they reach a slide.




The Essentials

3+ years in marketing, growth, or product analytics. Mobile UA experience strongly preferred.
Strong SQL. Comfortable modeling data, not just querying it.
Fluency with AI-assisted tooling (Claude, Gemini, Cursor) for analysis and automation.
Hands on experience with a BI tool (Looker, Tableau, or similar), including building and maintaining explores
Working knowledge of mobile attribution: MMP data (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Singular), SKAdNetwork and AdAttributionKit, network reporting discrepancies, and the limits of each.
Fluency in UA metrics: CPI, IPM, CTR, ROAS, etc
Ability to define a metric, defend the definition, and hold the line when someone wants a friendlier number.




The Nice to Haves

Experience analyzing creative performance specifically, including creative tagging and metadata frameworks.
Familiarity with GenAI creative production workflows.
Experience in gaming, especially free to play or 4X strategy titles.




How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

Championing Inclusion at WBD

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, mental or physical disability, and genetic information, marital status, citizenship status, military status, protected veteran status or any other category protected by law.

If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

In compliance with local law, we are disclosing the compensation, or a range thereof, for roles in locations where legally required. Actual salaries will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to external market data, internal equity, location, skill set, experience, and/or performance. Base pay is just one component of Warner Bros. Discovery’s total compensation package for employees. Pay Range: $63,000.00 - $117,000.00 salary per year. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, short- and long-term incentives, and program-specific awards. In addition, Warner Bros. Discovery provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, an employee wellness program, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays and sick time and vacation.

Description:
Beghou brings over three decades of experience helping life sciences companies optimize their commercialization through strategic insight, advanced analytics, and technology. Beghou also deploys proprietary and third-party technology solutions to help companies forecast performance, design territories, manage customer data, organize, and report on medical and commercial data, and more. Our mission is to bring together analytical minds and innovative technology to help life sciences companies navigate the complexity of health care and improve patient outcomes.

Collaborate with leadership to define project scope, approach, and development strategies
Contribute to Beghou’s internal data warehouse build
Demonstrate knowledge of data platform components (warehouse, monitoring, etc.) and data engineering (ETL design, schema design, etc.) and CI/CD best practices.
Analyze data, synthesize findings, and develop actionable insights, communicating results to both internal and external teams
Work on projects, handling client communications, meeting facilitation, and timelines, serving as a primary point of contact with minimal oversight
Develop and optimize data processes, utilizing coding where necessary to facilitate efficient data handling and reporting
Coordinate with global and diverse teams to ensure seamless project execution
Contribute to internal firm initiatives to drive organizational growth





You’ll Need to Have:


Bachelor’s or advanced degree with at least 2+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry
Experience with one or more additional UI-based ETL tools (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Alteryx, Informatica, SnapLogic, Boomi, Prophecy), preferred.
Experience with relational database technologies, such as Databricks, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and MySQL.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Word, PowerPoint), with advanced expertise in Excel
Knowledge of coding languages (e.g., Python, PySpark, SAS, VBA, etc.) and experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is highly preferred
Experience with Claude Code or ChatGPT Codex is preferred
Excellent analytical and quantitative skills, with a proven ability to solve complex problems
Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal
Demonstrated organizational, time management, and project management skills, with the ability to lead teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously
Strong ability to collaborate, adapt quickly, and work effectively in a fast-paced environment
Familiarity with industry best practices in data analytics within the pharmaceutical sector

Title: Data Analyst, ReBIRD
Description:
Your Opportunity at ARC’TERYX:
As the Data Analyst, ReBIRD, your expertise in analysis and data-driven insights supports key decisions on product service, repair, and long-term strategy. Reporting to the Senior Data Analyst, ReBIRD you will work closely with cross-functional partners of the ReBIRD program to deliver a best-in-class guest experience that extends the lifecycle of Arc’teryx products. You are a driven professional focused on creating a data-driven culture and enabling decision makers in the short- and long-term strategy to deliver on a best-in-class guest experience.




This role is based out of our North Vancouver office and is open to hybrid remote work. Candidates must be eligible to work in Canada.






Meet Your Future Team:




Under the Circularity umbrella, the ReBIRD team supports the operations of our warranty and repairs program, our service centers within retail, and resale.  The global ReBIRD program focuses on an exceptional Guest experience at all Commercial touchpoints, inclusive of Guest Services, After Sales, Branded activations, and especially within our owned Vertical channels, Retail and eCommerce. 







If you were in the Data Analyst, ReBIRD role now, here are some of the core activities you would be doing:


Performing data manipulation and analysis to support key performance metrics across the service and repair network


Maintaining recurring forecasts and supporting the development of new forecasting techniques


Building and maintaining dashboards in Power BI including troubleshooting and debugging errors, refreshing, and publishing data


Gathering business requirements and translating them into data requirements and specifications


Collaborating with cross-functional teams including Business Intelligence, Technology, Design, Quality Control, and Supply Chain; representing company needs in after-sales returns and service and working on projects to enable informed decision making


Improving data through research and analysis of product returns and trends in support of product insights and design teams


Understanding and teaching others about global service delivery systems and processes in relation to regional differences and constraints for reporting visibility





Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:





Supporting the creation and reporting of sustainability metrics and measuring the impact of the service and repair program, in partnership with our Sustainability team


Contributing to the evolution of data tools across the business, providing subject matter expertise in future development of data platforms


Integrating APAC regions into greater data analytics work to better inform global ReBIRD analytics


Incorporating raw material data to support forecasting, ordering, managing, and fulfillment






Are you our next Data Analyst, ReBIRD?



You have a Bachelor’s Degree in Math, Economics, Statistics, Finance, Business or a related field


You have 3+ years' experience synthesizing complex analysis into actionable insights and presenting insights to senior leaders


You have excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to summarize and express ideas clearly through visualizations, written documents and presentations


You have extensive experience in data visualization and analysis software (e.g. Power BI, Excel, Tableau, SQL, etc.)


You have experience with data manipulation and management including ETL, user provisioning, and Power BI service management


You have experience balancing customer focus with long-term strategic goals and operational constraints, and you take initiative in documenting and presenting opportunities for improvement


You are proactive in identifying the root cause of issues and developing solutions.


You remain highly flexible and adaptable when faced with ambiguity.


Your passion for your work is paralleled by your passion for getting outside and living it.


You are able and willing to travel as required








CompensationThe salary range for this role is CAD$71,000 - CAD$93,000
















Total Rewards




Most new team members join between the start and midpoint of the range, where you can contribute right away while continuing to grow your craft, your collaborations, and your impact at Arc’teryx. This range reflects market alignment and the scope of the role. Individual pay is determined by your skills, experience, and level of responsibility. 










We’re committed to fair, equitable, and competitive pay, reviewed regularly to ensure internal alignment and market relevance. Transparency is part of how we follow through on our commitments and how we honour the value you bring to our team. 










In addition to base pay, Arc’teryx supports people through benefits designed to sustain both work and life: 












Health & wellbeing - Extended health, dental, and vision coverage, including mental health support, fertility benefits, gender-affirming care and a 24/7 Employee Assistance Program (EAP).


Financial wellbeing - RRSP matching and eligibility for Arc'teryx Annual Incentive Plan and access to Employee Stock Purchase program (ESPP) where applicable.


Time & Flexibility - Paid time off, wellness time, and No Wasted Day program (dedicated paid days to get outside & explore).


Family support - Parental leave top-up and a nesting period for new parents.


Growth, community & gear - Professional development opportunities, Arc'teryx Academies (outdoor skill-building events), Employee Belonging Councils, and access to employee discounts and Pro Deals (exclusive discounted pricing on gear). 











 *Eligibility for certain programs may vary by role. 








Equal Opportunity




 




Arc’teryx is committed to actively creating and fostering a culture of inclusivity where voices are heard, people are seen, and values are respected. We care about the uniqueness of our applicants, employees, and guests, and we do so in a safe space fueled by curiosity and acceptance.

Title: Technical Data Package Analyst
Description:
Location: Halifax - Wilkinson, Canada

In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.

Technical Data Package Analyst

Halifax, NS, Canada (Hybrid)

Position Summary

Thales has a vacancy for a Technical Data Package Analyst to act as the primary integrator between Technical Data, ILS, Supply Support, Life Cycle Material Managers (LCMMs), and Engineering departments. They are responsible for identifying and resolving part changes within the Technical Data Package (TDP), managing the full lifecycle of Document Change Requests (DCRs) via a JIRA board, and ensuring total data alignment across internal and government systems.

Regulatory Compliance Requirements


This position requires direct or indirect access to hardware, software or technical information (data) controlled under the Canadian Export Control List and/or the ITAR or the US the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). All applicants must be eligible or able to obtain authorization for such access.
Requires a positive Controlled Goods assessment as you will have direct access to hardware, software, technology or technical data controlled under the Canadian Controlled Goods Program
Required to obtain and maintain a Security Clearance at the NATO Secret Level



Key Areas of Responsibility


Technical Data Package (TDP) Management & Configuration Control: Conduct deep-dive audits of the TDP to ensure National Stock Numbers (NSNs), part numbers, and vendor references are current; perform hands-on updates to technical documentation to reflect the as-supported fleet configuration; and resolve technical discrepancies between engineering drawings and procurement/cataloguing systems.
Change Management & Workflow Coordination: Manage and maintain a dedicated JIRA board to track technical changes; coordinate DCRs from identification through approval and implementation by obtaining required inputs from LCMMs and Engineering; and identify and resolve process bottlenecks to advance stalled requests.
Data Integrity & System Administration: Reconcile data between Maximo and DRMIS to ensure consistency; execute high-accuracy data entry and maintenance within Maximo to support maintenance and supply activities; and maintain accurate supply support records derived from LSA data.
Cataloguing & Government System Liaison: Interface with the Canadian Government Cataloguing System (CGCM/CGCS) to resolve cataloguing discrepancies and facilitate new NSN assignments.
Data Analysis, Reporting & Database Management: Utilize Excel (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables) to conduct mass data cleanses and identify trends; develop and maintain Power BI dashboards to provide visibility into part changes and obsolescence risks; and leverage Microsoft Access to manage complex datasets requiring structured, searchable records.
Obsolescence & Supply Support Planning: Proactively identify parts approaching end-of-life, collaborate with the Obsolescence department to identify and catalogue suitable alternatives, and translate LSA data into actionable supply support records to prepare the supply chain for future maintenance requirements.



Chorus Role


Prepare and Deliver Customer Service



Minimum Qualifications


Technical System Expertise: Proven experience using both Maximo and DRMIS (or CGCS/CGCM) is mandatory.
Software Proficiency: Advanced Excel skills are essential (VLOOKUP’s, Pivot Tables, and complex data reconciliation).
Change Management: Demonstrated experience managing workflows and tasks within JIRA.
Experience: 5 years in ILS, Supply Support, or Technical Data Management within a defence or aerospace environment.
Critical Thinking: The candidate must be a self-motivated problem solver capable of investigating complex data discrepancies independently.



If you’re excited about working with Thales, but not meeting the requirements for this position, we encourage you to join our Talent Community!

Preferred Qualifications


Data Analytics & Database Tools: Proficiency in Power BI and Microsoft Access is considered a strong asset.
Defense & In-Service Support Experience: Experience with DND In-Service Support (ISS) contracts and experience supporting an operational military asset.
Logistics Support Analysis Expertise: Familiarity with Logistics Support Analysis (LSA) and exposure to Logistics Support Analysis application software such as OmegaPS.
Technical Publications & Documentation Standards: Knowledge of Canadian Forces Technical Orders (CFTOs) and government-adopted technical publications.
Digital Technical Data Standards: Knowledge of the S1000D specification and Interactive Electronic Technical Manual (IETM) format.
Language Requirements: Bilingualism (English/French).



Special Position Requirements


Schedule: Core business hours Monday – Friday, 40 hours per week.
Physical Environment: Hybrid position – which is a mix of working from home and onsite (in office, at customer site or on-board ships alongside in harbour.
Physical Demands: Predominantly office work but may be required to work in dockyards and onboard Naval ships.
Travel: Occasional domestic travel maybe required in support of the ships.



What We Offer

The reference Total Target Compensation (TTC) market range for this position, inclusive of annual base salary and the variable compensation target, is between Total Target Cash (TTC) $74,146.88– $126,733.63 CAD Annual. This reflects how companies in a similar industry and geographic region generally pay for similar jobs. This range helps the Company make pay decisions as one data point among many. Where a position falls within this range is also dependent on other factors including – but not limited to – the employee’s career path history, competencies, skills and performance, as well as the company’s annual salary budget, the customer’s program requirements, and the company’s internal equity. Thales may offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s status protected by local, state, or federal law.

All hiring decisions, including candidate evaluation, selection, and disposition, are made by human recruiters. Artificial intelligence does not make hiring decisions on our behalf.

Title: Analytics Data Specialist
Description:
Welcome Home!

We’re more than Canada’s largest independent hardware and building supplies retailer—we’re part of communities across the nation.




Build Trusted Data. Empower Every Decision.

As the Analytics Data Specialist, you will champion and deliver enterprise data products that turn raw data into trusted insights, enabling scalable analytics through an Analytics Centre of Excellence. As part of the team that powers enterprise reporting and decision-making, you'll empower every area of the business with trusted data and insights that drive measurable business outcomes. Led by the Manager, Data and Analytics, this opportunity suits a collaborative and detail-oriented professional who enjoys building scalable data solutions, enabling enterprise analytics, and solving complex data challenges.




Ready to make an impact in a new role? Here’s how:

Design, build, and maintain scalable data products within Microsoft Fabric and Azure ecosystems that deliver trusted, business-ready data for reporting, analytics and decision making.
Develop and maintain Lakehouse and Warehouse data architectures, ensuring structured high performing data layers that support enterprise analytics.
Design and optimize business aligned semantic models that enable consistent reporting and analytics.
Develop automated data pipelines and integrated workflows using Fabric Data Factory, notebooks and Azure services to transform and deliver data.
Implement scalable data transformations that standardize how data is curated and modeled for analytics consumption.
Ensure data quality, integrity and reliability through validation, monitoring and cleansing processes across all datasets.
Collaborate with analytics teams to deliver high quality data solutions and enable adoption of enterprise data products.
Support enterprise data governance and master data management practices by applying data standards and lineage tracking.




We’re looking for:

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, or a related field; additional analytics certifications are an asset.
A minimum of five years of experience in data analytics, data engineering, or a related analytics role.
Strong experience with cloud data platforms, particularly Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, and Azure SQL.
Strong experience with data engineering and analytics languages (PySpark, SQL, Python, R).
Experience with database technologies (SQL Server, Azure SQL), PowerShell scripting, and ETL/ELT processes (SSIS).
Experience with cloud data platforms, particularly Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, and Azure SQL.
Experience with automation and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub) to support repeatable deployments.
Strong understanding of modern data architecture, including medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), dimensional and semantic data models, and data governance practices.
Experience delivering end-to-end analytics solutions, including data ingestion, transformation, semantic modeling, and reporting (Power BI).
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose issues across distributed data platforms.
Excellent cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to build relationships and confidently interact with senior leaders.
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Highly adaptable, with a passion for learning and evolving alongside emerging technologies such as Microsoft Fabric and AI.
Experience with data mining, predictive analytics, machine learning, and Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) is an asset.
The ability to be onsite three days a week at our corporate office in St. Jacobs, to accommodate our hybrid working model.




How we’ll make you feel at Home

Our Team Members enjoy life at Home with our strong culture of support and inclusion, excellent benefits, and a team that always has your back. You will receive:

The expected starting salary range for this role is $85,800 - $128,600; the final offer will reflect relevant skills and experience.
Eligible for the annual bonus program.
Comprehensive Benefits Program including:
Health, Dental, Vision, Paramedical, Disability coverage, Out of Country Travel Insurance, Life Insurance, Employee Family Assistance Program.
Defined Contribution Pension Plan with Company Match, and choice of contribution level.
Group RRSP.
Discount from our Corporate Retail Store in St. Jacobs.
Home & Auto Insurance discounts.
Competitive vacation time.
Personal and sick time.
Employee Discount Program through Venngo WorkPerks.

Reporting to the Manager, Business Analytics, the Business Intelligence Analyst is responsible for transforming business data into actionable insights through data analysis, semantic model development, and other analytics solutions.

This role partners closely with our Agile Delivery team to understand requirements, communicate findings, and develop trusted analytics products that support operational and strategic decision-making.

The Business Intelligence Analyst plays a key role in building, enhancing, and maintaining enterprise data and reporting assets while partnering closely with our Agile Delivery team to understand requirements and deliver trusted analytics products that support operational and strategic decision-making.

Apply today to join our True Blue Team in Edmonton or Calgary AB today!

Maintain and enhance existing Power BI models, ETL scripts (M), calculations (DAX), and design (UI/UX) in conjunction with GitHub and Jira, following best practice lifecycle development
Work with business users to assess new build requests, refine requirements using Confluence and Jira, and develop reporting content in Power BI or other reporting tools that aligns with established development best practices
Enhance the organization's catalogue of Power Apps and Power Automate solutions
Build foundational knowledge across the analytics stack, including Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, Paginated Reports, Databricks, and Sigma
Support routine maintenance, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting of analytics assets and low-code solutions
Collaborate regularly with internal stakeholders, including the Construction Services Sustainment Team, business leaders, operational teams, finance teams, project teams, Information Services, Data Engineering, and Data Governance teams to gather requirements, support reporting and analytics initiatives, and drive effective business outcomes
Communicate progress, blockers, risks, and questions clearly with team members and business partners
Demonstrate curiosity, initiative, and a continuous learning mindset by asking thoughtful questions, seeking feedback, and building both technical and business knowledge
Perform other duties as assigned

Minimum of a College, trade, or technical diploma or a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is required
Minimum 3-5 years of experience developing business intelligence, analytics, reporting, or data visualization solutions
Experience gathering business requirements, translating them into technical solutions, and delivering reporting and analytics outcomes
Strong experience with Microsoft Power BI, including Power Query, DAX, semantic modelling, report design, and SQL
Experience working with large and complex datasets to generate actionable business insights and support decision-making
Foundational knowledge of cloud-based analytics platforms and modern data ecosystems, including Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Azure, or similar technologies

Analyze and interpret large and complex datasets to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable insights for clients and internal stakeholders.

Post-secondary education in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Actuarial Science, Business Analytics, or a related discipline; equivalent experience will also be considered.
3–5 years of experience in underwriting, insurance, group benefits, financial analysis, or a similar analytical role.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, advanced formulas, data analysis, and data clean up techniques.
Experience using Power Query to transform, validate, and automate data processes.
Experience with VBA or other automation tools is considered a strong asset.
Demonstrated experience working with large datasets and producing insightful reports, analyses, and recommendations.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
Ability to interpret complex data and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
Effective verbal and written communication skills.
Strong collaboration and teamwork skills, including the ability to work across departments and with external partners.
Knowledge of group benefits, underwriting principles, and/or the insurance industry is an asset.

Learn by working alongside our experts

Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

About The Team

We’re looking for an experienced, highly independent analytics engineer to join our Revenue Analytics team. This team owns the data products, reporting infrastructure, semantic foundations, and analytical systems that support Affirm’s Revenue organization.

About The Role

In this role, you will lead the development of scalable, trusted data products for Affirm’s revenue teams. You turn ambiguous business and technical problems into scalable solutions across data modeling, metrics, dashboards, automation, governance, and AI enablement. You will help set the technical direction for Revenue’s data layer, establish the semantic and metadata foundations required for AI, and raise the quality and impact of data across the Revenue organization.

Lead high-impact data product initiatives for Revenue, from ambiguous problem definition through technical design, implementation, rollout, and adoption.

Design and build durable, well-tested data products that power revenue operations, field and executive reporting, external merchant reporting, and analyst self-service.
Set technical direction for Revenue’s data layer across dbt models, metrics, semantic structures, documentation, lineage, testing, governance, and access controls.
Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and scale Revenue Analytics through improved data architecture, tooling, governance, and enablement.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to analysts and cross-functional partners, raising the bar for how data products are designed, built, and maintained.


What We Look For


7+ years of experience in analytics engineering, business intelligence, data engineering, data product development, or a related technical analytics role.
Deep expertise in SQL, dbt, data modeling, metrics design, data quality, documentation, and modern analytics engineering practices.
Strong working knowledge of BI tools such as Sigma, Looker, or Tableau, cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, and modern data platforms such as Databricks.
Strong understanding of the foundations required for reliable AI—including semantic layers, metadata, evaluations, documentation, lineage, access controls, and data quality—and experience applying AI tools within analytics engineering workflows.
Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, ambiguous projects by defining scope, sequencing work, managing tradeoffs, aligning stakeholders, and delivering durable technical solutions.
Experience designing scalable data products for multiple audiences and influencing technical and non-technical stakeholders around architecture and product direction.
Familiarity with Salesforce and experience supporting commercial, GTM, revenue, or sales operations teams.

Equity Grade - 6

Title: Financial Data Analyst
Description:
Join Our Team

"Cascade Aerospace is one of Canada's leading specialty aerospace and defence contractors - a place where we do cool things for great customers!" We invite you to consider a career with us - come, experience our creative, innovative, and performance-based company!

Job Description

Financial Data Analyst supports financial planning, reporting, costing, and business decision-making through advanced data analysis and financial modeling. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Excel, Power BI, and database querying tools, combined with a solid foundation in accounting and ERP systems. This role will transform complex financial data into actionable insights that drive operational and financial performance.

CPA designation is not required. Candidates with strong analytical, financial modeling, and business intelligence skills are encouraged to apply.

This position requires immediate Controlled Goods clearance, therefore, only Canadian Citizens or Permanent Residents will be considered at this time.

Major Responsibilities & Duties

Financial Analysis & Reporting


Analyze large volumes of financial and operational data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
Develop and maintain recurring financial reports, dashboards, and KPIs.
Support budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis processes.
Provide actionable recommendations to management based on financial and business performance.


Financial Modeling


Build, maintain, and enhance financial models for budgeting, forecasting, scenario analysis, and strategic decision-making.
Develop profitability, pricing, and cost allocation models.
Perform sensitivity and trend analyses to support business initiatives and investments.


Business Intelligence & Data Analytics


Design and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI.
Extract, transform, and analyze data using SQL, Power Query, and other query tools.
Improve data quality, reporting accuracy, and automation across finance processes.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to define reporting requirements and data solutions.


Costing & ERP Systems


Support product costing, operational costing, and margin analysis initiatives.
Analyze manufacturing, distribution, or operational costs to identify efficiency opportunities.
Maintain and validate financial data within ERP systems.
Partner with operations, supply chain, and accounting teams to improve cost visibility and reporting.


Accounting & Financial Controls


Apply general accounting principles to ensure accuracy and consistency in reporting.
Support month-end and year-end financial reporting activities.
Assist with account reconciliations, financial audits, and internal controls as required.
Ensure data integrity between ERP systems and reporting platforms.


Core Skills


Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including: PivotTables, Power Query, Advanced formulas and functions, and Financial modeling
Strong proficiency in Power BI dashboard development and data visualization.
Experience writing and optimizing SQL queries and working with relational databases.
Strong understanding of data management, reporting automation, and analytics best practices.
Familiarity with ERP reporting tools and financial data structures.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.
Ability to translate complex financial data into clear business insights.
Effective communication and presentation skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.


Education


University degree in Business, Accounting or equivalent
CPA designation is not required.


Experience


3–7 years of experience in financial analysis, business analysis, data analytics, or related finance roles.
Experience building robust financial models and conducting financial analysis.
Experience working with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, JD Edwards, or similar).
Experience with costing and general accounting practices.
Experience in manufacturing, distribution, supply chain, or operational finance environments.
Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and business intelligence tools.
Experience with advanced analytics, forecasting, and scenario planning.
Understanding of cost accounting methodologies and profitability analysis.


Reasons To Apply


Employee retention and engagement is important to Cascade; we value our employees.
Comprehensive benefits package provided. Extended benefits and the Employee Resilience Program (all 100% paid by Cascade) are offered after 3 months of employment and Pension matching after 6 months.
ATO (Approved Training Organization) provides endorsement (type) training & development.
Company-wide social events and family functions throughout the year.
Relocation Package available for qualifying candidates.

Cascade Aerospace Inc. is a dynamic, privately-held Canadian specialty aerospace and defence contractor focused on providing long-term integrated aircraft support programs for Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), military, government and commercial customers.

All employees are encouraged to realize their true potential and play an active role in fostering an environment of safety, quality, customer satisfaction and continuous improvement. We are a diverse organization that strives to be respectful and inclusive of everyone and to treat employees fairly and equally.

At Cascade Aerospace we strongly believe in the value of teaming - with our employees, our customers, our suppliers, and our communities. 3-5 years' experience as a Business Analyst, ideally on data or reporting products.

Experience gathering requirements from diverse, sometimes non-technical stakeholders, including in situations with unclear requirements or changing priorities
Data profiling experience, including querying and profiling data using SQL
Exposure to a cloud data platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Experience working within an Agile delivery methodology
Excellent communication skills — confident liaising with stakeholders at all levels, able to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences
Sound analytical thinking, problem-solving, and negotiation skills
Self-motivated and comfortable working autonomously, while collaborating closely with the other Data Business Analysts

Nice-to-have


Experience in a retail environment.
Technical data skills: Power BI or other visualization tools
Experience in data visualisation techniques and principles
Awareness of the use of AI to support in the Data BA space


Compensation: $95,000 - $115,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.

Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose

Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Title: Analyst, Offer Management & Optimization
Description:
This position requires in-person collaboration up to five days a week. This arrangement is subject to change based on business requirements.

Why WestJet

Since our story took off in 1996, WestJet has strived to enrich the lives of everyone in our world; a career with us is no exception. We’re proud to be one of Canada’s most admired and respected corporate cultures and continuously aim for the highest standards of service and success.

Join us, this is where your career story takes off.

Overview Of Role

As the Analyst, Offer Management & Optimization, you will tackle the complex puzzle of airline pricing by bringing WestJet's Offer Management strategy to life through data-driven execution. This role is focused on actively optimizing fares, designing dynamic bundles, and leveraging large datasets to test and deploy modern offer strategies.

Acting as a critical bridge between Commercial and Technology teams, working alongside Pricing, Revenue Management, Digital, Distribution, and external technology partners, you will ensure WestJet delivers innovative retailing capabilities that directly boost revenue and elevate guest value.

Key Responsibilities

Offer Execution & Optimization


Support the evolution and daily execution of WestJet's Offer Management capabilities across:
Fare price optimization
Ancillary price optimization
Dynamic bundle generation
Offer optimization and decisioning
Commercial experimentation and testing
Offer governance and configuration
Collaborate closely with Pricing and Revenue Management teams to ensure pricing strategies are effectively executed through Offer Management tools.


Cross-Functional Delivery


Manage day-to-day technical workflows with internal teams and external vendors, using tools like Postman to validate API requests, troubleshoot integrations, and ensure seamless offer delivery.
Participate in the business delivery of new capabilities by working with stakeholders across the organization including Pricing, Revenue Management, Distribution, Digital, Commercial Technology, Finance, and the Contact Centre.
Gather and document business requirements, coordinate testing, and assist with change management and release readiness to ensure successful implementations


Performance Management


Monitor product performance, build queries, and identify optimization opportunities by tracking key commercial metrics, including:
Revenue uplift
Conversion rates
Ancillary attachment
Bundle performance
Pricing effectiveness
Customer adoption
Provide regular reporting, dashboards, and actionable recommendations to leadership


Experience And Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline
2–4 years of experience in data analytics, airline commercial strategy, pricing, revenue management, product management, or distribution
Experience supporting complex technology or commercial transformation initiatives
Demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional stakeholders and external vendors
Understanding of airline pricing and revenue management principles
Familiarity with Offer Management and Pricing Optimization concepts
Knowledge of airline retailing and distribution
Strong commercial and analytical mindset with proficiency in analyzing performance data
Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights
Strong hands-on experience querying large relational databases using SQL on cloud platforms like Snowflake, and visualizing data in tools like Tableau or PowerBI
Familiarity with API testing and validation (e.g., using Postman) to support technical troubleshooting and vendor integrations is an asset


The Benefits Of Being a WestJetter

WestJet provides all WestJetters with a competitive total rewards package. On top of that, we offer:


A fun and friendly culture with colleagues who work together to win
Travel privileges for you and your family, effective from your start date
Savings and Benefit programs that are flexible to meet your specific needs


Think we’re a great fit? Apply now!

WestJet took to the skies in 1996 with just over 200 employees and three aircraft operating service to five destinations. Since then, WestJet has pioneered low-cost travel in Canada, cutting airfares in half, and increasing the flying population in Canada by more than 50 per cent. Since the Sunwing Airlines integration in 2025, more than 15,000 WestJetters support nearly 200 aircraft and connect guests to our global network of more than 100 destinations across North America, Central America, the Caribbean, Europe and Asia. The WestJet Group is a major Canadian employer and includes WestJet Airlines, WestJet Encore and Sunwing Vacations Group. Title: Continuous Improvement Specialist
Description:
The Continuous Improvement Specialist bridges the gap between operational data and real-world execution. This role is responsible for analyzing courier, customer, and partner performance data to uncover hidden inefficiencies, designing structured "test and learn" pilots, and validating proof-of-concepts before they are scaled across global markets. The ideal candidate thrives on turning complex data into actionable recommendations and running live experiments in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. Ultimately, this role is critical to optimizing our global logistics footprint, directly impacting courier satisfaction, cost efficiency, and customer loyalty.

Key Responsibilities


Data Analysis & Opportunity Identification
Analyze operational performance data and key performance indicators (including courier utilization, complaints, and delivery reliability) to identify trends, bottlenecks, and service risks.
Quantify and articulate specific areas of opportunity across courier experience and support touchpoints.
Partner with data teams to enhance dashboards and reports (utilizing tools like Tableau or SQL) to back all improvement initiatives with hard data.
Lead process improvement initiatives focused on service quality, operational efficiency, capacity utilization, and cost reduction.
Facilitate process mapping, root cause analysis, Kaizen events, and problem-solving workshops.
Pilot Execution & Experimentation
Develop and deliver continuous improvement initiatives across all courier experience and courier support touchpoints, ensuring cohesive plans, ongoing measurement and impact to couriers and team members
Adopt a strict "test and learn" culture by designing, launching, and managing live pilots to continuously experiment with operational hypotheses.
Drive a globalised and aligned approach while adapting for local needs
Establish clear success metrics for pilots to quickly determine feasibility for scaling across various markets.
Monitor, validate, and report on the realized benefits, cost-effectiveness, and productivity impacts of all implemented pilot programs.
Stakeholder Engagement & Scaling
Collaborate closely with operations leaders, market teams, and global functions to ensure pilots align with business priorities and local regulations.
Clearly present data-driven insights, pilot proposals, and project milestones to key stakeholders and management.
Develop current and future-state process documentation to ensure a seamless handoff to Operations, Training and QA teams when a pilot is approved for scaling.

Qualifications & Competencies


Experience: 3–4 years of experience in continuous improvement, business analysis, operations management, or logistics.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.
Technical Skills: Strong analytical thinking with a data-driven approach ; experience using Tableau, SQL, or other data analytics tools is highly preferred.
Methodologies: Practical experience with Lean principles, root cause analysis, and project management practices.
Soft Skills: Exceptional stakeholder management skills ; independent thinker who is proactive and highly comfortable navigating ambiguity.


Why work at Skip?

Skip is the kind of workplace that garnered a “Top Places to Work in Manitoba” and it was no small coincidence. We set out to make this a place our employees are proud to tell their Mothers, Fathers, friends and anyone who will listen that they work here. Skip team members feel pride knowing their input and uniqueness are not only embraced but make an impact on a major Canadian company and its satisfied customers. As the company grows, so do you — you meet and surpass new challenges every day. That’s just a small taste of what it’s like to work at one of Canada’s leading tech companies. If you’re hungry for opportunity, growth, and something meaningful in a dynamic, fun and challenging environment, we’d love to hear from you.

SKIP is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive environment where all employees feel they truly belong and where everyone is included, seen, heard and respected.

In keeping with our values, all applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of: gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, marital/domestic partner status, (dis)ability, neurodivergence, or any other characteristic protected by law. Should you require any accommodations throughout the hiring process, we encourage you to reach out to your talent acquisition specialist.

Note


All employees will be asked to sign a Consent for Disclosure of Personal Information in order to complete a background check. Job offers will be conditional upon results that the Company determines to be satisfactory.
This is a hybrid role, requiring 3 days per week in our Winnipeg office and 2 days per week working remotely from home.

    • Adopt a strict "test and learn" culture by designing, launching, and managing live pilots to continuously experiment with operational hypotheses.

    • Establish clear success metrics for pilots to quickly determine feasibility for scaling across various markets.

    • Collaborate closely with operations leaders, market teams, and global functions to ensure pilots align with business priorities and local regulations.
    • Clearly present data-driven insights, pilot proposals, and project milestones to key stakeholders and management.
    • Develop current and future-state process documentation to ensure a seamless handoff to Operations, Training and QA teams when a pilot is approved for scaling.

Title: Maximo Technical Data Package Analyst
Description:
Location: Halifax - Wilkinson, Canada

In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.

Maximo Technical Data Package Analyst

Halifax, NS, Canada (Hybrid)

Position Summary

Thales has a vacancy for a Maximo Technical Data Package Analyst to act as the primary integrator between Technical Data, ILS, Supply Support, Life Cycle Material Managers (LCMMs), and Engineering departments. They are responsible for identifying and resolving part changes within the Technical Data Package (TDP), managing the full lifecycle of Document Change Requests (DCRs) via a JIRA board, and ensuring total data alignment across internal and government systems.

Regulatory Compliance Requirements


This position requires direct or indirect access to hardware, software or technical information (data) controlled under the Canadian Export Control List and/or the ITAR or the US the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). All applicants must be eligible or able to obtain authorization for such access.
Requires a positive Controlled Goods assessment as you will have direct access to hardware, software, technology or technical data controlled under the Canadian Controlled Goods Program
Required to obtain and maintain a Security Clearance at the NATO Secret Level



Key Areas of Responsibility


Technical Data Package (TDP) Management & Configuration Control: Conduct deep-dive audits of the TDP to ensure National Stock Numbers (NSNs), part numbers, and vendor references are current; perform hands-on updates to technical documentation to reflect the as-supported fleet configuration; and resolve technical discrepancies between engineering drawings and procurement/cataloguing systems.
Change Management & Workflow Coordination: Manage and maintain a dedicated JIRA board to track technical changes; coordinate DCRs from identification through approval and implementation by obtaining required inputs from LCMMs and Engineering; and identify and resolve process bottlenecks to advance stalled requests.
Data Integrity & System Administration: Reconcile data between Maximo and DRMIS to ensure consistency; execute high-accuracy data entry and maintenance within Maximo to support maintenance and supply activities; and maintain accurate supply support records derived from LSA data.
Cataloguing & Government System Liaison: Interface with the Canadian Government Cataloguing System (CGCM/CGCS) to resolve cataloguing discrepancies and facilitate new NSN assignments.
Data Analysis, Reporting & Database Management: Utilize Excel (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables) to conduct mass data cleanses and identify trends; develop and maintain Power BI dashboards to provide visibility into part changes and obsolescence risks; and leverage Microsoft Access to manage complex datasets requiring structured, searchable records.
Obsolescence & Supply Support Planning: Proactively identify parts approaching end-of-life, collaborate with the Obsolescence department to identify and catalogue suitable alternatives, and translate LSA data into actionable supply support records to prepare the supply chain for future maintenance requirements.



Chorus Role


Prepare and Deliver Customer Service



Minimum Qualifications


Technical System Expertise: Proven experience using both Maximo and DRMIS (or CGCS/CGCM) is mandatory.
Software Proficiency: Advanced Excel skills are essential (VLOOKUP’s, Pivot Tables, and complex data reconciliation).
Change Management: Demonstrated experience managing workflows and tasks within JIRA.
Experience: 5 years in ILS, Supply Support, or Technical Data Management within a defence or aerospace environment.
Critical Thinking: The candidate must be a self-motivated problem solver capable of investigating complex data discrepancies independently.



If you’re excited about working with Thales, but not meeting the requirements for this position, we encourage you to join our Talent Community!

Preferred Qualifications


Data Analytics & Database Tools: Proficiency in Power BI and Microsoft Access is considered a strong asset.
Defense & In-Service Support Experience: Experience with DND In-Service Support (ISS) contracts and experience supporting an operational military asset.
Logistics Support Analysis Expertise: Familiarity with Logistics Support Analysis (LSA) and exposure to Logistics Support Analysis application software such as OmegaPS.
Technical Publications & Documentation Standards: Knowledge of Canadian Forces Technical Orders (CFTOs) and government-adopted technical publications.
Digital Technical Data Standards: Knowledge of the S1000D specification and Interactive Electronic Technical Manual (IETM) format.
Language Requirements: Bilingualism (English/French).



Special Position Requirements


Schedule: Core business hours Monday – Friday, 40 hours per week.
Physical Environment: Hybrid position – which is a mix of working from home and onsite (in office, at customer site or on-board ships alongside in harbour.
Physical Demands: Predominantly office work but may be required to work in dockyards and onboard Naval ships.
Travel: Occasional domestic travel maybe required in support of the ships.

Title: Content Analyst
Description:
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.

Job Description

The team:

We are a unified, collaborative marketing team focused on creating meaningful client connections that drive business growth. We combine deep insights with strong partnerships to deliver timely, relevant, and impactful experiences for our clients. Our team is committed to continuous learning, innovation, and excellence in everything we do. We align closely with distribution partners to generate demand and unlock new opportunities across the business. Above all, we measure and optimize our efforts to ensure we consistently deliver value, drive engagement, and strengthen loyalty to Invesco.

The role:

The Content Enablement Content Analyst is a key role within Invesco’s Global Content Enablement team, supporting the Americas & EMEA Marketing organization. This position executes the content strategy and roadmap to enhance the quality, accessibility, and usability of content across the EMEA region. The role focuses on building and managing content infrastructure, ensuring accurate categorization, distribution, and access across platforms and audiences. It partners closely with business and technology stakeholders to deliver consistent, well-governed content solutions and ensure requirements are clearly defined and tested. This hands-on role is critical to improving content quality and driving engagement, ultimately enabling a stronger client and investment experience.

Responsibilities of the role:

Provides analytics support primarily for EMEA content domains, with additional support for North America.
Partners closely with EMEA Content Product Owners to deliver analysis across development, deployment, and research initiatives.
Defines and standardizes content quality metrics, building reporting and dashboards to provide visibility into content performance for senior leadership.
Collaborates with EMEA and NA domain experts to develop and maintain global taxonomy, aligning stakeholders to standardized definitions and fields.
Bridges business and technology teams to ensure solutions meet requirements and align with strategic priorities.
Maps business processes, develops expertise in content sources, and provides recommendations to improve content effectiveness.
Translates stakeholder needs into user stories and supports execution of content initiatives, including testing, impact analysis, and cross-team coordination.
Leads governance and documentation efforts, including content quality monitoring, process improvement, issue escalation, and maintaining records in tools such as Jira and Confluence.


Requirements of the role:

Bachelor’s degree, 5+ years in technology platforms, project management, or content development and distribution.
Experience with CMS and/or DAM platforms, content lifecycle management, and content migrations, including API-based integrations.
Familiarity with AI-assisted content analysis and UX or digital marketing concepts.
Strong skills in workflow/process mapping, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and operate effectively in ambiguous environments.
Advanced technical proficiency, including SQL and Excel (advanced formulas, pivot tables; VBA a plus), along with strong desktop tool capabilities.
Strong analytical and statistical reasoning skills, with ability to organize, analyze, and communicate large data sets with accuracy and attention to detail.
Knowledge of content categorization (campaign, program, asset class, product), with preferred experience in investment or asset management content.
Client-focused, execution-oriented professional with strong communication, organizational, relationship-building, and influencing skills, plus a data-driven approach to measuring content performance and impact.


The salary range for this position is $55,000 to $61,000 per year. The total compensation offered for this position includes salary and incentive pay and will vary based on skills, experience and location.

Full Time / Part Time

Full time

Worker Type

Employee

Job Exempt (Yes / No)

Yes

Workplace Model

Pursuant to Invesco’s Workplace Policy, employees are expected to comply with the firm’s most current workplace model, which as of October 1, 2025, includes spending at least four full days each week working in an Invesco office. This reflects our belief that spending time together in the office helps us build stronger relationships, collaborate more easily, and support each other’s growth and development.

What’s in it for you?

Our people are at the very core of our success and we strive to provide employees with a competitive total rewards package which includes:

Hybrid working environment
RRSP Contributions
Health & Wellness Benefits
Work flexibility Programs
Parental Leave Benefits
Study Support

The job holder may be required to perform other duties as deemed appropriate by their manager from time to time.

Title: Power BI Developer
Description:
About The Role

Job Overview:

As a Power BI Developer, you will play a dual role—developing impactful business intelligence solutions while also building strong relationships with potential clients. You will design, develop, and maintain business analytics dashboards and reports using Power BI to provide actionable insights for clients. Additionally, you will help explain the value of Power BI and other technology solutions to prospective clients, ensuring they understand how our offerings can solve their business challenges.

Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement: Establish and maintain relationships with clients, understanding their data analytics needs and offering customized BI solutions.

Solution Development: Design, create, and manage Power BI reports and dashboards that transform raw data into meaningful insights.

Data Analysis: Work with clients to analyze business data, identify trends, and provide solutions that improve business performance.

Requirement Gathering: Collaborate with clients to understand their needs and translate them into effective Power BI solutions.

Technical Expertise: Advise clients on the best Power BI practices, data modeling, DAX expressions, and report optimization.

Sales Collaboration: Work closely with the sales team to present Power BI solutions to prospective clients, demonstrating the value of data-driven decision-making.

Continuous Improvement: Stay up-to-date with Power BI features, and incorporate new tools and methodologies to improve client solutions.

Training: Provide client training sessions and documentation to ensure users can efficiently navigate and use Power BI tools.

Lead Generation Support: Assist in generating leads through strategic conversations and presentations that highlight our BI solutions.

Requirements

Qualifications:


Proven experience (3+ years) working as a Power BI Developer or Business Intelligence Specialist.
Strong technical skills in Power BI, including data modeling, DAX (Data Analysis Expressions), Power Query, and visualization best practices.
Experience with data integration from multiple data sources like SQL, Excel, and cloud-based databases.
Strong understanding of database management and ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes.
Proven ability to understand client business challenges and develop technical solutions that address these issues.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical solutions to non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to manage multiple projects and client relationships simultaneously.
Familiarity with business process analysis and the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights.


About The Company

BI Control is a company that offers a wide range of innovative services to drive the success and growth of organizations.

We are a forward-thinking startup providing cutting-edge business technology solutions to help organizations optimize their operations. Our services empower companies with the data insights needed to drive better decision-making and growth.

We are looking for a passionate Power BI Developer to join our growing team and engage with clients, building solutions that drive business performance.
